## sendRichMessage

Use this method to send rich messages. If the message contains a block with a media element, then the bot must have the right to send the media to the chat. On success, the sent `Message` is returned.

- PHP: `$api->sendRichMessage(array $params): Types\Message`
- Request class: `Requests\SendRichMessage`
- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendrichmessage

Parameters:
- `business_connection_id` (optional) `string` — Unique identifier of the business connection on behalf of which the message will be sent. Bot can send rich messages on behalf of a business account only if the corresponding user can send rich messages.
- `chat_id` (required) `int|string` — Unique identifier for the target chat or username of the target bot, supergroup or channel in the format `@username`
- `message_thread_id` (optional) `int` — Unique identifier for the target message thread (topic) of a forum; for forum supergroups and private chats of bots with forum topic mode enabled only
- `direct_messages_topic_id` (optional) `int` — Identifier of the direct messages topic to which the message will be sent; required if the message is sent to a direct messages chat
- `ephemeral_message_parameters` (optional) `Types\EphemeralMessageParameters|array<string, mixed>` — A JSON-serialized object containing the parameters of the ephemeral message to send
- `rich_message` (required) `RichMessages\InputRichMessage|array<string, mixed>` — The message to be sent
- `disable_notification` (optional) `bool` — Sends the message [silently](https://telegram.org/blog/channels-2-0#silent-messages). Users will receive a notification with no sound.
- `protect_content` (optional) `bool` — Protects the contents of the sent message from forwarding and saving
- `allow_paid_broadcast` (optional) `bool` — Pass *True* to allow up to 1000 messages per second, ignoring [broadcasting limits](https://core.telegram.org/bots/faq#how-can-i-message-all-of-my-bot-39s-subscribers-at-once) for a fee of 0.1 Telegram Stars per message. The relevant Stars will be withdrawn from the bot's balance.
- `message_effect_id` (optional) `string` — Unique identifier of the message effect to be added to the message; for private chats only
- `suggested_post_parameters` (optional) `Types\SuggestedPostParameters|array<string, mixed>` — A JSON-serialized object containing the parameters of the suggested post to send; for direct messages chats only. If the message is sent as a reply to another suggested post, then that suggested post is automatically declined.
- `reply_parameters` (optional) `Types\ReplyParameters|array<string, mixed>` — Description of the message to reply to
- `reply_markup` (optional) `Types\InlineKeyboardMarkup|array<string, mixed>|Types\ReplyKeyboardMarkup|Types\ReplyKeyboardRemove|Types\ForceReply` — Additional interface options. A JSON-serialized object for an [inline keyboard](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#inline-keyboards), [custom reply keyboard](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#keyboards), instructions to remove a reply keyboard or to force a reply from the user.

## sendRichMessageDraft

Use this method to stream a partial rich message to a user while the message is being generated. Note that the streamed draft is ephemeral and acts as a temporary 30-second preview - once the output is finalized, you **must** call `sendRichMessage` with the complete message to persist it in the user's chat. Returns *True* on success.

- PHP: `$api->sendRichMessageDraft(array $params): Base\ParameterBool`
- Request class: `Requests\SendRichMessageDraft`
- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendrichmessagedraft

Parameters:
- `chat_id` (required) `int` — Unique identifier for the target private chat
- `message_thread_id` (optional) `int` — Unique identifier for the target message thread
- `draft_id` (required) `int` — Unique identifier of the message draft; must be non-zero. Changes to drafts with the same identifier are animated. Otherwise, the draft is replaced without animation.
- `rich_message` (required) `RichMessages\InputRichMessage|array<string, mixed>` — The partial message to be streamed. Direct upload of new files and explicit upload of files by a URL isn't supported.
- `can_stop` (optional) `bool` — Pass *True* to show the user a button to stop further drafts. The bot will receive an `Update` “stopped_message_generation” if the user presses the button.
- `keep_on_stop` (optional) `bool` — Pass *True* to keep the draft in the chat when the button is pressed. The draft will still disappear after a short time or if the bot sends a message. To fully preserve the partial draft, the bot should send it as a new message.

## answerInlineQuery

Use this method to send answers to an inline query. On success, *True* is returned.
No more than **50** results per query are allowed.

- PHP: `$api->answerInlineQuery(array $params): Base\ParameterBool`
- Request class: `Requests\AnswerInlineQuery`
- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#answerinlinequery

Parameters:
- `inline_query_id` (required) `string` — Unique identifier for the answered query
- `results` (required) `list<InlineMode\InlineQueryResult|array<string, mixed>>|Base\ArrayObject<InlineMode\InlineQueryResult>` — A JSON-serialized Array of results for the inline query
- `cache_time` (optional) `int` — The maximum amount of time in seconds that the result of the inline query may be cached on the server. Defaults to 300.
- `is_personal` (optional) `bool` — Pass *True* if results may be cached on the server side only for the user that sent the query. By default, results may be returned to any user who sends the same query.
- `next_offset` (optional) `string` — Pass the offset that a client should send in the next query with the same text to receive more results. Pass an empty string if there are no more results or if you don't support pagination. Offset length can't exceed 64 bytes.
- `button` (optional) `InlineMode\InlineQueryResultsButton|array<string, mixed>` — A JSON-serialized object describing a button to be shown above inline query results

## sendInvoice

Use this method to send invoices. On success, the sent `Message` is returned.

- PHP: `$api->sendInvoice(array $params): Types\Message`
- Request class: `Requests\SendInvoice`
- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendinvoice

Parameters:
- `chat_id` (required) `int|string` — Unique identifier for the target chat or username of the target bot, supergroup or channel in the format `@username`
- `message_thread_id` (optional) `int` — Unique identifier for the target message thread (topic) of a forum; for forum supergroups and private chats of bots with forum topic mode enabled only
- `direct_messages_topic_id` (optional) `int` — Identifier of the direct messages topic to which the message will be sent; required if the message is sent to a direct messages chat
- `title` (required) `string` — Product name, 1-32 characters
- `description` (required) `string` — Product description, 1-255 characters
- `payload` (required) `string` — Bot-defined invoice payload, 1-128 bytes. This will not be displayed to the user, use it for your internal processes.
- `provider_token` (optional) `string` — Payment provider token, obtained via [@BotFather](https://t.me/botfather). Pass an empty string for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).
- `currency` (required) `string` — Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code, see [more on currencies](https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments#supported-currencies). Pass “XTR” for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).
- `prices` (required) `list<Payments\LabeledPrice|array<string, mixed>>|Base\ArrayObject<Payments\LabeledPrice>` — Price breakdown, a JSON-serialized list of components (e.g. product price, tax, discount, delivery cost, delivery tax, bonus, etc.). Must contain exactly one item for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).
- `max_tip_amount` (optional) `int` — The maximum accepted amount for tips in the *smallest units* of the currency (integer, **not** float/double). For example, for a maximum tip of `US$ 1.45` pass `max_tip_amount = 145`. See the *exp* parameter in [currencies.json](https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments/currencies.json), it shows the number of digits past the decimal point for each currency (2 for the majority of currencies). Defaults to 0. Not supported for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).
- `suggested_tip_amounts` (optional) `list<int>|Base\ArrayObject<Base\ParameterInt>` — A JSON-serialized Array of suggested amounts of tips in the *smallest units* of the currency (integer, **not** float/double). At most 4 suggested tip amounts can be specified. The suggested tip amounts must be positive, passed in a strictly increased order and must not exceed *max_tip_amount*.
- `start_parameter` (optional) `string` — Unique deep-linking parameter. If left empty, **forwarded copies** of the sent message will have a *Pay* button, allowing multiple users to pay directly from the forwarded message, using the same invoice. If non-empty, forwarded copies of the sent message will have a *URL* button with a deep link to the bot (instead of a *Pay* button), with the value used as the start parameter.
- `provider_data` (optional) `string` — JSON-serialized data about the invoice, which will be shared with the payment provider. A detailed description of required fields should be provided by the payment provider.
- `photo_url` (optional) `string` — URL of the product photo for the invoice. Can be a photo of the goods or a marketing image for a service. People like it better when they see what they are paying for.
- `photo_size` (optional) `int` — Photo size in bytes
- `photo_width` (optional) `int` — Photo width
- `photo_height` (optional) `int` — Photo height
- `need_name` (optional) `bool` — Pass *True* if you require the user's full name to complete the order. Ignored for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).
- `need_phone_number` (optional) `bool` — Pass *True* if you require the user's phone number to complete the order. Ignored for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).
- `need_email` (optional) `bool` — Pass *True* if you require the user's email address to complete the order. Ignored for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).
- `need_shipping_address` (optional) `bool` — Pass *True* if you require the user's shipping address to complete the order. Ignored for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).
- `send_phone_number_to_provider` (optional) `bool` — Pass *True* if the user's phone number should be sent to the provider. Ignored for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).
- `send_email_to_provider` (optional) `bool` — Pass *True* if the user's email address should be sent to the provider. Ignored for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).
- `is_flexible` (optional) `bool` — Pass *True* if the final price depends on the shipping method. Ignored for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).
- `disable_notification` (optional) `bool` — Sends the message [silently](https://telegram.org/blog/channels-2-0#silent-messages). Users will receive a notification with no sound.
- `protect_content` (optional) `bool` — Protects the contents of the sent message from forwarding and saving
- `allow_paid_broadcast` (optional) `bool` — Pass *True* to allow up to 1000 messages per second, ignoring [broadcasting limits](https://core.telegram.org/bots/faq#how-can-i-message-all-of-my-bot-39s-subscribers-at-once) for a fee of 0.1 Telegram Stars per message. The relevant Stars will be withdrawn from the bot's balance.
- `message_effect_id` (optional) `string` — Unique identifier of the message effect to be added to the message; for private chats only
- `suggested_post_parameters` (optional) `Types\SuggestedPostParameters|array<string, mixed>` — A JSON-serialized object containing the parameters of the suggested post to send; for direct messages chats only. If the message is sent as a reply to another suggested post, then that suggested post is automatically declined.
- `reply_parameters` (optional) `Types\ReplyParameters|array<string, mixed>` — Description of the message to reply to
- `reply_markup` (optional) `Types\InlineKeyboardMarkup|array<string, mixed>` — A JSON-serialized object for an [inline keyboard](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#inline-keyboards). If empty, one 'Pay `total price`' button will be shown. If not empty, the first button must be a Pay button.

## createInvoiceLink

Use this method to create a link for an invoice. Returns the created invoice link as *String* on success.

- PHP: `$api->createInvoiceLink(array $params): Base\ParameterString`
- Request class: `Requests\CreateInvoiceLink`
- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#createinvoicelink

Parameters:
- `business_connection_id` (optional) `string` — Unique identifier of the business connection on behalf of which the link will be created. For payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90) only.
- `title` (required) `string` — Product name, 1-32 characters
- `description` (required) `string` — Product description, 1-255 characters
- `payload` (required) `string` — Bot-defined invoice payload, 1-128 bytes. This will not be displayed to the user, use it for your internal processes.
- `provider_token` (optional) `string` — Payment provider token, obtained via [@BotFather](https://t.me/botfather). Pass an empty string for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).
- `currency` (required) `string` — Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code, see [more on currencies](https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments#supported-currencies). Pass “XTR” for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).
- `prices` (required) `list<Payments\LabeledPrice|array<string, mixed>>|Base\ArrayObject<Payments\LabeledPrice>` — Price breakdown, a JSON-serialized list of components (e.g. product price, tax, discount, delivery cost, delivery tax, bonus, etc.). Must contain exactly one item for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).
- `subscription_period` (optional) `int` — The number of seconds the subscription will be active for before the next payment. The currency must be set to “XTR” (Telegram Stars) if the parameter is used. Currently, it must always be 2592000 (30 days) if specified. Any number of subscriptions can be active for a given bot at the same time, including multiple concurrent subscriptions from the same user. Subscription price must no exceed 10000 Telegram Stars.
- `max_tip_amount` (optional) `int` — The maximum accepted amount for tips in the *smallest units* of the currency (integer, **not** float/double). For example, for a maximum tip of `US$ 1.45` pass `max_tip_amount = 145`. See the *exp* parameter in [currencies.json](https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments/currencies.json), it shows the number of digits past the decimal point for each currency (2 for the majority of currencies). Defaults to 0. Not supported for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).
- `suggested_tip_amounts` (optional) `list<int>|Base\ArrayObject<Base\ParameterInt>` — A JSON-serialized Array of suggested amounts of tips in the *smallest units* of the currency (integer, **not** float/double). At most 4 suggested tip amounts can be specified. The suggested tip amounts must be positive, passed in a strictly increased order and must not exceed *max_tip_amount*.
- `provider_data` (optional) `string` — JSON-serialized data about the invoice, which will be shared with the payment provider. A detailed description of required fields should be provided by the payment provider.
- `photo_url` (optional) `string` — URL of the product photo for the invoice. Can be a photo of the goods or a marketing image for a service.
- `photo_size` (optional) `int` — Photo size in bytes
- `photo_width` (optional) `int` — Photo width
- `photo_height` (optional) `int` — Photo height
- `need_name` (optional) `bool` — Pass *True* if you require the user's full name to complete the order. Ignored for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).
- `need_phone_number` (optional) `bool` — Pass *True* if you require the user's phone number to complete the order. Ignored for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).
- `need_email` (optional) `bool` — Pass *True* if you require the user's email address to complete the order. Ignored for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).
- `need_shipping_address` (optional) `bool` — Pass *True* if you require the user's shipping address to complete the order. Ignored for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).
- `send_phone_number_to_provider` (optional) `bool` — Pass *True* if the user's phone number should be sent to the provider. Ignored for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).
- `send_email_to_provider` (optional) `bool` — Pass *True* if the user's email address should be sent to the provider. Ignored for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).
- `is_flexible` (optional) `bool` — Pass *True* if the final price depends on the shipping method. Ignored for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).

## answerShippingQuery

If you sent an invoice requesting a shipping address and the parameter *is_flexible* was specified, the Bot API will send an `Update` with a *shipping_query* field to the bot. Use this method to reply to shipping queries. On success, *True* is returned.

- PHP: `$api->answerShippingQuery(array $params): Base\ParameterBool`
- Request class: `Requests\AnswerShippingQuery`
- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#answershippingquery

Parameters:
- `shipping_query_id` (required) `string` — Unique identifier for the query to be answered
- `ok` (required) `bool` — Pass *True* if delivery to the specified address is possible and *False* if there are any problems (for example, if delivery to the specified address is not possible)
- `shipping_options` (optional) `list<Payments\ShippingOption|array<string, mixed>>|Base\ArrayObject<Payments\ShippingOption>` — Required if *ok* is *True*. A JSON-serialized Array of available shipping options.
- `error_message` (optional) `string` — Required if *ok* is *False*. Error message in human readable form that explains why it is impossible to complete the order (e.g. “Sorry, delivery to your desired address is unavailable”). Telegram will display this message to the user.

## answerPreCheckoutQuery

Once the user has confirmed their payment and shipping details, the Bot API sends the final confirmation in the form of an `Update` with the field *pre_checkout_query*. Use this method to respond to such pre-checkout queries. On success, *True* is returned. **Note:** The Bot API must receive an answer within 10 seconds after the pre-checkout query was sent.

- PHP: `$api->answerPreCheckoutQuery(array $params): Base\ParameterBool`
- Request class: `Requests\AnswerPreCheckoutQuery`
- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#answerprecheckoutquery

Parameters:
- `pre_checkout_query_id` (required) `string` — Unique identifier for the query to be answered
- `ok` (required) `bool` — Specify *True* if everything is alright (goods are available, etc.) and the bot is ready to proceed with the order. Use *False* if there are any problems.
- `error_message` (optional) `string` — Required if *ok* is *False*. Error message in human readable form that explains the reason for failure to proceed with the checkout (e.g. "Sorry, somebody just bought the last of our amazing black T-shirts while you were busy filling out your payment details. Please choose a different color or garment!"). Telegram will display this message to the user.

## getMyStarBalance

A method to get the current Telegram Stars balance of the bot. Requires no parameters. On success, returns a `StarAmount` object.

- PHP: `$api->getMyStarBalance(): Types\StarAmount`
- Request class: `Requests\GetMyStarBalance`
- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#getmystarbalance

## getStarTransactions

Returns the bot's Telegram Star transactions in chronological order. On success, returns a `StarTransactions` object.

- PHP: `$api->getStarTransactions(array $params = []): Payments\StarTransactions`
- Request class: `Requests\GetStarTransactions`
- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#getstartransactions

Parameters:
- `offset` (optional) `int` — Number of transactions to skip in the response
- `limit` (optional) `int` — The maximum number of transactions to be retrieved. Values between 1-100 are accepted. Defaults to 100.

## refundStarPayment

Refunds a successful payment in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90). Returns *True* on success.

- PHP: `$api->refundStarPayment(array $params): Base\ParameterBool`
- Request class: `Requests\RefundStarPayment`
- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#refundstarpayment

Parameters:
- `user_id` (required) `int` — Identifier of the user whose payment will be refunded
- `telegram_payment_charge_id` (required) `string` — Telegram payment identifier

## editUserStarSubscription

Allows the bot to cancel or re-enable extension of a subscription paid in Telegram Stars. Returns *True* on success.

- PHP: `$api->editUserStarSubscription(array $params): Base\ParameterBool`
- Request class: `Requests\EditUserStarSubscription`
- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#edituserstarsubscription

Parameters:
- `user_id` (required) `int` — Identifier of the user whose subscription will be edited
- `telegram_payment_charge_id` (required) `string` — Telegram payment identifier for the subscription
- `is_canceled` (required) `bool` — Pass *True* to cancel extension of the user subscription; the subscription must be active up to the end of the current subscription period. Pass *False* to allow the user to re-enable a subscription that was previously canceled by the bot.

## setPassportDataErrors

Informs a user that some of the Telegram Passport elements they provided contains errors. The user will not be able to re-submit their Passport to you until the errors are fixed (the contents of the field for which you returned the error must change). Returns *True* on success.

Use this if the data submitted by the user doesn't satisfy the standards your service requires for any reason. For example, if a birthday date seems invalid, a submitted document is blurry, a scan shows evidence of tampering, etc. Supply some details in the error message to make sure the user knows how to correct the issues.

- PHP: `$api->setPassportDataErrors(array $params): Base\ParameterBool`
- Request class: `Requests\SetPassportDataErrors`
- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#setpassportdataerrors

Parameters:
- `user_id` (required) `int` — User identifier
- `errors` (required) `list<Passport\PassportElementError|array<string, mixed>>|Base\ArrayObject<Passport\PassportElementError>` — A JSON-serialized Array describing the errors

## sendGame

Use this method to send a game. On success, the sent `Message` is returned.

- PHP: `$api->sendGame(array $params): Types\Message`
- Request class: `Requests\SendGame`
- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendgame

Parameters:
- `business_connection_id` (optional) `string` — Unique identifier of the business connection on behalf of which the message will be sent
- `chat_id` (required) `int|string` — Unique identifier for the target chat or username of the target bot in the format `@username`. Games can't be sent to channel direct messages chats and channel chats.
- `message_thread_id` (optional) `int` — Unique identifier for the target message thread (topic) of a forum; for forum supergroups and private chats of bots with forum topic mode enabled only
- `game_short_name` (required) `string` — Short name of the game, serves as the unique identifier for the game. Set up your games via [@BotFather](https://t.me/botfather).
- `disable_notification` (optional) `bool` — Sends the message [silently](https://telegram.org/blog/channels-2-0#silent-messages). Users will receive a notification with no sound.
- `protect_content` (optional) `bool` — Protects the contents of the sent message from forwarding and saving
- `allow_paid_broadcast` (optional) `bool` — Pass *True* to allow up to 1000 messages per second, ignoring [broadcasting limits](https://core.telegram.org/bots/faq#how-can-i-message-all-of-my-bot-39s-subscribers-at-once) for a fee of 0.1 Telegram Stars per message. The relevant Stars will be withdrawn from the bot's balance.
- `message_effect_id` (optional) `string` — Unique identifier of the message effect to be added to the message; for private chats only
- `reply_parameters` (optional) `Types\ReplyParameters|array<string, mixed>` — Description of the message to reply to
- `reply_markup` (optional) `Types\InlineKeyboardMarkup|array<string, mixed>` — A JSON-serialized object for an [inline keyboard](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#inline-keyboards). If empty, one 'Play game_title' button will be shown. If not empty, the first button must launch the game.

## setGameScore

Use this method to set the score of the specified user in a game message. On success, if the message is not an inline message, the `Message` is returned, otherwise *True* is returned. Returns an error, if the new score is not greater than the user's current score in the chat and *force* is *False*.

- PHP: `$api->setGameScore(array $params): Types\Message|bool`
- Request class: `Requests\SetGameScore`
- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#setgamescore

Parameters:
- `user_id` (required) `int` — User identifier
- `score` (required) `int` — New score, must be non-negative
- `force` (optional) `bool` — Pass *True* if the high score is allowed to decrease. This can be useful when fixing mistakes or banning cheaters.
- `disable_edit_message` (optional) `bool` — Pass *True* if the game message should not be automatically edited to include the current scoreboard
- `chat_id` (optional) `int` — Required if *inline_message_id* is not specified. Unique identifier for the target chat.
- `message_id` (optional) `int` — Required if *inline_message_id* is not specified. Identifier of the sent message.
- `inline_message_id` (optional) `string` — Required if *chat_id* and *message_id* are not specified. Identifier of the inline message.

## getGameHighScores

Use this method to get data for high score tables. Will return the score of the specified user and several of their neighbors in a game. Returns an Array of `GameHighScore` objects.

This method will currently return scores for the target user, plus two of their closest neighbors on each side. Will also return the top three users if the user and their neighbors are not among them. Please note that this behavior is subject to change.

- PHP: `$api->getGameHighScores(array $params): Base\ArrayObject<Games\GameHighScore>`
- Request class: `Requests\GetGameHighScores`
- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#getgamehighscores

Parameters:
- `user_id` (required) `int` — Target user id
- `chat_id` (optional) `int` — Required if *inline_message_id* is not specified. Unique identifier for the target chat.
- `message_id` (optional) `int` — Required if *inline_message_id* is not specified. Identifier of the sent message.
- `inline_message_id` (optional) `string` — Required if *chat_id* and *message_id* are not specified. Identifier of the inline message.

# Reference: types

## Update

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\Update`

This [object](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#available-types) represents an incoming update.
At most **one** of the optional fields can be present in any given update.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#update

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `update_id` → `$updateId` / `getUpdateId()` / `setUpdateId()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. The update's unique identifier. Update identifiers start from a certain positive number and increase sequentially. This identifier becomes especially handy if you're using `setWebhook`, since it allows you to ignore repeated updates or to restore the correct update sequence, should they get out of order. If there are no new updates for at least a week, then identifier of the next update will be chosen randomly instead of sequentially.
- `message` → `$message` / `getMessage()` / `setMessage()`: `Types\Message|null`; `Types\Message|array<string, mixed>` — optional. New incoming message of any kind - text, photo, sticker, etc.
- `edited_message` → `$editedMessage` / `getEditedMessage()` / `setEditedMessage()`: `Types\Message|null`; `Types\Message|array<string, mixed>` — optional. New version of a message that is known to the bot and was edited. This update may at times be triggered by changes to message fields that are either unavailable or not actively used by your bot.
- `channel_post` → `$channelPost` / `getChannelPost()` / `setChannelPost()`: `Types\Message|null`; `Types\Message|array<string, mixed>` — optional. New incoming channel post of any kind - text, photo, sticker, etc.
- `edited_channel_post` → `$editedChannelPost` / `getEditedChannelPost()` / `setEditedChannelPost()`: `Types\Message|null`; `Types\Message|array<string, mixed>` — optional. New version of a channel post that is known to the bot and was edited. This update may at times be triggered by changes to message fields that are either unavailable or not actively used by your bot.
- `business_connection` → `$businessConnection` / `getBusinessConnection()` / `setBusinessConnection()`: `Types\BusinessConnection|null`; `Types\BusinessConnection|array<string, mixed>` — optional. The bot was connected to or disconnected from a business account, or a user edited an existing connection with the bot
- `business_message` → `$businessMessage` / `getBusinessMessage()` / `setBusinessMessage()`: `Types\Message|null`; `Types\Message|array<string, mixed>` — optional. New message from a connected business account
- `edited_business_message` → `$editedBusinessMessage` / `getEditedBusinessMessage()` / `setEditedBusinessMessage()`: `Types\Message|null`; `Types\Message|array<string, mixed>` — optional. New version of a message from a connected business account
- `deleted_business_messages` → `$deletedBusinessMessages` / `getDeletedBusinessMessages()` / `setDeletedBusinessMessages()`: `Types\BusinessMessagesDeleted|null`; `Types\BusinessMessagesDeleted|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Messages were deleted from a connected business account
- `guest_message` → `$guestMessage` / `getGuestMessage()` / `setGuestMessage()`: `Types\Message|null`; `Types\Message|array<string, mixed>` — optional. New guest message. The bot can use the field *Message.guest_query_id* and the method `answerGuestQuery` to send a message in response.
- `message_reaction` → `$messageReaction` / `getMessageReaction()` / `setMessageReaction()`: `Types\MessageReactionUpdated|null`; `Types\MessageReactionUpdated|array<string, mixed>` — optional. A reaction to a message was changed by a user. The bot must be an administrator in the chat and must explicitly specify `"message_reaction"` in the list of *allowed_updates* to receive these updates. The update isn't received for reactions set by bots.
- `message_reaction_count` → `$messageReactionCount` / `getMessageReactionCount()` / `setMessageReactionCount()`: `Types\MessageReactionCountUpdated|null`; `Types\MessageReactionCountUpdated|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Reactions to a message with anonymous reactions were changed. The bot must be an administrator in the chat and must explicitly specify `"message_reaction_count"` in the list of *allowed_updates* to receive these updates. The updates are grouped and can be sent with delay up to a few minutes.
- `inline_query` → `$inlineQuery` / `getInlineQuery()` / `setInlineQuery()`: `InlineMode\InlineQuery|null`; `InlineMode\InlineQuery|array<string, mixed>` — optional. New incoming [inline](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inline-mode) query
- `chosen_inline_result` → `$chosenInlineResult` / `getChosenInlineResult()` / `setChosenInlineResult()`: `InlineMode\ChosenInlineResult|null`; `InlineMode\ChosenInlineResult|array<string, mixed>` — optional. The result of an [inline](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inline-mode) query that was chosen by a user and sent to their chat partner. Please see our documentation on the [feedback collecting](https://core.telegram.org/bots/inline#collecting-feedback) for details on how to enable these updates for your bot.
- `callback_query` → `$callbackQuery` / `getCallbackQuery()` / `setCallbackQuery()`: `Types\CallbackQuery|null`; `Types\CallbackQuery|array<string, mixed>` — optional. New incoming callback query
- `shipping_query` → `$shippingQuery` / `getShippingQuery()` / `setShippingQuery()`: `Payments\ShippingQuery|null`; `Payments\ShippingQuery|array<string, mixed>` — optional. New incoming shipping query. Only for invoices with flexible price.
- `pre_checkout_query` → `$preCheckoutQuery` / `getPreCheckoutQuery()` / `setPreCheckoutQuery()`: `Payments\PreCheckoutQuery|null`; `Payments\PreCheckoutQuery|array<string, mixed>` — optional. New incoming pre-checkout query. Contains full information about checkout.
- `purchased_paid_media` → `$purchasedPaidMedia` / `getPurchasedPaidMedia()` / `setPurchasedPaidMedia()`: `Payments\PaidMediaPurchased|null`; `Payments\PaidMediaPurchased|array<string, mixed>` — optional. A user purchased paid media with a non-empty payload sent by the bot in a non-channel chat
- `poll` → `$poll` / `getPoll()` / `setPoll()`: `Types\Poll|null`; `Types\Poll|array<string, mixed>` — optional. New poll state. Bots receive only updates about manually stopped polls and polls, which are sent by the bot.
- `poll_answer` → `$pollAnswer` / `getPollAnswer()` / `setPollAnswer()`: `Types\PollAnswer|null`; `Types\PollAnswer|array<string, mixed>` — optional. A user changed their answer in a non-anonymous poll. Bots receive new votes only in polls that were sent by the bot itself.
- `my_chat_member` → `$myChatMember` / `getMyChatMember()` / `setMyChatMember()`: `Types\ChatMemberUpdated|null`; `Types\ChatMemberUpdated|array<string, mixed>` — optional. The bot's chat member status was updated in a chat. For private chats, this update is received only when the bot is blocked or unblocked by the user.
- `chat_member` → `$chatMember` / `getChatMember()` / `setChatMember()`: `Types\ChatMemberUpdated|null`; `Types\ChatMemberUpdated|array<string, mixed>` — optional. A chat member's status was updated in a chat. The bot must be an administrator in the chat and must explicitly specify `"chat_member"` in the list of *allowed_updates* to receive these updates.
- `chat_join_request` → `$chatJoinRequest` / `getChatJoinRequest()` / `setChatJoinRequest()`: `Types\ChatJoinRequest|null`; `Types\ChatJoinRequest|array<string, mixed>` — optional. A request to join the chat has been sent. The bot must have the *can_invite_users* administrator right in the chat to receive these updates.
- `chat_boost` → `$chatBoost` / `getChatBoost()` / `setChatBoost()`: `Types\ChatBoostUpdated|null`; `Types\ChatBoostUpdated|array<string, mixed>` — optional. A chat boost was added or changed. The bot must be an administrator in the chat to receive these updates.
- `removed_chat_boost` → `$removedChatBoost` / `getRemovedChatBoost()` / `setRemovedChatBoost()`: `Types\ChatBoostRemoved|null`; `Types\ChatBoostRemoved|array<string, mixed>` — optional. A boost was removed from a chat. The bot must be an administrator in the chat to receive these updates.
- `managed_bot` → `$managedBot` / `getManagedBot()` / `setManagedBot()`: `Types\ManagedBotUpdated|null`; `Types\ManagedBotUpdated|array<string, mixed>` — optional. A new bot was created to be managed by the bot, or token or owner of a managed bot was changed
- `subscription` → `$subscription` / `getSubscription()` / `setSubscription()`: `Types\BotSubscriptionUpdated|null`; `Types\BotSubscriptionUpdated|array<string, mixed>` — optional. User payment subscription has changed
- `stopped_message_generation` → `$stoppedMessageGeneration` / `getStoppedMessageGeneration()` / `setStoppedMessageGeneration()`: `Types\MessageGenerationStopped|null`; `Types\MessageGenerationStopped|array<string, mixed>` — optional. A user asked the bot to stop the generation of a message

## WebhookInfo

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\WebhookInfo`

Describes the current status of a webhook.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#webhookinfo

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `url` → `$url` / `getUrl()` / `setUrl()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Webhook URL, may be empty if webhook is not set up
- `has_custom_certificate` → `$hasCustomCertificate` / `getHasCustomCertificate()` / `setHasCustomCertificate()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. *True*, if a custom certificate was provided for webhook certificate checks
- `pending_update_count` → `$pendingUpdateCount` / `getPendingUpdateCount()` / `setPendingUpdateCount()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Number of updates awaiting delivery
- `ip_address` → `$ipAddress` / `getIpAddress()` / `setIpAddress()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Currently used webhook IP address
- `last_error_date` → `$lastErrorDate` / `getLastErrorDate()` / `setLastErrorDate()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Unix time for the most recent error that happened when trying to deliver an update via webhook
- `last_error_message` → `$lastErrorMessage` / `getLastErrorMessage()` / `setLastErrorMessage()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Error message in human-readable format for the most recent error that happened when trying to deliver an update via webhook
- `last_synchronization_error_date` → `$lastSynchronizationErrorDate` / `getLastSynchronizationErrorDate()` / `setLastSynchronizationErrorDate()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Unix time of the most recent error that happened when trying to synchronize available updates with Telegram datacenters
- `max_connections` → `$maxConnections` / `getMaxConnections()` / `setMaxConnections()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. The maximum allowed number of simultaneous HTTPS connections to the webhook for update delivery
- `allowed_updates` → `$allowedUpdates` / `getAllowedUpdates()` / `setAllowedUpdates()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Base\ParameterString>`; `list<string>|Base\ArrayObject<Base\ParameterString>` — optional. A list of update types the bot is subscribed to. Defaults to all update types except *chat_member*, *message_reaction*, and *message_reaction_count*.

## User

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\User`

This object represents a Telegram user or bot.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#user

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `id` → `$id` / `getId()` / `setId()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Unique identifier for this user or bot. This number may have more than 32 significant bits and some programming languages may have difficulty/silent defects in interpreting it. But it has at most 52 significant bits, so a 64-bit integer or double-precision float type are safe for storing this identifier.
- `is_bot` → `$isBot` / `getIsBot()` / `setIsBot()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. *True*, if this user is a bot
- `first_name` → `$firstName` / `getFirstName()` / `setFirstName()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. User's or bot's first name
- `last_name` → `$lastName` / `getLastName()` / `setLastName()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. User's or bot's last name
- `username` → `$username` / `getUsername()` / `setUsername()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. User's or bot's username
- `language_code` → `$languageCode` / `getLanguageCode()` / `setLanguageCode()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. [IETF language tag](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IETF_language_tag) of the user's language
- `is_premium` → `$isPremium` / `getIsPremium()` / `setIsPremium()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if this user is a Telegram Premium user
- `added_to_attachment_menu` → `$addedToAttachmentMenu` / `getAddedToAttachmentMenu()` / `setAddedToAttachmentMenu()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if this user added the bot to the attachment menu
- `can_join_groups` → `$canJoinGroups` / `getCanJoinGroups()` / `setCanJoinGroups()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the bot can be invited to groups. Returned only in `getMe`.
- `can_read_all_group_messages` → `$canReadAllGroupMessages` / `getCanReadAllGroupMessages()` / `setCanReadAllGroupMessages()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if [privacy mode](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#privacy-mode) is disabled for the bot. Returned only in `getMe`.
- `supports_guest_queries` → `$supportsGuestQueries` / `getSupportsGuestQueries()` / `setSupportsGuestQueries()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the bot supports guest queries from chats it is not a member of. Returned only in `getMe`.
- `supports_inline_queries` → `$supportsInlineQueries` / `getSupportsInlineQueries()` / `setSupportsInlineQueries()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the bot supports inline queries. Returned only in `getMe`.
- `can_connect_to_business` → `$canConnectToBusiness` / `getCanConnectToBusiness()` / `setCanConnectToBusiness()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the bot can be connected to a user account to manage it. Returned only in `getMe`.
- `has_main_web_app` → `$hasMainWebApp` / `getHasMainWebApp()` / `setHasMainWebApp()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the bot has a main Web App. Returned only in `getMe`.
- `has_topics_enabled` → `$hasTopicsEnabled` / `getHasTopicsEnabled()` / `setHasTopicsEnabled()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the bot has forum topic mode enabled in private chats. Returned only in `getMe`.
- `allows_users_to_create_topics` → `$allowsUsersToCreateTopics` / `getAllowsUsersToCreateTopics()` / `setAllowsUsersToCreateTopics()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the bot allows users to create and delete topics in private chats. Returned only in `getMe`.
- `can_manage_bots` → `$canManageBots` / `getCanManageBots()` / `setCanManageBots()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if other bots can be created to be controlled by the bot. Returned only in `getMe`.
- `supports_join_request_queries` → `$supportsJoinRequestQueries` / `getSupportsJoinRequestQueries()` / `setSupportsJoinRequestQueries()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the bot supports join request queries and can be assigned to process them. Returned only in `getMe`.

## Chat

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\Chat`

This object represents a chat.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#chat

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `id` → `$id` / `getId()` / `setId()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Unique identifier for this chat. This number may have more than 32 significant bits and some programming languages may have difficulty/silent defects in interpreting it. But it has at most 52 significant bits, so a signed 64-bit integer or double-precision float type are safe for storing this identifier.
- `type` → `$type` / `getType()` / `setType()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Type of the chat, can be either “private”, “group”, “supergroup” or “channel”
- `title` → `$title` / `getTitle()` / `setTitle()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Title, for supergroups, channels and group chats
- `username` → `$username` / `getUsername()` / `setUsername()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Username, for private chats, supergroups and channels if available
- `first_name` → `$firstName` / `getFirstName()` / `setFirstName()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. First name of the other party in a private chat
- `last_name` → `$lastName` / `getLastName()` / `setLastName()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Last name of the other party in a private chat
- `is_forum` → `$isForum` / `getIsForum()` / `setIsForum()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the supergroup chat is a forum (has [topics](https://telegram.org/blog/topics-in-groups-collectible-usernames#topics-in-groups) enabled)
- `is_direct_messages` → `$isDirectMessages` / `getIsDirectMessages()` / `setIsDirectMessages()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the chat is the direct messages chat of a channel

This number may have more than 32 significant bits and some programming languages may have difficulty/silent defects in interpreting it. But it has at most 52 significant bits, so a signed 64-bit integer or double-precision float type are safe for storing this identifier.

- `has_restricted_voice_and_video_messages` → `$hasRestrictedVoiceAndVideoMessages` / `getHasRestrictedVoiceAndVideoMessages()` / `setHasRestrictedVoiceAndVideoMessages()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the privacy settings of the other party restrict sending voice and video note messages in the private chat

- `invite_link` → `$inviteLink` / `getInviteLink()` / `setInviteLink()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Primary invite link, for groups, supergroups and channel chats
- `pinned_message` → `$pinnedMessage` / `getPinnedMessage()` / `setPinnedMessage()`: `Types\Message|null`; `Types\Message|array<string, mixed>` — optional. The most recent pinned message (by sending date)
- `permissions` → `$permissions` / `getPermissions()` / `setPermissions()`: `Types\ChatPermissions|null`; `Types\ChatPermissions|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Default chat member permissions, for groups and supergroups

- `can_send_paid_media` → `$canSendPaidMedia` / `getCanSendPaidMedia()` / `setCanSendPaidMedia()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if paid media messages can be sent or forwarded to the channel chat. The field is available only for channel chats.
- `slow_mode_delay` → `$slowModeDelay` / `getSlowModeDelay()` / `setSlowModeDelay()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. For supergroups, the minimum allowed delay between consecutive messages sent by each unprivileged user; in seconds
- `unrestrict_boost_count` → `$unrestrictBoostCount` / `getUnrestrictBoostCount()` / `setUnrestrictBoostCount()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. For supergroups, the minimum number of boosts that a non-administrator user needs to add in order to ignore slow mode and chat permissions
- `message_auto_delete_time` → `$messageAutoDeleteTime` / `getMessageAutoDeleteTime()` / `setMessageAutoDeleteTime()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. The time after which all messages sent to the chat will be automatically deleted; in seconds
- `has_aggressive_anti_spam_enabled` → `$hasAggressiveAntiSpamEnabled` / `getHasAggressiveAntiSpamEnabled()` / `setHasAggressiveAntiSpamEnabled()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if aggressive anti-spam checks are enabled in the supergroup. - `has_protected_content` → `$hasProtectedContent` / `getHasProtectedContent()` / `setHasProtectedContent()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if messages from the chat can't be forwarded to other chats
- `has_visible_history` → `$hasVisibleHistory` / `getHasVisibleHistory()` / `setHasVisibleHistory()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if new chat members will have access to old messages; available only to chat administrators
- `sticker_set_name` → `$stickerSetName` / `getStickerSetName()` / `setStickerSetName()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. For supergroups, name of the group sticker set
- `can_set_sticker_set` → `$canSetStickerSet` / `getCanSetStickerSet()` / `setCanSetStickerSet()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the bot can change the group sticker set
- `custom_emoji_sticker_set_name` → `$customEmojiStickerSetName` / `getCustomEmojiStickerSetName()` / `setCustomEmojiStickerSetName()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. For supergroups, the name of the group's custom emoji sticker set. Custom emoji from this set can be used by all users and bots in the group.
- `linked_chat_id` → `$linkedChatId` / `getLinkedChatId()` / `setLinkedChatId()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Unique identifier for the linked chat, i.e. the discussion group identifier for a channel and vice versa; for supergroups and channel chats. This identifier may be greater than 32 bits and some programming languages may have difficulty/silent defects in interpreting it. But it is smaller than 52 bits, so a signed 64 bit integer or double-precision float type are safe for storing this identifier.
- `location` → `$location` / `getLocation()` / `setLocation()`: `Types\ChatLocation|null`; `Types\ChatLocation|array<string, mixed>` — optional. For supergroups, the location to which the supergroup is connected
- `rating` → `$rating` / `getRating()` / `setRating()`: `Types\UserRating|null`; `Types\UserRating|array<string, mixed>` — optional. For private chats, the rating of the user if any
- `first_profile_audio` → `$firstProfileAudio` / `getFirstProfileAudio()` / `setFirstProfileAudio()`: `Types\Audio|null`; `Types\Audio|array<string, mixed>` — optional. For private chats, the first audio added to the profile of the user

- `community` → `$community` / `getCommunity()` / `setCommunity()`: `Types\Community|null`; `Types\Community|array<string, mixed>` — optional. The `Community` to which the chat belongs

## Message

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\Message` — variant of `MaybeInaccessibleMessage`

This object represents a message.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#message

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `message_id` → `$messageId` / `getMessageId()` / `setMessageId()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Unique message identifier inside this chat; 0 for ephemeral messages. In specific instances (e.g., a message containing a video sent to a big chat), the server might automatically schedule a message instead of sending it immediately. In such cases, this field will be 0 and the relevant message will be unusable until it is actually sent.
- `message_thread_id` → `$messageThreadId` / `getMessageThreadId()` / `setMessageThreadId()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Unique identifier of a message thread or forum topic to which the message belongs; for supergroups and private chats only
- `direct_messages_topic` → `$directMessagesTopic` / `getDirectMessagesTopic()` / `setDirectMessagesTopic()`: `Types\DirectMessagesTopic|null`; `Types\DirectMessagesTopic|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Information about the direct messages chat topic that contains the message
- `from` → `$from` / `getFrom()` / `setFrom()`: `Types\User|null`; `Types\User|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Sender of the message; may be empty for messages sent to channels. For backward compatibility, if the message was sent on behalf of a chat, the field contains a fake sender user in non-channel chats.
- `sender_chat` → `$senderChat` / `getSenderChat()` / `setSenderChat()`: `Types\Chat|null`; `Types\Chat|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Sender of the message when sent on behalf of a chat. For example, the supergroup itself for messages sent by its anonymous administrators or a linked channel for messages automatically forwarded to the channel's discussion group. For backward compatibility, if the message was sent on behalf of a chat, the field *from* contains a fake sender user in non-channel chats.
- `sender_boost_count` → `$senderBoostCount` / `getSenderBoostCount()` / `setSenderBoostCount()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. If the sender of the message boosted the chat, the number of boosts added by the user
- `sender_business_bot` → `$senderBusinessBot` / `getSenderBusinessBot()` / `setSenderBusinessBot()`: `Types\User|null`; `Types\User|array<string, mixed>` — optional. The bot that actually sent the message on behalf of the business account. Available only for outgoing messages sent on behalf of the connected business account.
- `sender_tag` → `$senderTag` / `getSenderTag()` / `setSenderTag()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Tag or custom title of the sender of the message; for supergroups only
- `receiver_user` → `$receiverUser` / `getReceiverUser()` / `setReceiverUser()`: `Types\User|null`; `Types\User|array<string, mixed>` — optional. For ephemeral messages, the user who received the message
- `ephemeral_message_id` → `$ephemeralMessageId` / `getEphemeralMessageId()` / `setEphemeralMessageId()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. For ephemeral messages, identifier of the ephemeral message inside this chat. The identifier may be reused for another ephemeral message after the message is deleted or expires.
- `date` → `$date` / `getDate()` / `setDate()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Date the message was sent in Unix time. It is always a positive number, representing a valid date.
- `guest_query_id` → `$guestQueryId` / `getGuestQueryId()` / `setGuestQueryId()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. The unique identifier for the guest query. Use this identifier with the method `answerGuestQuery` to send a response message. If non-empty, the message belongs to the chat where the guest bot was summoned, which may not coincide with other existing bot chats sharing the same identifier.
- `business_connection_id` → `$businessConnectionId` / `getBusinessConnectionId()` / `setBusinessConnectionId()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Unique identifier of the business connection from which the message was received. If non-empty, the message belongs to a chat of the corresponding business account that is independent from any potential bot chat which might share the same identifier.
- `chat` → `$chat` / `getChat()` / `setChat()`: `Types\Chat|null`; `Types\Chat|array<string, mixed>` — required. Chat the message belongs to
- `forward_origin` → `$forwardOrigin` / `getForwardOrigin()` / `setForwardOrigin()`: `Types\MessageOrigin|null`; `Types\MessageOrigin|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Information about the original message for forwarded messages
- `is_topic_message` → `$isTopicMessage` / `getIsTopicMessage()` / `setIsTopicMessage()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the message is sent to a topic in a forum supergroup or a private chat with the bot
- `is_automatic_forward` → `$isAutomaticForward` / `getIsAutomaticForward()` / `setIsAutomaticForward()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the message is a channel post that was automatically forwarded to the connected discussion group
- `reply_to_message` → `$replyToMessage` / `getReplyToMessage()` / `setReplyToMessage()`: `Types\Message|null`; `Types\Message|array<string, mixed>` — optional. For replies in the same chat and message thread, the original message. Note that the `Message` object in this field will not contain further *reply_to_message* fields even if it itself is a reply. If the message is a reply to an ephemeral message, then this field may be omitted.
- `external_reply` → `$externalReply` / `getExternalReply()` / `setExternalReply()`: `Types\ExternalReplyInfo|null`; `Types\ExternalReplyInfo|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Information about the message that is being replied to, which may come from another chat or forum topic
- `quote` → `$quote` / `getQuote()` / `setQuote()`: `Types\TextQuote|null`; `Types\TextQuote|array<string, mixed>` — optional. For replies that quote part of the original message, the quoted part of the message
- `reply_to_story` → `$replyToStory` / `getReplyToStory()` / `setReplyToStory()`: `Types\Story|null`; `Types\Story|array<string, mixed>` — optional. For replies to a story, the original story
- `reply_to_checklist_task_id` → `$replyToChecklistTaskId` / `getReplyToChecklistTaskId()` / `setReplyToChecklistTaskId()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Identifier of the specific checklist task that is being replied to
- `reply_to_poll_option_id` → `$replyToPollOptionId` / `getReplyToPollOptionId()` / `setReplyToPollOptionId()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Persistent identifier of the specific poll option that is being replied to
- `via_bot` → `$viaBot` / `getViaBot()` / `setViaBot()`: `Types\User|null`; `Types\User|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Bot through which the message was sent
- `guest_bot_caller_user` → `$guestBotCallerUser` / `getGuestBotCallerUser()` / `setGuestBotCallerUser()`: `Types\User|null`; `Types\User|array<string, mixed>` — optional. For a message sent by a guest bot, this is the user whose original message triggered the bot's response

## MessageId

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\MessageId`

This object represents a unique message identifier.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#messageid

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `message_id` → `$messageId` / `getMessageId()` / `setMessageId()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Unique message identifier. In specific instances (e.g., message containing a video sent to a big chat), the server might automatically schedule a message instead of sending it immediately. In such cases, this field will be 0 and the relevant message will be unusable until it is actually sent.

## InaccessibleMessage

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\InaccessibleMessage` — variant of `MaybeInaccessibleMessage`

This object describes a message that was deleted or is otherwise inaccessible to the bot.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inaccessiblemessage

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `chat` → `$chat` / `getChat()` / `setChat()`: `Types\Chat|null`; `Types\Chat|array<string, mixed>` — required. Chat the message belonged to
- `message_id` → `$messageId` / `getMessageId()` / `setMessageId()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Unique message identifier inside the chat
- `date` → `$date` / `getDate()` / `setDate()`: `int|null`; `int` — required, always `0`. Always 0. The field can be used to differentiate regular and inaccessible messages.

## MaybeInaccessibleMessage

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\MaybeInaccessibleMessage`

This object describes a message that can be inaccessible to the bot. It can be one of

- `Message`
- `InaccessibleMessage`

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#maybeinaccessiblemessage
- Union: `MaybeInaccessibleMessage::create($data)` returns one of: `Message`, `InaccessibleMessage`

## MessageEntity

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\MessageEntity`

This object represents one special entity in a text message. For example, hashtags, usernames, URLs, etc.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#messageentity

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `type` → `$type` / `getType()` / `setType()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Type of the entity. Currently, can be “mention” (`@username`), “hashtag” (`#hashtag` or `#hashtag@chatusername`), “cashtag” (`$USD` or `$USD@chatusername`), “bot_command” (`/start@jobs_bot`), “url” (`https://telegram.org`), “email” (`do-not-reply@telegram.org`), “phone_number” (`+1-212-555-0123`), “bold” (**bold text**), “italic” (*italic text*), “underline” (underlined text), “strikethrough” (strikethrough text), “spoiler” (spoiler message), “blockquote” (block quotation), “expandable_blockquote” (collapsed-by-default block quotation), “code” (monowidth string), “pre” (monowidth block), “text_link” (for clickable text URLs), “text_mention” (for users [without usernames](https://telegram.org/blog/edit#new-mentions)), “custom_emoji” (for inline custom emoji stickers), or “date_time” (for formatted date and time).
- `offset` → `$offset` / `getOffset()` / `setOffset()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Offset in [UTF-16 code units](https://core.telegram.org/api/entities#entity-length) to the start of the entity
- `length` → `$length` / `getLength()` / `setLength()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Length of the entity in [UTF-16 code units](https://core.telegram.org/api/entities#entity-length)
- `url` → `$url` / `getUrl()` / `setUrl()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. For “text_link” only, URL that will be opened after user taps on the text
- `user` → `$user` / `getUser()` / `setUser()`: `Types\User|null`; `Types\User|array<string, mixed>` — optional. For “text_mention” only, the mentioned user
- `language` → `$language` / `getLanguage()` / `setLanguage()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. For “pre” only, the programming language of the entity text
- `custom_emoji_id` → `$customEmojiId` / `getCustomEmojiId()` / `setCustomEmojiId()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. For “custom_emoji” only, unique identifier of the custom emoji. Use `getCustomEmojiStickers` to get full information about the sticker.
- `unix_time` → `$unixTime` / `getUnixTime()` / `setUnixTime()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. For “date_time” only, the Unix time associated with the entity
- `date_time_format` → `$dateTimeFormat` / `getDateTimeFormat()` / `setDateTimeFormat()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. For “date_time” only, the string that defines the formatting of the date and time. See [date-time entity formatting](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#date-time-entity-formatting) for more details.

## TextQuote

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\TextQuote`

This object contains information about the quoted part of a message that is replied to by the given message.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#textquote

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `text` → `$text` / `getText()` / `setText()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Text of the quoted part of a message that is replied to by the given message
- `entities` → `$entities` / `getEntities()` / `setEntities()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Types\MessageEntity>`; `list<Types\MessageEntity|array<string, mixed>>|Base\ArrayObject<Types\MessageEntity>` — optional. Special entities that appear in the quote. Currently, only *bold*, *italic*, *underline*, *strikethrough*, *spoiler*, *custom_emoji*, and *date_time* entities are kept in quotes.
- `position` → `$position` / `getPosition()` / `setPosition()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Approximate quote position in the original message in UTF-16 code units as specified by the sender
- `is_manual` → `$isManual` / `getIsManual()` / `setIsManual()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the quote was chosen manually by the message sender. Otherwise, the quote was added automatically by the server.

## ExternalReplyInfo

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\ExternalReplyInfo`

This object contains information about a message that is being replied to, which may come from another chat or forum topic.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#externalreplyinfo

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `origin` → `$origin` / `getOrigin()` / `setOrigin()`: `Types\MessageOrigin|null`; `Types\MessageOrigin|array<string, mixed>` — required. Origin of the message replied to by the given message
- `chat` → `$chat` / `getChat()` / `setChat()`: `Types\Chat|null`; `Types\Chat|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Chat the original message belongs to. Available only if the chat is a supergroup or a channel.
- `message_id` → `$messageId` / `getMessageId()` / `setMessageId()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Unique message identifier inside the original chat. Available only if the original chat is a supergroup or a channel.
- `link_preview_options` → `$linkPreviewOptions` / `getLinkPreviewOptions()` / `setLinkPreviewOptions()`: `Types\LinkPreviewOptions|null`; `Types\LinkPreviewOptions|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Options used for link preview generation for the original message, if it is a text message
- `animation` → `$animation` / `getAnimation()` / `setAnimation()`: `Types\Animation|null`; `Types\Animation|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Message is an animation, information about the animation
- `audio` → `$audio` / `getAudio()` / `setAudio()`: `Types\Audio|null`; `Types\Audio|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Message is an audio file, information about the file
- `document` → `$document` / `getDocument()` / `setDocument()`: `Types\Document|null`; `Types\Document|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Message is a general file, information about the file
- `live_photo` → `$livePhoto` / `getLivePhoto()` / `setLivePhoto()`: `Types\LivePhoto|null`; `Types\LivePhoto|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Message is a live photo, information about the live photo
- `paid_media` → `$paidMedia` / `getPaidMedia()` / `setPaidMedia()`: `Types\PaidMediaInfo|null`; `Types\PaidMediaInfo|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Message contains paid media; information about the paid media
- `photo` → `$photo` / `getPhoto()` / `setPhoto()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Types\PhotoSize>`; `list<Types\PhotoSize|array<string, mixed>>|Base\ArrayObject<Types\PhotoSize>` — optional. Message is a photo, available sizes of the photo
- `sticker` → `$sticker` / `getSticker()` / `setSticker()`: `Stickers\Sticker|null`; `Stickers\Sticker|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Message is a sticker, information about the sticker
- `story` → `$story` / `getStory()` / `setStory()`: `Types\Story|null`; `Types\Story|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Message is a forwarded story
- `video` → `$video` / `getVideo()` / `setVideo()`: `Types\Video|null`; `Types\Video|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Message is a video, information about the video
- `video_note` → `$videoNote` / `getVideoNote()` / `setVideoNote()`: `Types\VideoNote|null`; `Types\VideoNote|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Message is a [video note](https://telegram.org/blog/video-messages-and-telescope), information about the video message
- `voice` → `$voice` / `getVoice()` / `setVoice()`: `Types\Voice|null`; `Types\Voice|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Message is a voice message, information about the file
- `has_media_spoiler` → `$hasMediaSpoiler` / `getHasMediaSpoiler()` / `setHasMediaSpoiler()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the message media is covered by a spoiler animation
- `checklist` → `$checklist` / `getChecklist()` / `setChecklist()`: `Types\Checklist|null`; `Types\Checklist|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Message is a checklist
- `contact` → `$contact` / `getContact()` / `setContact()`: `Types\Contact|null`; `Types\Contact|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Message is a shared contact, information about the contact
- `dice` → `$dice` / `getDice()` / `setDice()`: `Types\Dice|null`; `Types\Dice|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Message is a dice with random value
- `game` → `$game` / `getGame()` / `setGame()`: `Games\Game|null`; `Games\Game|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Message is a game, information about the game. [More about games »](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#games)
- `giveaway` → `$giveaway` / `getGiveaway()` / `setGiveaway()`: `Types\Giveaway|null`; `Types\Giveaway|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Message is a scheduled giveaway, information about the giveaway
- `giveaway_winners` → `$giveawayWinners` / `getGiveawayWinners()` / `setGiveawayWinners()`: `Types\GiveawayWinners|null`; `Types\GiveawayWinners|array<string, mixed>` — optional. A giveaway with public winners was completed
- `invoice` → `$invoice` / `getInvoice()` / `setInvoice()`: `Payments\Invoice|null`; `Payments\Invoice|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Message is an invoice for a [payment](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#payments), information about the invoice. [More about payments »](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#payments)
- `location` → `$location` / `getLocation()` / `setLocation()`: `Types\Location|null`; `Types\Location|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Message is a shared location, information about the location
- `poll` → `$poll` / `getPoll()` / `setPoll()`: `Types\Poll|null`; `Types\Poll|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Message is a native poll, information about the poll
- `venue` → `$venue` / `getVenue()` / `setVenue()`: `Types\Venue|null`; `Types\Venue|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Message is a venue, information about the venue

## ReplyParameters

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\ReplyParameters`

Describes reply parameters for the message that is being sent.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#replyparameters

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `message_id` → `$messageId` / `getMessageId()` / `setMessageId()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Identifier of the message that will be replied to in the current chat, or in the chat *chat_id* if it is specified. Required if *ephemeral_message_id* isn't specified.
- `chat_id` → `$chatId` / `getChatId()` / `setChatId()`: `int|string|null`; `int|string` — optional. If the message to be replied to is from a different chat, unique identifier for the chat or username of the bot, supergroup or channel in the format `@username`. Not supported for messages sent on behalf of a business account, messages from channel direct messages chats and ephemeral messages.
- `ephemeral_message_id` → `$ephemeralMessageId` / `getEphemeralMessageId()` / `setEphemeralMessageId()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Identifier of the incoming ephemeral message that will be replied to in the current chat. A reply to an ephemeral message must itself be an ephemeral message. An ephemeral message may only be replied to within 15 seconds of being sent. Required if *message_id* isn't specified.
- `allow_sending_without_reply` → `$allowSendingWithoutReply` / `getAllowSendingWithoutReply()` / `setAllowSendingWithoutReply()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Pass *True* if the message should be sent even if the specified message to be replied to is not found. Always *False* for replies in another chat or forum topic, and sent ephemeral messages. Always *True* for messages sent on behalf of a business account.
- `quote` → `$quote` / `getQuote()` / `setQuote()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Quoted part of the message to be replied to; 0-1024 characters after entities parsing. The quote must be an exact substring of the message to be replied to, including *bold*, *italic*, *underline*, *strikethrough*, *spoiler*, *custom_emoji*, and *date_time* entities. The message will fail to send if the quote isn't found in the original message. Ignored for ephemeral messages.
- `quote_parse_mode` → `$quoteParseMode` / `getQuoteParseMode()` / `setQuoteParseMode()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Mode for parsing entities in the quote. See [formatting options](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#formatting-options) for more details.
- `quote_entities` → `$quoteEntities` / `getQuoteEntities()` / `setQuoteEntities()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Types\MessageEntity>`; `list<Types\MessageEntity|array<string, mixed>>|Base\ArrayObject<Types\MessageEntity>` — optional. A JSON-serialized list of special entities that appear in the quote. It can be specified instead of *quote_parse_mode*.
- `quote_position` → `$quotePosition` / `getQuotePosition()` / `setQuotePosition()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Position of the quote in the original message in UTF-16 code units
- `checklist_task_id` → `$checklistTaskId` / `getChecklistTaskId()` / `setChecklistTaskId()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Identifier of the specific checklist task to be replied to
- `poll_option_id` → `$pollOptionId` / `getPollOptionId()` / `setPollOptionId()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Persistent identifier of the specific poll option to be replied to

## EphemeralMessageParameters

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\EphemeralMessageParameters`



- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#ephemeralmessageparameters

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `receiver_user_id` → `$receiverUserId` / `getReceiverUserId()` / `setReceiverUserId()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Identifier of the user who will receive the message. It is not guaranteed that the user will receive the message, especially if they are offline. See [here](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#ephemeral-messages-and-commands) for more details.
- `callback_query_id` → `$callbackQueryId` / `getCallbackQueryId()` / `setCallbackQueryId()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Identifier of the callback query which triggered the message, if any
- `replace_callback_query_message` → `$replaceCallbackQueryMessage` / `getReplaceCallbackQueryMessage()` / `setReplaceCallbackQueryMessage()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Pass *True* if the ephemeral message must be shown in place of the original message. Must be *False* for callback queries from ephemeral messages, which must be edited using regular *editEphemeralMessage…* methods.

## MessageOrigin

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\MessageOrigin`

This object describes the origin of a message. It can be one of

- `MessageOriginUser`
- `MessageOriginHiddenUser`
- `MessageOriginChat`
- `MessageOriginChannel`

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#messageorigin
- Union: `MessageOrigin::create($data)` returns one of: `MessageOriginUser`, `MessageOriginHiddenUser`, `MessageOriginChat`, `MessageOriginChannel`

## MessageOriginUser

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\MessageOriginUser` — variant of `MessageOrigin`

The message was originally sent by a known user.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#messageoriginuser

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `type` → `$type` / `getType()` / `setType()`: `string|null`; `string` — required, always `'user'`. Type of the message origin, always “user”
- `date` → `$date` / `getDate()` / `setDate()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Date the message was sent originally in Unix time
- `sender_user` → `$senderUser` / `getSenderUser()` / `setSenderUser()`: `Types\User|null`; `Types\User|array<string, mixed>` — required. User that sent the message originally

## MessageOriginHiddenUser

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\MessageOriginHiddenUser` — variant of `MessageOrigin`

The message was originally sent by an unknown user.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#messageoriginhiddenuser

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `type` → `$type` / `getType()` / `setType()`: `string|null`; `string` — required, always `'hidden_user'`. Type of the message origin, always “hidden_user”
- `date` → `$date` / `getDate()` / `setDate()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Date the message was sent originally in Unix time
- `sender_user_name` → `$senderUserName` / `getSenderUserName()` / `setSenderUserName()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Name of the user that sent the message originally

## MessageOriginChat

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\MessageOriginChat` — variant of `MessageOrigin`

The message was originally sent on behalf of a chat to a group chat.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#messageoriginchat

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `type` → `$type` / `getType()` / `setType()`: `string|null`; `string` — required, always `'chat'`. Type of the message origin, always “chat”
- `date` → `$date` / `getDate()` / `setDate()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Date the message was sent originally in Unix time
- `sender_chat` → `$senderChat` / `getSenderChat()` / `setSenderChat()`: `Types\Chat|null`; `Types\Chat|array<string, mixed>` — required. Chat that sent the message originally
- `author_signature` → `$authorSignature` / `getAuthorSignature()` / `setAuthorSignature()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. For messages originally sent by an anonymous chat administrator, original message author signature

## MessageOriginChannel

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\MessageOriginChannel` — variant of `MessageOrigin`

The message was originally sent to a channel chat.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#messageoriginchannel

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `type` → `$type` / `getType()` / `setType()`: `string|null`; `string` — required, always `'channel'`. Type of the message origin, always “channel”
- `date` → `$date` / `getDate()` / `setDate()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Date the message was sent originally in Unix time
- `chat` → `$chat` / `getChat()` / `setChat()`: `Types\Chat|null`; `Types\Chat|array<string, mixed>` — required. Channel chat to which the message was originally sent
- `message_id` → `$messageId` / `getMessageId()` / `setMessageId()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Unique message identifier inside the chat
- `author_signature` → `$authorSignature` / `getAuthorSignature()` / `setAuthorSignature()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Signature of the original post author

## PhotoSize

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\PhotoSize`

This object represents one size of a photo or a `Document` / `Sticker` thumbnail.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#photosize

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `file_id` → `$fileId` / `getFileId()` / `setFileId()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Identifier for this file, which can be used to download or reuse the file
- `file_unique_id` → `$fileUniqueId` / `getFileUniqueId()` / `setFileUniqueId()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Unique identifier for this file, which is supposed to be the same over time and for different bots. Can't be used to download or reuse the file.
- `width` → `$width` / `getWidth()` / `setWidth()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Photo width
- `height` → `$height` / `getHeight()` / `setHeight()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Photo height
- `file_size` → `$fileSize` / `getFileSize()` / `setFileSize()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. File size in bytes

## Animation

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\Animation`

This object represents an animation file (GIF or H.264/MPEG-4 AVC video without sound).

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#animation

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `file_id` → `$fileId` / `getFileId()` / `setFileId()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Identifier for this file, which can be used to download or reuse the file
- `file_unique_id` → `$fileUniqueId` / `getFileUniqueId()` / `setFileUniqueId()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Unique identifier for this file, which is supposed to be the same over time and for different bots. Can't be used to download or reuse the file.
- `width` → `$width` / `getWidth()` / `setWidth()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Video width as defined by the sender
- `height` → `$height` / `getHeight()` / `setHeight()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Video height as defined by the sender
- `duration` → `$duration` / `getDuration()` / `setDuration()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Duration of the video in seconds as defined by the sender
- `thumbnail` → `$thumbnail` / `getThumbnail()` / `setThumbnail()`: `Types\PhotoSize|null`; `Types\PhotoSize|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Animation thumbnail as defined by the sender
- `file_name` → `$fileName` / `getFileName()` / `setFileName()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Original animation filename as defined by the sender
- `mime_type` → `$mimeType` / `getMimeType()` / `setMimeType()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. MIME type of the file as defined by the sender
- `file_size` → `$fileSize` / `getFileSize()` / `setFileSize()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. File size in bytes. It can be bigger than 2^31 and some programming languages may have difficulty/silent defects in interpreting it. But it has at most 52 significant bits, so a signed 64-bit integer or double-precision float type are safe for storing this value.
