## Story

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\Story`

This object represents a story.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#story

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `chat` → `$chat` / `getChat()` / `setChat()`: `Types\Chat|null`; `Types\Chat|array<string, mixed>` — required. Chat that posted the story
- `id` → `$id` / `getId()` / `setId()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Unique identifier for the story in the chat

## VideoQuality

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\VideoQuality`

This object represents a video file of a specific quality.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#videoquality

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `file_id` → `$fileId` / `getFileId()` / `setFileId()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Identifier for this file, which can be used to download or reuse the file
- `file_unique_id` → `$fileUniqueId` / `getFileUniqueId()` / `setFileUniqueId()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Unique identifier for this file, which is supposed to be the same over time and for different bots. Can't be used to download or reuse the file.
- `width` → `$width` / `getWidth()` / `setWidth()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Video width
- `height` → `$height` / `getHeight()` / `setHeight()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Video height
- `codec` → `$codec` / `getCodec()` / `setCodec()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Codec that was used to encode the video, for example, “h264”, “h265”, or “av01”
- `file_size` → `$fileSize` / `getFileSize()` / `setFileSize()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. File size in bytes. It can be bigger than 2^31 and some programming languages may have difficulty/silent defects in interpreting it. But it has at most 52 significant bits, so a signed 64-bit integer or double-precision float type are safe for storing this value.

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\PollOption`

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):

## Poll

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\Poll`

This object contains information about a poll.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#poll

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `id` → `$id` / `getId()` / `setId()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Unique poll identifier
- `question` → `$question` / `getQuestion()` / `setQuestion()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Poll question, 1-300 characters
- `question_entities` → `$questionEntities` / `getQuestionEntities()` / `setQuestionEntities()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Types\MessageEntity>`; `list<Types\MessageEntity|array<string, mixed>>|Base\ArrayObject<Types\MessageEntity>` — optional. Special entities that appear in the *question*. Currently, only custom emoji entities are allowed in poll questions
- `options` → `$options` / `getOptions()` / `setOptions()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Types\PollOption>`; `list<Types\PollOption|array<string, mixed>>|Base\ArrayObject<Types\PollOption>` — required. List of poll options
- `total_voter_count` → `$totalVoterCount` / `getTotalVoterCount()` / `setTotalVoterCount()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Total number of users that voted in the poll
- `is_closed` → `$isClosed` / `getIsClosed()` / `setIsClosed()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. *True*, if the poll is closed
- `is_anonymous` → `$isAnonymous` / `getIsAnonymous()` / `setIsAnonymous()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. *True*, if the poll is anonymous
- `type` → `$type` / `getType()` / `setType()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Poll type, currently can be “regular” or “quiz”
- `allows_multiple_answers` → `$allowsMultipleAnswers` / `getAllowsMultipleAnswers()` / `setAllowsMultipleAnswers()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. *True*, if the poll allows multiple answers
- `allows_revoting` → `$allowsRevoting` / `getAllowsRevoting()` / `setAllowsRevoting()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. *True*, if the poll allows to change the chosen answer options
- `members_only` → `$membersOnly` / `getMembersOnly()` / `setMembersOnly()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. *True* if voting is limited to users who have been members of the chat where the poll was originally sent for more than 24 hours
- `country_codes` → `$countryCodes` / `getCountryCodes()` / `setCountryCodes()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Base\ParameterString>`; `list<string>|Base\ArrayObject<Base\ParameterString>` — optional. A list of two-letter [ISO 3166-1 alpha-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2) country codes indicating the countries from which users can vote in the poll. The country code “FT” is used for users with anonymous numbers. If omitted, then users from any country can participate in the poll.
- `correct_option_ids` → `$correctOptionIds` / `getCorrectOptionIds()` / `setCorrectOptionIds()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Base\ParameterInt>`; `list<int>|Base\ArrayObject<Base\ParameterInt>` — optional. Array of 0-based identifiers of the correct answer options. Available only for polls in quiz mode which are closed or were sent (not forwarded) by the bot or to the private chat with the bot.
- `explanation` → `$explanation` / `getExplanation()` / `setExplanation()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Text that is shown when a user chooses an incorrect answer or taps on the lamp icon in a quiz-style poll, 0-200 characters
- `explanation_entities` → `$explanationEntities` / `getExplanationEntities()` / `setExplanationEntities()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Types\MessageEntity>`; `list<Types\MessageEntity|array<string, mixed>>|Base\ArrayObject<Types\MessageEntity>` — optional. Special entities like usernames, URLs, bot commands, etc. that appear in the *explanation*
- `explanation_media` → `$explanationMedia` / `getExplanationMedia()` / `setExplanationMedia()`: `Types\PollMedia|null`; `Types\PollMedia|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Media added to the quiz explanation
- `open_period` → `$openPeriod` / `getOpenPeriod()` / `setOpenPeriod()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Amount of time in seconds the poll will be active after creation
- `close_date` → `$closeDate` / `getCloseDate()` / `setCloseDate()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Point in time (Unix timestamp) when the poll will be automatically closed
- `description` → `$description` / `getDescription()` / `setDescription()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Description of the poll; for polls inside the `Message` object only
- `description_entities` → `$descriptionEntities` / `getDescriptionEntities()` / `setDescriptionEntities()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Types\MessageEntity>`; `list<Types\MessageEntity|array<string, mixed>>|Base\ArrayObject<Types\MessageEntity>` — optional. Special entities like usernames, URLs, bot commands, etc. that appear in the description
- `media` → `$media` / `getMedia()` / `setMedia()`: `Types\PollMedia|null`; `Types\PollMedia|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Media added to the poll description; for polls inside the `Message` object only

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#checklisttask

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `id` → `$id` / `getId()` / `setId()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Unique identifier of the task
- `text` → `$text` / `getText()` / `setText()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Text of the task
- `text_entities` → `$textEntities` / `getTextEntities()` / `setTextEntities()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Types\MessageEntity>`; `list<Types\MessageEntity|array<string, mixed>>|Base\ArrayObject<Types\MessageEntity>` — optional. Special entities that appear in the task text
- `completed_by_user` → `$completedByUser` / `getCompletedByUser()` / `setCompletedByUser()`: `Types\User|null`; `Types\User|array<string, mixed>` — optional. User that completed the task; omitted if the task wasn't completed by a user
- `completed_by_chat` → `$completedByChat` / `getCompletedByChat()` / `setCompletedByChat()`: `Types\Chat|null`; `Types\Chat|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Chat that completed the task; omitted if the task wasn't completed by a chat
- `completion_date` → `$completionDate` / `getCompletionDate()` / `setCompletionDate()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Point in time (Unix timestamp) when the task was completed; 0 if the task wasn't completed

## InputChecklistTask

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\InputChecklistTask`

Describes a task to add to a checklist.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputchecklisttask

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `id` → `$id` / `getId()` / `setId()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Unique identifier of the task; must be positive and unique among all task identifiers currently present in the checklist
- `text` → `$text` / `getText()` / `setText()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Text of the task; 1-100 characters after entities parsing
- `parse_mode` → `$parseMode` / `getParseMode()` / `setParseMode()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Mode for parsing entities in the text. See [formatting options](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#formatting-options) for more details.
- `text_entities` → `$textEntities` / `getTextEntities()` / `setTextEntities()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Types\MessageEntity>`; `list<Types\MessageEntity|array<string, mixed>>|Base\ArrayObject<Types\MessageEntity>` — optional. List of special entities that appear in the text, which can be specified instead of parse_mode. Currently, only *bold*, *italic*, *underline*, *strikethrough*, *spoiler*, *custom_emoji*, and *date_time* entities are allowed.

## Location

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\Location`

This object represents a point on the map.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#location

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `latitude` → `$latitude` / `getLatitude()` / `setLatitude()`: `float|null`; `float|int` — required. Latitude as defined by the sender
- `longitude` → `$longitude` / `getLongitude()` / `setLongitude()`: `float|null`; `float|int` — required. Longitude as defined by the sender
- `horizontal_accuracy` → `$horizontalAccuracy` / `getHorizontalAccuracy()` / `setHorizontalAccuracy()`: `float|null`; `float|int` — optional. The radius of uncertainty for the location, measured in meters; 0-1500
- `live_period` → `$livePeriod` / `getLivePeriod()` / `setLivePeriod()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Time relative to the message sending date, during which the location can be updated; in seconds. For active live locations only.
- `heading` → `$heading` / `getHeading()` / `setHeading()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. The direction in which user is moving, in degrees; 1-360. For active live locations only.
- `proximity_alert_radius` → `$proximityAlertRadius` / `getProximityAlertRadius()` / `setProximityAlertRadius()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. The maximum distance for proximity alerts about approaching another chat member, in meters. For sent live locations only.

## BackgroundFill

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\BackgroundFill`

This object describes the way a background is filled based on the selected colors. Currently, it can be one of

- `BackgroundFillSolid`
- `BackgroundFillGradient`
- `BackgroundFillFreeformGradient`

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#backgroundfill
- Union: `BackgroundFill::create($data)` returns one of: `BackgroundFillSolid`, `BackgroundFillGradient`, `BackgroundFillFreeformGradient`

## BackgroundFillSolid

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\BackgroundFillSolid` — variant of `BackgroundFill`

The background is filled using the selected color.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#backgroundfillsolid

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `type` → `$type` / `getType()` / `setType()`: `string|null`; `string` — required, always `'solid'`. Type of the background fill, always “solid”
- `color` → `$color` / `getColor()` / `setColor()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. The color of the background fill in the RGB24 format

## BackgroundFillGradient

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\BackgroundFillGradient` — variant of `BackgroundFill`

The background is a gradient fill.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#backgroundfillgradient

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `type` → `$type` / `getType()` / `setType()`: `string|null`; `string` — required, always `'gradient'`. Type of the background fill, always “gradient”
- `top_color` → `$topColor` / `getTopColor()` / `setTopColor()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Top color of the gradient in the RGB24 format
- `bottom_color` → `$bottomColor` / `getBottomColor()` / `setBottomColor()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Bottom color of the gradient in the RGB24 format
- `rotation_angle` → `$rotationAngle` / `getRotationAngle()` / `setRotationAngle()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Clockwise rotation angle of the background fill in degrees; 0-359

## BackgroundFillFreeformGradient

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\BackgroundFillFreeformGradient` — variant of `BackgroundFill`

The background is a freeform gradient that rotates after every message in the chat.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#backgroundfillfreeformgradient

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `type` → `$type` / `getType()` / `setType()`: `string|null`; `string` — required, always `'freeform_gradient'`. Type of the background fill, always “freeform_gradient”
- `colors` → `$colors` / `getColors()` / `setColors()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Base\ParameterInt>`; `list<int>|Base\ArrayObject<Base\ParameterInt>` — required. A list of the 3 or 4 base colors that are used to generate the freeform gradient in the RGB24 format

## BackgroundType

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\BackgroundType`

This object describes the type of a background. Currently, it can be one of

- `BackgroundTypeFill`
- `BackgroundTypeWallpaper`
- `BackgroundTypePattern`
- `BackgroundTypeChatTheme`

## BackgroundTypeWallpaper

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\BackgroundTypeWallpaper` — variant of `BackgroundType`

The background is a wallpaper in the JPEG format.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#backgroundtypewallpaper

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `type` → `$type` / `getType()` / `setType()`: `string|null`; `string` — required, always `'wallpaper'`. Type of the background, always “wallpaper”
- `document` → `$document` / `getDocument()` / `setDocument()`: `Types\Document|null`; `Types\Document|array<string, mixed>` — required. Document with the wallpaper
- `dark_theme_dimming` → `$darkThemeDimming` / `getDarkThemeDimming()` / `setDarkThemeDimming()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Dimming of the background in dark themes, as a percentage; 0-100
- `is_blurred` → `$isBlurred` / `getIsBlurred()` / `setIsBlurred()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the wallpaper is downscaled to fit in a 450x450 square and then box-blurred with radius 12
- `is_moving` → `$isMoving` / `getIsMoving()` / `setIsMoving()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the background moves slightly when the device is tilted

## BackgroundTypePattern

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\BackgroundTypePattern` — variant of `BackgroundType`

The background is a .PNG or .TGV (gzipped subset of SVG with MIME type “application/x-tgwallpattern”) pattern to be combined with the background fill chosen by the user.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#backgroundtypepattern

- `fill` → `$fill` / `getFill()` / `setFill()`: `Types\BackgroundFill|null`; `Types\BackgroundFill|array<string, mixed>` — required. The background fill that is combined with the pattern
- `intensity` → `$intensity` / `getIntensity()` / `setIntensity()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Intensity of the pattern when it is shown above the filled background; 0-100
- `is_inverted` → `$isInverted` / `getIsInverted()` / `setIsInverted()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the background fill must be applied only to the pattern itself. All other pixels are black in this case. For dark themes only.
- `is_moving` → `$isMoving` / `getIsMoving()` / `setIsMoving()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the background moves slightly when the device is tilted

## SharedUser

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\SharedUser`

This object contains information about a user that was shared with the bot using a `KeyboardButtonRequestUsers` button.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#shareduser

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `user_id` → `$userId` / `getUserId()` / `setUserId()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Identifier of the shared user. This number may have more than 32 significant bits and some programming languages may have difficulty/silent defects in interpreting it. But it has at most 52 significant bits, so 64-bit integers or double-precision float types are safe for storing these identifiers. The bot may not have access to the user and could be unable to use this identifier, unless the user is already known to the bot by some other means.
- `first_name` → `$firstName` / `getFirstName()` / `setFirstName()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. First name of the user, if the name was requested by the bot
- `last_name` → `$lastName` / `getLastName()` / `setLastName()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Last name of the user, if the name was requested by the bot
- `username` → `$username` / `getUsername()` / `setUsername()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Username of the user, if the username was requested by the bot
- `photo` → `$photo` / `getPhoto()` / `setPhoto()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Types\PhotoSize>`; `list<Types\PhotoSize|array<string, mixed>>|Base\ArrayObject<Types\PhotoSize>` — optional. Available sizes of the chat photo, if the photo was requested by the bot

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#chatshared

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):

This number may have more than 32 significant bits and some programming languages may have difficulty/silent defects in interpreting it. But it has at most 52 significant bits, so a 64-bit integer or double-precision float type are safe for storing this identifier. The bot may not have access to the chat and could be unable to use this identifier, unless the chat is already known to the bot by some other means.

## Giveaway

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\Giveaway`

This object represents a message about a scheduled giveaway.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#giveaway

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `chats` → `$chats` / `getChats()` / `setChats()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Types\Chat>`; `list<Types\Chat|array<string, mixed>>|Base\ArrayObject<Types\Chat>` — required. The list of chats which the user must join to participate in the giveaway
- `winners_selection_date` → `$winnersSelectionDate` / `getWinnersSelectionDate()` / `setWinnersSelectionDate()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Point in time (Unix timestamp) when winners of the giveaway will be selected
- `winner_count` → `$winnerCount` / `getWinnerCount()` / `setWinnerCount()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. The number of users which are supposed to be selected as winners of the giveaway
- `only_new_members` → `$onlyNewMembers` / `getOnlyNewMembers()` / `setOnlyNewMembers()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if only users who join the chats after the giveaway started should be eligible to win
- `has_public_winners` → `$hasPublicWinners` / `getHasPublicWinners()` / `setHasPublicWinners()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the list of giveaway winners will be visible to everyone
- `prize_description` → `$prizeDescription` / `getPrizeDescription()` / `setPrizeDescription()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Description of additional giveaway prize
- `country_codes` → `$countryCodes` / `getCountryCodes()` / `setCountryCodes()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Base\ParameterString>`; `list<string>|Base\ArrayObject<Base\ParameterString>` — optional. A list of two-letter [ISO 3166-1 alpha-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2) country codes indicating the countries from which eligible users for the giveaway must come. If empty, then all users can participate in the giveaway. Users with a phone number that was bought on Fragment can always participate in giveaways.
- `prize_star_count` → `$prizeStarCount` / `getPrizeStarCount()` / `setPrizeStarCount()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. The number of Telegram Stars to be split between giveaway winners; for Telegram Star giveaways only
- `premium_subscription_month_count` → `$premiumSubscriptionMonthCount` / `getPremiumSubscriptionMonthCount()` / `setPremiumSubscriptionMonthCount()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. The number of months the Telegram Premium subscription won from the giveaway will be active for; for Telegram Premium giveaways only

## SuggestedPostPrice

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\SuggestedPostPrice`

Describes the price of a suggested post.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#suggestedpostprice

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `currency` → `$currency` / `getCurrency()` / `setCurrency()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Currency in which the post will be paid. Currently, must be one of “XTR” for Telegram Stars or “TON” for TON grams.
- `amount` → `$amount` / `getAmount()` / `setAmount()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. The amount of the currency that will be paid for the post in the *smallest units* of the currency, i.e. Telegram Stars or nanograms. Currently, price in Telegram Stars must be between 5 and 100000, and price in nanograms must be between 10000000 and 10000000000000.

## SuggestedPostInfo

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\SuggestedPostInfo`

Contains information about a suggested post.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#suggestedpostinfo

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `state` → `$state` / `getState()` / `setState()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. State of the suggested post. Currently, it can be one of “pending”, “approved”, “declined”.
- `price` → `$price` / `getPrice()` / `setPrice()`: `Types\SuggestedPostPrice|null`; `Types\SuggestedPostPrice|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Proposed price of the post. If the field is omitted, then the post is unpaid.
- `send_date` → `$sendDate` / `getSendDate()` / `setSendDate()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Proposed send date of the post. If the field is omitted, then the post can be published at any time within 30 days at the sole discretion of the user or administrator who approves it.

## SuggestedPostParameters

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\SuggestedPostParameters`

Contains parameters of a post that is being suggested by the bot.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#suggestedpostparameters

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `price` → `$price` / `getPrice()` / `setPrice()`: `Types\SuggestedPostPrice|null`; `Types\SuggestedPostPrice|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Proposed price for the post. If the field is omitted, then the post is unpaid.
- `send_date` → `$sendDate` / `getSendDate()` / `setSendDate()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Proposed send date of the post. If specified, then the date must be between 300 second and 2678400 seconds (30 days) in the future. If the field is omitted, then the post can be published at any time within 30 days at the sole discretion of the user who approves it.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#directmessagestopic

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `topic_id` → `$topicId` / `getTopicId()` / `setTopicId()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Unique identifier of the topic. This number may have more than 32 significant bits and some programming languages may have difficulty/silent defects in interpreting it. But it has at most 52 significant bits, so a 64-bit integer or double-precision float type are safe for storing this identifier.
- `user` → `$user` / `getUser()` / `setUser()`: `Types\User|null`; `Types\User|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Information about the user that created the topic. Currently, it is always present.

## UserProfilePhotos

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\UserProfilePhotos`

This object represent a user's profile pictures.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#userprofilephotos

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `total_count` → `$totalCount` / `getTotalCount()` / `setTotalCount()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Total number of profile pictures the target user has
- `photos` → `$photos` / `getPhotos()` / `setPhotos()`: `Base\ArrayOfArrayObject<Types\PhotoSize>`; `list<list<Types\PhotoSize|array<string, mixed>>>|Base\ArrayOfArrayObject<Types\PhotoSize>` — required. Requested profile pictures (in up to 4 sizes each)

## UserProfileAudios

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\UserProfileAudios`

This object represents the audios displayed on a user's profile.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#userprofileaudios

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `total_count` → `$totalCount` / `getTotalCount()` / `setTotalCount()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Total number of profile audios for the target user
- `audios` → `$audios` / `getAudios()` / `setAudios()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Types\Audio>`; `list<Types\Audio|array<string, mixed>>|Base\ArrayObject<Types\Audio>` — required. Requested profile audios

## File

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\File`

This object represents a file ready to be downloaded. The file can be downloaded via the link `https://api.telegram.org/file/bot<token>/<file_path>`. It is guaranteed that the link will be valid for at least 1 hour. When the link expires, a new one can be requested by calling `getFile`.

The maximum file size to download is 20 MB

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#file

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `file_id` → `$fileId` / `getFileId()` / `setFileId()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Identifier for this file, which can be used to download or reuse the file
- `file_unique_id` → `$fileUniqueId` / `getFileUniqueId()` / `setFileUniqueId()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Unique identifier for this file, which is supposed to be the same over time and for different bots. Can't be used to download or reuse the file.
- `file_size` → `$fileSize` / `getFileSize()` / `setFileSize()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. File size in bytes. It can be bigger than 2^31 and some programming languages may have difficulty/silent defects in interpreting it. But it has at most 52 significant bits, so a signed 64-bit integer or double-precision float type are safe for storing this value.
- `file_path` → `$filePath` / `getFilePath()` / `setFilePath()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. File path. Use `https://api.telegram.org/file/bot<token>/<file_path>` to get the file.

## WebAppInfo

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\WebAppInfo`

Describes a [Web App](https://core.telegram.org/bots/webapps).

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#webappinfo

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `url` → `$url` / `getUrl()` / `setUrl()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. An HTTPS URL of a Web App to be opened with additional data as specified in [Initializing Web Apps](https://core.telegram.org/bots/webapps#initializing-mini-apps)

## ReplyKeyboardMarkup

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\ReplyKeyboardMarkup`

This object represents a [custom keyboard](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#keyboards) with reply options (see [Introduction to bots](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#keyboards) for details and examples). Not supported in channels and for messages sent on behalf of a business account.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#replykeyboardmarkup

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `keyboard` → `$keyboard` / `getKeyboard()` / `setKeyboard()`: `Base\ArrayOfArrayObject<Types\KeyboardButton>`; `list<list<Types\KeyboardButton|array<string, mixed>>>|Base\ArrayOfArrayObject<Types\KeyboardButton>` — required. Array of button rows, each represented by an Array of `KeyboardButton` objects
- `is_persistent` → `$isPersistent` / `getIsPersistent()` / `setIsPersistent()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Requests clients to always show the keyboard when the regular keyboard is hidden. Defaults to *False*, in which case the custom keyboard can be hidden and opened with a keyboard icon.
- `resize_keyboard` → `$resizeKeyboard` / `getResizeKeyboard()` / `setResizeKeyboard()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Requests clients to resize the keyboard vertically for optimal fit (e.g., make the keyboard smaller if there are just two rows of buttons). Defaults to *False*, in which case the custom keyboard is always of the same height as the app's standard keyboard.
- `one_time_keyboard` → `$oneTimeKeyboard` / `getOneTimeKeyboard()` / `setOneTimeKeyboard()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Requests clients to hide the keyboard as soon as it's been used. The keyboard will still be available, but clients will automatically display the usual letter-keyboard in the chat - the user can press a special button in the input field to see the custom keyboard again. Defaults to *False*.
- `input_field_placeholder` → `$inputFieldPlaceholder` / `getInputFieldPlaceholder()` / `setInputFieldPlaceholder()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. The placeholder to be shown in the input field when the keyboard is active; 1-64 characters
- `selective` → `$selective` / `getSelective()` / `setSelective()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Use this parameter if you want to show the keyboard to specific users only. Targets: 1) users that are @mentioned in the *text* of the `Message` object; 2) if the bot's message is a reply to a message in the same chat and forum topic, sender of the original message. *Example:* A user requests to change the bot's language, bot replies to the request with a keyboard to select the new language. Other users in the group don't see the keyboard.
- `force_reply` → `$forceReply` / `getForceReply()` / `setForceReply()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Pass *True* if the reply interface must be shown to the user, as if they had manually selected the bot's message and tapped 'Reply'

## KeyboardButton

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\KeyboardButton`

This object represents one button of the reply keyboard. At most one of the fields other than *text*, *icon_custom_emoji_id*, and *style* must be used to specify the type of the button. For simple text buttons, *String* can be used instead of this object to specify the button text.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#keyboardbutton

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `text` → `$text` / `getText()` / `setText()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Text of the button. If none of the fields other than *text*, *icon_custom_emoji_id*, and *style* are used, it will be sent as a message when the button is pressed.
- `icon_custom_emoji_id` → `$iconCustomEmojiId` / `getIconCustomEmojiId()` / `setIconCustomEmojiId()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Unique identifier of the custom emoji shown before the text of the button. Can only be used by bots that purchased additional usernames on [Fragment](https://fragment.com) or in the messages directly sent by the bot to private, group and supergroup chats if the owner of the bot has a Telegram Premium subscription.
- `style` → `$style` / `getStyle()` / `setStyle()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Style of the button. Must be one of “danger” (red), “success” (green) or “primary” (blue). If omitted, then an app-specific style is used.
- `request_users` → `$requestUsers` / `getRequestUsers()` / `setRequestUsers()`: `Types\KeyboardButtonRequestUsers|null`; `Types\KeyboardButtonRequestUsers|array<string, mixed>` — optional. If specified, pressing the button will open a list of suitable users. Identifiers of selected users will be sent to the bot in a “users_shared” service message. Available in private chats only.
- `request_chat` → `$requestChat` / `getRequestChat()` / `setRequestChat()`: `Types\KeyboardButtonRequestChat|null`; `Types\KeyboardButtonRequestChat|array<string, mixed>` — optional. If specified, pressing the button will open a list of suitable chats. Tapping on a chat will send its identifier to the bot in a “chat_shared” service message. Available in private chats only.
- `request_managed_bot` → `$requestManagedBot` / `getRequestManagedBot()` / `setRequestManagedBot()`: `Types\KeyboardButtonRequestManagedBot|null`; `Types\KeyboardButtonRequestManagedBot|array<string, mixed>` — optional. If specified, pressing the button will ask the user to create and share a bot that will be managed by the current bot. Available for bots that enabled management of other bots in the [@BotFather](https://t.me/BotFather) Mini App. Available in private chats only.
- `request_contact` → `$requestContact` / `getRequestContact()` / `setRequestContact()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. If *True*, the user's phone number will be sent as a contact when the button is pressed. Available in private chats only.
- `request_location` → `$requestLocation` / `getRequestLocation()` / `setRequestLocation()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. If *True*, the user's current location will be sent when the button is pressed. Available in private chats only.
- `request_poll` → `$requestPoll` / `getRequestPoll()` / `setRequestPoll()`: `Types\KeyboardButtonPollType|null`; `Types\KeyboardButtonPollType|array<string, mixed>` — optional. If specified, the user will be asked to create a poll and send it to the bot when the button is pressed. Available in private chats only.
- `web_app` → `$webApp` / `getWebApp()` / `setWebApp()`: `Types\WebAppInfo|null`; `Types\WebAppInfo|array<string, mixed>` — optional. If specified, the described [Web App](https://core.telegram.org/bots/webapps) will be launched when the button is pressed. The Web App will be able to send a “web_app_data” service message. Available in private chats only.

## KeyboardButtonRequestUsers

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\KeyboardButtonRequestUsers`

This object defines the criteria used to request suitable users. Information about the selected users will be shared with the bot when the corresponding button is pressed. [More about requesting users »](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#chat-and-user-selection)

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#keyboardbuttonrequestusers

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `request_id` → `$requestId` / `getRequestId()` / `setRequestId()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Signed 32-bit identifier of the request that will be received back in the `UsersShared` object. Must be unique within the message.
- `user_is_bot` → `$userIsBot` / `getUserIsBot()` / `setUserIsBot()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Pass *True* to request bots, pass *False* to request regular users. If not specified, no additional restrictions are applied.
- `user_is_premium` → `$userIsPremium` / `getUserIsPremium()` / `setUserIsPremium()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Pass *True* to request premium users, pass *False* to request non-premium users. If not specified, no additional restrictions are applied.
- `max_quantity` → `$maxQuantity` / `getMaxQuantity()` / `setMaxQuantity()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. The maximum number of users to be selected; 1-10. Defaults to 1.
- `request_name` → `$requestName` / `getRequestName()` / `setRequestName()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Pass *True* to request the users' first and last names
- `request_username` → `$requestUsername` / `getRequestUsername()` / `setRequestUsername()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Pass *True* to request the users' usernames
- `request_photo` → `$requestPhoto` / `getRequestPhoto()` / `setRequestPhoto()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Pass *True* to request the users' photos

## KeyboardButtonRequestChat

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\KeyboardButtonRequestChat`

This object defines the criteria used to request a suitable chat. Information about the selected chat will be shared with the bot when the corresponding button is pressed. The bot will be granted requested rights in the chat if appropriate. [More about requesting chats »](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#chat-and-user-selection).

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#keyboardbuttonrequestchat

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `request_id` → `$requestId` / `getRequestId()` / `setRequestId()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Signed 32-bit identifier of the request, which will be received back in the `ChatShared` object. Must be unique within the message.
- `chat_is_channel` → `$chatIsChannel` / `getChatIsChannel()` / `setChatIsChannel()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. Pass *True* to request a channel chat, pass *False* to request a group or a supergroup chat
- `chat_is_forum` → `$chatIsForum` / `getChatIsForum()` / `setChatIsForum()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Pass *True* to request a forum supergroup, pass *False* to request a non-forum chat. If not specified, no additional restrictions are applied.
- `chat_has_username` → `$chatHasUsername` / `getChatHasUsername()` / `setChatHasUsername()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Pass *True* to request a supergroup or a channel with a username, pass *False* to request a chat without a username. If not specified, no additional restrictions are applied.
- `chat_is_created` → `$chatIsCreated` / `getChatIsCreated()` / `setChatIsCreated()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Pass *True* to request a chat owned by the user. Otherwise, no additional restrictions are applied.
- `user_administrator_rights` → `$userAdministratorRights` / `getUserAdministratorRights()` / `setUserAdministratorRights()`: `Types\ChatAdministratorRights|null`; `Types\ChatAdministratorRights|array<string, mixed>` — optional. A JSON-serialized object listing the required administrator rights of the user in the chat. The rights must be a superset of *bot_administrator_rights*. If not specified, no additional restrictions are applied.
- `bot_administrator_rights` → `$botAdministratorRights` / `getBotAdministratorRights()` / `setBotAdministratorRights()`: `Types\ChatAdministratorRights|null`; `Types\ChatAdministratorRights|array<string, mixed>` — optional. A JSON-serialized object listing the required administrator rights of the bot in the chat. The rights must be a subset of *user_administrator_rights*. If not specified, no additional restrictions are applied.
- `bot_is_member` → `$botIsMember` / `getBotIsMember()` / `setBotIsMember()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Pass *True* to request a chat with the bot as a member. Otherwise, no additional restrictions are applied.
- `request_title` → `$requestTitle` / `getRequestTitle()` / `setRequestTitle()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Pass *True* to request the chat's title
- `request_username` → `$requestUsername` / `getRequestUsername()` / `setRequestUsername()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Pass *True* to request the chat's username
- `request_photo` → `$requestPhoto` / `getRequestPhoto()` / `setRequestPhoto()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Pass *True* to request the chat's photo

## KeyboardButtonRequestManagedBot

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\KeyboardButtonRequestManagedBot`

This object defines the parameters for the creation of a managed bot. Information about the created bot will be shared with the bot using the update *managed_bot* and a `Message` with the field *managed_bot_created*.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#keyboardbuttonrequestmanagedbot

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `request_id` → `$requestId` / `getRequestId()` / `setRequestId()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Signed 32-bit identifier of the request. Must be unique within the message.
- `suggested_name` → `$suggestedName` / `getSuggestedName()` / `setSuggestedName()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Suggested name for the bot
- `suggested_username` → `$suggestedUsername` / `getSuggestedUsername()` / `setSuggestedUsername()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Suggested username for the bot

## KeyboardButtonPollType

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\KeyboardButtonPollType`

This object represents type of a poll, which is allowed to be created and sent when the corresponding button is pressed.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#keyboardbuttonpolltype

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `type` → `$type` / `getType()` / `setType()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. If *quiz* is passed, the user will be allowed to create only polls in the quiz mode. If *regular* is passed, only regular polls will be allowed. Otherwise, the user will be allowed to create a poll of any type.

## ReplyKeyboardRemove

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\ReplyKeyboardRemove`

Upon receiving a message with this object, Telegram clients will remove the current custom keyboard and display the default letter-keyboard. By default, custom keyboards are displayed until a new keyboard is sent by a bot. An exception is made for one-time keyboards that are hidden immediately after the user presses a button (see `ReplyKeyboardMarkup`). Not supported in channels and for messages sent on behalf of a business account.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#replykeyboardremove

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `remove_keyboard` → `$removeKeyboard` / `getRemoveKeyboard()` / `setRemoveKeyboard()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. Requests clients to remove the custom keyboard (user will not be able to summon this keyboard; if you want to hide the keyboard from sight but keep it accessible, use *one_time_keyboard* in `ReplyKeyboardMarkup`)
- `selective` → `$selective` / `getSelective()` / `setSelective()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Use this parameter if you want to remove the keyboard for specific users only. Targets: 1) users that are @mentioned in the *text* of the `Message` object; 2) if the bot's message is a reply to a message in the same chat and forum topic, sender of the original message. *Example:* A user votes in a poll, bot returns confirmation message in reply to the vote and removes the keyboard for that user, while still showing the keyboard with poll options to users who haven't voted yet.

## InlineKeyboardMarkup

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\InlineKeyboardMarkup`

This object represents an [inline keyboard](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#inline-keyboards) that appears right next to the message it belongs to.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inlinekeyboardmarkup

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `inline_keyboard` → `$inlineKeyboard` / `getInlineKeyboard()` / `setInlineKeyboard()`: `Base\ArrayOfArrayObject<Types\InlineKeyboardButton>`; `list<list<Types\InlineKeyboardButton|array<string, mixed>>>|Base\ArrayOfArrayObject<Types\InlineKeyboardButton>` — required. Array of button rows, each represented by an Array of `InlineKeyboardButton` objects
- `force_reply` → `$forceReply` / `getForceReply()` / `setForceReply()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Pass *True* if the reply interface must be shown to the user, as if they had manually selected the bot's message and tapped 'Reply'. The value of the field can't be changed when the inline keyboard is edited.

## InlineKeyboardButton

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\InlineKeyboardButton`

This object represents one button of an inline keyboard. Exactly one of the fields other than *text*, *icon_custom_emoji_id*, and *style* must be used to specify the type of the button.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inlinekeyboardbutton

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `text` → `$text` / `getText()` / `setText()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Label text on the button
- `icon_custom_emoji_id` → `$iconCustomEmojiId` / `getIconCustomEmojiId()` / `setIconCustomEmojiId()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Unique identifier of the custom emoji shown before the text of the button. Can only be used by bots that purchased additional usernames on [Fragment](https://fragment.com) or in the messages directly sent by the bot to private, group and supergroup chats if the owner of the bot has a Telegram Premium subscription.
- `style` → `$style` / `getStyle()` / `setStyle()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Style of the button. Must be one of “danger” (red), “success” (green) or “primary” (blue). If omitted, then an app-specific style is used.
- `url` → `$url` / `getUrl()` / `setUrl()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. HTTP or tg:// URL to be opened when the button is pressed. Links `tg://user?id=<user_id>` can be used to mention a user by their identifier without using a username, if this is allowed by their privacy settings.
- `callback_data` → `$callbackData` / `getCallbackData()` / `setCallbackData()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Data to be sent in a `CallbackQuery` to the bot when the button is pressed, 1-64 bytes
- `web_app` → `$webApp` / `getWebApp()` / `setWebApp()`: `Types\WebAppInfo|null`; `Types\WebAppInfo|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Description of the [Web App](https://core.telegram.org/bots/webapps) that will be launched when the user presses the button. The Web App will be able to send an arbitrary message on behalf of the user using the method `answerWebAppQuery`. Available only in private chats between a user and the bot. Not supported for messages sent on behalf of a business account.
- `login_url` → `$loginUrl` / `getLoginUrl()` / `setLoginUrl()`: `Types\LoginUrl|null`; `Types\LoginUrl|array<string, mixed>` — optional. An HTTPS URL used to automatically authorize the user. Can be used as a replacement for the [Telegram Login Widget](https://core.telegram.org/widgets/login). Not supported for ephemeral messages.
- `switch_inline_query` → `$switchInlineQuery` / `getSwitchInlineQuery()` / `setSwitchInlineQuery()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. If set, pressing the button will prompt the user to select one of their chats, open that chat and insert the bot's username and the specified inline query in the input field. May be empty, in which case just the bot's username will be inserted. Not supported for messages sent in channel direct messages chats and on behalf of a business account.
- `switch_inline_query_current_chat` → `$switchInlineQueryCurrentChat` / `getSwitchInlineQueryCurrentChat()` / `setSwitchInlineQueryCurrentChat()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. If set, pressing the button will insert the bot's username and the specified inline query in the current chat's input field. May be empty, in which case only the bot's username will be inserted. This offers a quick way for the user to open your bot in inline mode in the same chat - good for selecting something from multiple options. Not supported in channels and for messages sent in channel direct messages chats and on behalf of a business account.
- `switch_inline_query_chosen_chat` → `$switchInlineQueryChosenChat` / `getSwitchInlineQueryChosenChat()` / `setSwitchInlineQueryChosenChat()`: `Types\SwitchInlineQueryChosenChat|null`; `Types\SwitchInlineQueryChosenChat|array<string, mixed>` — optional. If set, pressing the button will prompt the user to select one of their chats of the specified type, open that chat and insert the bot's username and the specified inline query in the input field. Not supported for messages sent in channel direct messages chats and on behalf of a business account.
- `copy_text` → `$copyText` / `getCopyText()` / `setCopyText()`: `Types\CopyTextButton|null`; `Types\CopyTextButton|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Description of the button that copies the specified text to the clipboard
- `callback_game` → `$callbackGame` / `getCallbackGame()` / `setCallbackGame()`: `Games\CallbackGame|null`; `Games\CallbackGame|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Description of the game that will be launched when the user presses the button. **NOTE:** This type of button **must** always be the first button in the first row.
- `pay` → `$pay` / `getPay()` / `setPay()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Specify *True*, to send a [Pay button](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#payments). Substrings “⭐” and “XTR” in the buttons's text will be replaced with a Telegram Star icon. **NOTE:** This type of button **must** always be the first button in the first row and can only be used in invoice messages.
- `disabled` → `$disabled` / `getDisabled()` / `setDisabled()`: `Types\DisabledButton|null`; `Types\DisabledButton|array<string, mixed>` — optional. If set, then the button is disabled and does nothing

## LoginUrl

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\LoginUrl`

This object represents a parameter of the inline keyboard button used to automatically authorize a user. It serves as a great replacement for the [Telegram Login Widget](https://core.telegram.org/widgets/login) when the user is coming from Telegram. All the user needs to do is tap/click a button and confirm that they want to log in:

Sample bot: [@DiscussBot](https://t.me/discussbot)

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#loginurl

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `url` → `$url` / `getUrl()` / `setUrl()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. An HTTPS URL to be opened with user authorization data added to the query string when the button is pressed. If the user refuses to provide authorization data, the original URL without information about the user will be opened. The data added is the same as described in [Receiving authorization data](https://core.telegram.org/widgets/login#receiving-authorization-data). **NOTE:** You **must** always check the hash of the received data to verify the authentication and the integrity of the data as described in [Checking authorization](https://core.telegram.org/widgets/login#checking-authorization).
- `forward_text` → `$forwardText` / `getForwardText()` / `setForwardText()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. New text of the button in forwarded messages
- `bot_username` → `$botUsername` / `getBotUsername()` / `setBotUsername()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Username of a bot, which will be used for user authorization; not supported in `RichMessageButton`. See [Setting up a bot](https://core.telegram.org/widgets/login#setting-up-a-bot) for more details. If not specified, the current bot's username will be assumed. The *url*'s domain must be the same as the domain linked with the bot. See [Linking your domain to the bot](https://core.telegram.org/widgets/login#linking-your-domain-to-the-bot) for more details.
- `request_write_access` → `$requestWriteAccess` / `getRequestWriteAccess()` / `setRequestWriteAccess()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Pass *True* to request the permission for your bot to send messages to the user

## SwitchInlineQueryChosenChat

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\SwitchInlineQueryChosenChat`

This object represents an inline button that switches the current user to inline mode in a chosen chat, with an optional default inline query.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#switchinlinequerychosenchat

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `query` → `$query` / `getQuery()` / `setQuery()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. The default inline query to be inserted in the input field. If left empty, only the bot's username will be inserted.
- `allow_user_chats` → `$allowUserChats` / `getAllowUserChats()` / `setAllowUserChats()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if private chats with users can be chosen
- `allow_bot_chats` → `$allowBotChats` / `getAllowBotChats()` / `setAllowBotChats()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if private chats with bots can be chosen
- `allow_group_chats` → `$allowGroupChats` / `getAllowGroupChats()` / `setAllowGroupChats()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if group and supergroup chats can be chosen
- `allow_channel_chats` → `$allowChannelChats` / `getAllowChannelChats()` / `setAllowChannelChats()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if channel chats can be chosen

## CopyTextButton

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\CopyTextButton`

This object represents an inline keyboard button that copies specified text to the clipboard.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#copytextbutton

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `text` → `$text` / `getText()` / `setText()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. The text to be copied to the clipboard; 1-256 characters

## DisabledButton

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\DisabledButton`

This object represents a disabled button which does nothing. Currently holds no information.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#disabledbutton

## CallbackQuery

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\CallbackQuery`

This object represents an incoming callback query from a callback button in an [inline keyboard](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#inline-keyboards). If the button that originated the query was attached to a message sent by the bot, the field *message* will be present. If the button was attached to a message sent via the bot (in [inline mode](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inline-mode)), the field *inline_message_id* will be present. Exactly one of the fields *data* or *game_short_name* will be present.

**NOTE:** After the user presses a callback button, Telegram clients will display a progress bar until you call `answerCallbackQuery`. It is, therefore, necessary to react by calling `answerCallbackQuery` even if no notification to the user is needed (e.g., without specifying any of the optional parameters).

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#callbackquery

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `id` → `$id` / `getId()` / `setId()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Unique identifier for this query
- `from` → `$from` / `getFrom()` / `setFrom()`: `Types\User|null`; `Types\User|array<string, mixed>` — required. Sender
- `message` → `$message` / `getMessage()` / `setMessage()`: `Types\MaybeInaccessibleMessage|null`; `Types\MaybeInaccessibleMessage|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Message sent by the bot with the callback button that originated the query
- `inline_message_id` → `$inlineMessageId` / `getInlineMessageId()` / `setInlineMessageId()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Identifier of the message sent via the bot in inline mode, that originated the query
- `chat_instance` → `$chatInstance` / `getChatInstance()` / `setChatInstance()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Global identifier, uniquely corresponding to the chat to which the message with the callback button was sent. Useful for high scores in [games](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#games).
- `data` → `$data` / `getData()` / `setData()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Data associated with the callback button. Be aware that the message originated the query can contain no callback buttons with this data.
- `game_short_name` → `$gameShortName` / `getGameShortName()` / `setGameShortName()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Short name of a `Game` to be returned, serves as the unique identifier for the game

## ForceReply

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\ForceReply`

Upon receiving a message with this object, Telegram clients will display a reply interface to the user (act as if the user has selected the bot's message and tapped 'Reply'). This can be extremely useful if you want to create user-friendly step-by-step interfaces without having to sacrifice [privacy mode](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#privacy-mode). Not supported in channels and for messages sent on behalf of a user account.

**Example:** A [poll bot](https://t.me/PollBot) for groups runs in privacy mode (only receives commands, replies to its messages and mentions). There could be two ways to create a new poll:

The last option is definitely more attractive. And if you use `ForceReply` in your bot's questions, it will receive the user's answers even if it only receives replies, commands and mentions - without any extra work for the user.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#forcereply

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `force_reply` → `$forceReply` / `getForceReply()` / `setForceReply()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. Shows reply interface to the user, as if they had manually selected the bot's message and tapped 'Reply'
- `input_field_placeholder` → `$inputFieldPlaceholder` / `getInputFieldPlaceholder()` / `setInputFieldPlaceholder()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. The placeholder to be shown in the input field when the reply is active; 1-64 characters
- `selective` → `$selective` / `getSelective()` / `setSelective()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Use this parameter if you want to force reply from specific users only. Targets: 1) users that are @mentioned in the *text* of the `Message` object; 2) if the bot's message is a reply to a message in the same chat and forum topic, sender of the original message.

## Community

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\Community`

Represents a community (a group of chats).

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#community

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `id` → `$id` / `getId()` / `setId()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Unique identifier for this community. This number may have more than 32 significant bits and some programming languages may have difficulty/silent defects in interpreting it. But it has at most 52 significant bits, so a signed 64-bit integer or double-precision float type are safe for storing this identifier.
- `name` → `$name` / `getName()` / `setName()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Name of the community

## ChatPhoto

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\ChatPhoto`

This object represents a chat photo.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#chatphoto

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `small_file_id` → `$smallFileId` / `getSmallFileId()` / `setSmallFileId()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. File identifier of small (160x160) chat photo. This file_id can be used only for photo download and only for as long as the photo is not changed.
- `small_file_unique_id` → `$smallFileUniqueId` / `getSmallFileUniqueId()` / `setSmallFileUniqueId()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Unique file identifier of small (160x160) chat photo, which is supposed to be the same over time and for different bots. Can't be used to download or reuse the file.
- `big_file_id` → `$bigFileId` / `getBigFileId()` / `setBigFileId()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. File identifier of big (640x640) chat photo. This file_id can be used only for photo download and only for as long as the photo is not changed.
- `big_file_unique_id` → `$bigFileUniqueId` / `getBigFileUniqueId()` / `setBigFileUniqueId()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Unique file identifier of big (640x640) chat photo, which is supposed to be the same over time and for different bots. Can't be used to download or reuse the file.

## ChatInviteLink

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\ChatInviteLink`

Represents an invite link for a chat.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#chatinvitelink

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `invite_link` → `$inviteLink` / `getInviteLink()` / `setInviteLink()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. The invite link. If the link was created by another chat administrator, then the second part of the link will be replaced with “…”.
- `creator` → `$creator` / `getCreator()` / `setCreator()`: `Types\User|null`; `Types\User|array<string, mixed>` — required. Creator of the link
- `creates_join_request` → `$createsJoinRequest` / `getCreatesJoinRequest()` / `setCreatesJoinRequest()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. *True*, if users joining the chat via the link need to be approved by chat administrators
- `is_primary` → `$isPrimary` / `getIsPrimary()` / `setIsPrimary()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. *True*, if the link is primary
- `is_revoked` → `$isRevoked` / `getIsRevoked()` / `setIsRevoked()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. *True*, if the link is revoked
- `name` → `$name` / `getName()` / `setName()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Invite link name
- `expire_date` → `$expireDate` / `getExpireDate()` / `setExpireDate()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Point in time (Unix timestamp) when the link will expire or has been expired
- `member_limit` → `$memberLimit` / `getMemberLimit()` / `setMemberLimit()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. The maximum number of users that can be members of the chat simultaneously after joining the chat via this invite link; 1-99999
- `pending_join_request_count` → `$pendingJoinRequestCount` / `getPendingJoinRequestCount()` / `setPendingJoinRequestCount()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Number of pending join requests created using this link
- `subscription_period` → `$subscriptionPeriod` / `getSubscriptionPeriod()` / `setSubscriptionPeriod()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. The number of seconds the subscription will be active for before the next payment
- `subscription_price` → `$subscriptionPrice` / `getSubscriptionPrice()` / `setSubscriptionPrice()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. The amount of Telegram Stars a user must pay initially and after each subsequent subscription period to be a member of the chat using the link

## ChatAdministratorRights

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\ChatAdministratorRights`

Represents the rights of an administrator in a chat.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#chatadministratorrights

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `is_anonymous` → `$isAnonymous` / `getIsAnonymous()` / `setIsAnonymous()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. *True*, if the user's presence in the chat is hidden
- `can_manage_chat` → `$canManageChat` / `getCanManageChat()` / `setCanManageChat()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. *True*, if the administrator can access the chat event log, get boost list, see hidden supergroup and channel members, report spam messages, ignore slow mode, and send messages to the chat without paying Telegram Stars. Implied by any other administrator privilege.
- `can_delete_messages` → `$canDeleteMessages` / `getCanDeleteMessages()` / `setCanDeleteMessages()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. *True*, if the administrator can delete messages of other users
- `can_manage_video_chats` → `$canManageVideoChats` / `getCanManageVideoChats()` / `setCanManageVideoChats()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. *True*, if the administrator can manage video chats
- `can_restrict_members` → `$canRestrictMembers` / `getCanRestrictMembers()` / `setCanRestrictMembers()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. *True*, if the administrator can restrict, ban or unban chat members, or access supergroup statistics
- `can_promote_members` → `$canPromoteMembers` / `getCanPromoteMembers()` / `setCanPromoteMembers()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. *True*, if the administrator can add new administrators with a subset of their own privileges or demote administrators that they have promoted, directly or indirectly (promoted by administrators that were appointed by the user)
- `can_change_info` → `$canChangeInfo` / `getCanChangeInfo()` / `setCanChangeInfo()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. *True*, if the user is allowed to change the chat title, photo and other settings
- `can_invite_users` → `$canInviteUsers` / `getCanInviteUsers()` / `setCanInviteUsers()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. *True*, if the user is allowed to invite new users to the chat
- `can_post_stories` → `$canPostStories` / `getCanPostStories()` / `setCanPostStories()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. *True*, if the administrator can post stories to the chat
- `can_edit_stories` → `$canEditStories` / `getCanEditStories()` / `setCanEditStories()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. *True*, if the administrator can edit stories posted by other users, post stories to the chat page, pin chat stories, and access the chat's story archive
- `can_delete_stories` → `$canDeleteStories` / `getCanDeleteStories()` / `setCanDeleteStories()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. *True*, if the administrator can delete stories posted by other users
- `can_post_messages` → `$canPostMessages` / `getCanPostMessages()` / `setCanPostMessages()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the administrator can post messages in the channel, approve suggested posts, or access channel statistics; for channels only
- `can_edit_messages` → `$canEditMessages` / `getCanEditMessages()` / `setCanEditMessages()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the administrator can edit messages of other users and can pin messages; for channels only
- `can_pin_messages` → `$canPinMessages` / `getCanPinMessages()` / `setCanPinMessages()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the user is allowed to pin messages; for groups and supergroups only
- `can_manage_topics` → `$canManageTopics` / `getCanManageTopics()` / `setCanManageTopics()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the user is allowed to create, rename, close, and reopen forum topics; for supergroups only
- `can_manage_direct_messages` → `$canManageDirectMessages` / `getCanManageDirectMessages()` / `setCanManageDirectMessages()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the administrator can manage direct messages of the channel and decline suggested posts; for channels only
- `can_manage_tags` → `$canManageTags` / `getCanManageTags()` / `setCanManageTags()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the administrator can edit the tags of regular members; for groups and supergroups only
- `can_send_welcome_messages` → `$canSendWelcomeMessages` / `getCanSendWelcomeMessages()` / `setCanSendWelcomeMessages()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. *True*, if the administrator can manage chat welcome messages or directly send them in the case of bots

## ChatMember

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\ChatMember`

This object contains information about one member of a chat. Currently, the following 6 types of chat members are supported:

- `ChatMemberOwner`
- `ChatMemberAdministrator`
- `ChatMemberMember`
- `ChatMemberRestricted`
- `ChatMemberLeft`
- `ChatMemberBanned`

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#chatmember
- Union: `ChatMember::create($data)` returns one of: `ChatMemberOwner`, `ChatMemberAdministrator`, `ChatMemberMember`, `ChatMemberRestricted`, `ChatMemberLeft`, `ChatMemberBanned`

## ChatMemberOwner

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\ChatMemberOwner` — variant of `ChatMember`

Represents a `ChatMember` that owns the chat and has all administrator privileges.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#chatmemberowner

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `status` → `$status` / `getStatus()` / `setStatus()`: `string|null`; `string` — required, always `'creator'`. The member's status in the chat, always “creator”
- `user` → `$user` / `getUser()` / `setUser()`: `Types\User|null`; `Types\User|array<string, mixed>` — required. Information about the user
- `is_anonymous` → `$isAnonymous` / `getIsAnonymous()` / `setIsAnonymous()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. *True*, if the user's presence in the chat is hidden
- `custom_title` → `$customTitle` / `getCustomTitle()` / `setCustomTitle()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Custom title for this user

- `can_add_web_page_previews` → `$canAddWebPagePreviews` / `getCanAddWebPagePreviews()` / `setCanAddWebPagePreviews()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. *True*, if the user is allowed to add web page previews to their messages
- `can_react_to_messages` → `$canReactToMessages` / `getCanReactToMessages()` / `setCanReactToMessages()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. *True*, if the user is allowed to react to messages
- `can_edit_tag` → `$canEditTag` / `getCanEditTag()` / `setCanEditTag()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. *True*, if the user is allowed to edit their own tag
- `can_change_info` → `$canChangeInfo` / `getCanChangeInfo()` / `setCanChangeInfo()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. *True*, if the user is allowed to change the chat title, photo and other settings
- `can_invite_users` → `$canInviteUsers` / `getCanInviteUsers()` / `setCanInviteUsers()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. *True*, if the user is allowed to invite new users to the chat
- `can_pin_messages` → `$canPinMessages` / `getCanPinMessages()` / `setCanPinMessages()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. *True*, if the user is allowed to pin messages
- `can_manage_topics` → `$canManageTopics` / `getCanManageTopics()` / `setCanManageTopics()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. *True*, if the user is allowed to create forum topics
- `until_date` → `$untilDate` / `getUntilDate()` / `setUntilDate()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Date when restrictions will be lifted for this user; Unix time. If 0, then the user is restricted forever.

## ChatJoinRequest

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\ChatJoinRequest`

Represents a join request sent to a chat.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#chatjoinrequest

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `chat` → `$chat` / `getChat()` / `setChat()`: `Types\Chat|null`; `Types\Chat|array<string, mixed>` — required. Chat to which the request was sent
- `from` → `$from` / `getFrom()` / `setFrom()`: `Types\User|null`; `Types\User|array<string, mixed>` — required. User that sent the join request
- `user_chat_id` → `$userChatId` / `getUserChatId()` / `setUserChatId()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Identifier of a private chat with the user who sent the join request. This number may have more than 32 significant bits and some programming languages may have difficulty/silent defects in interpreting it. But it has at most 52 significant bits, so a 64-bit integer or double-precision float type are safe for storing this identifier. The bot can use this identifier for 5 minutes to send messages until the join request is processed, assuming no other administrator contacted the user.
- `date` → `$date` / `getDate()` / `setDate()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Date the request was sent in Unix time
- `bio` → `$bio` / `getBio()` / `setBio()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Bio of the user
- `invite_link` → `$inviteLink` / `getInviteLink()` / `setInviteLink()`: `Types\ChatInviteLink|null`; `Types\ChatInviteLink|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Chat invite link that was used by the user to send the join request
- `query_id` → `$queryId` / `getQueryId()` / `setQueryId()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Identifier of the join request query; for bots assigned to process join requests only. If present, then the bot must call `sendChatJoinRequestWebApp` or directly call `answerChatJoinRequestQuery` within 10 seconds.

- `date` → `$date` / `getDate()` / `setDate()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Date of the change in Unix time
- `old_reaction` → `$oldReaction` / `getOldReaction()` / `setOldReaction()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Types\ReactionType>`; `list<Types\ReactionType|array<string, mixed>>|Base\ArrayObject<Types\ReactionType>` — required. Previous list of reaction types that were set by the user
- `new_reaction` → `$newReaction` / `getNewReaction()` / `setNewReaction()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Types\ReactionType>`; `list<Types\ReactionType|array<string, mixed>>|Base\ArrayObject<Types\ReactionType>` — required. New list of reaction types that have been set by the user

## UniqueGift

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\UniqueGift`

This object describes a unique gift that was upgraded from a regular gift.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#uniquegift

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `gift_id` → `$giftId` / `getGiftId()` / `setGiftId()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Identifier of the regular gift from which the gift was upgraded
- `base_name` → `$baseName` / `getBaseName()` / `setBaseName()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Human-readable name of the regular gift from which this unique gift was upgraded
- `name` → `$name` / `getName()` / `setName()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Unique name of the gift. This name can be used in `https://t.me/nft/...` links and story areas.
- `number` → `$number` / `getNumber()` / `setNumber()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Unique number of the upgraded gift among gifts upgraded from the same regular gift
- `model` → `$model` / `getModel()` / `setModel()`: `Types\UniqueGiftModel|null`; `Types\UniqueGiftModel|array<string, mixed>` — required. Model of the gift
- `symbol` → `$symbol` / `getSymbol()` / `setSymbol()`: `Types\UniqueGiftSymbol|null`; `Types\UniqueGiftSymbol|array<string, mixed>` — required. Symbol of the gift
- `backdrop` → `$backdrop` / `getBackdrop()` / `setBackdrop()`: `Types\UniqueGiftBackdrop|null`; `Types\UniqueGiftBackdrop|array<string, mixed>` — required. Backdrop of the gift
- `is_premium` → `$isPremium` / `getIsPremium()` / `setIsPremium()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the original regular gift was exclusively purchaseable by Telegram Premium subscribers
- `is_burned` → `$isBurned` / `getIsBurned()` / `setIsBurned()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the gift was used to craft another gift and isn't available anymore
- `is_from_blockchain` → `$isFromBlockchain` / `getIsFromBlockchain()` / `setIsFromBlockchain()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the gift is assigned from the TON blockchain and can't be resold or transferred in Telegram
- `colors` → `$colors` / `getColors()` / `setColors()`: `Types\UniqueGiftColors|null`; `Types\UniqueGiftColors|array<string, mixed>` — optional. The color scheme that can be used by the gift's owner for the chat's name, replies to messages and link previews; for business account gifts and gifts that are currently on sale only
- `publisher_chat` → `$publisherChat` / `getPublisherChat()` / `setPublisherChat()`: `Types\Chat|null`; `Types\Chat|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Information about the chat that published the gift

## GiftInfo

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\GiftInfo`

Describes a service message about a regular gift that was sent or received.

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):

- `convert_star_count` → `$convertStarCount` / `getConvertStarCount()` / `setConvertStarCount()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Number of Telegram Stars that can be claimed by the receiver by converting the gift; omitted if conversion to Telegram Stars is impossible
- `prepaid_upgrade_star_count` → `$prepaidUpgradeStarCount` / `getPrepaidUpgradeStarCount()` / `setPrepaidUpgradeStarCount()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Number of Telegram Stars that were prepaid for the ability to upgrade the gift
- `is_upgrade_separate` → `$isUpgradeSeparate` / `getIsUpgradeSeparate()` / `setIsUpgradeSeparate()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the gift's upgrade was purchased after the gift was sent
- `can_be_upgraded` → `$canBeUpgraded` / `getCanBeUpgraded()` / `setCanBeUpgraded()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the gift can be upgraded to a unique gift
- `text` → `$text` / `getText()` / `setText()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Text of the message that was added to the gift
- `entities` → `$entities` / `getEntities()` / `setEntities()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Types\MessageEntity>`; `list<Types\MessageEntity|array<string, mixed>>|Base\ArrayObject<Types\MessageEntity>` — optional. Special entities that appear in the text
- `is_private` → `$isPrivate` / `getIsPrivate()` / `setIsPrivate()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the sender and gift text are shown only to the gift receiver; otherwise, everyone will be able to see them
- `unique_gift_number` → `$uniqueGiftNumber` / `getUniqueGiftNumber()` / `setUniqueGiftNumber()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Unique number reserved for this gift when upgraded. See the *number* field in `UniqueGift`.

## UniqueGiftInfo

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\UniqueGiftInfo`

Describes a service message about a unique gift that was sent or received.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#uniquegiftinfo

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `gift` → `$gift` / `getGift()` / `setGift()`: `Types\UniqueGift|null`; `Types\UniqueGift|array<string, mixed>` — required. Information about the gift
- `origin` → `$origin` / `getOrigin()` / `setOrigin()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Origin of the gift. Currently, either “upgrade” for gifts upgraded from regular gifts, “transfer” for gifts transferred from other users or channels, “resale” for gifts bought from other users, “gifted_upgrade” for upgrades purchased after the gift was sent, or “offer” for gifts bought or sold through gift purchase offers.
- `text` → `$text` / `getText()` / `setText()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Text of the message that was added to the gift
- `entities` → `$entities` / `getEntities()` / `setEntities()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Types\MessageEntity>`; `list<Types\MessageEntity|array<string, mixed>>|Base\ArrayObject<Types\MessageEntity>` — optional. Special entities that appear in the text
- `is_private` → `$isPrivate` / `getIsPrivate()` / `setIsPrivate()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the sender and gift text are shown only to the gift receiver; otherwise, everyone will be able to see them
- `last_resale_currency` → `$lastResaleCurrency` / `getLastResaleCurrency()` / `setLastResaleCurrency()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. For gifts bought from other users, the currency in which the payment for the gift was done. Currently, one of “XTR” for Telegram Stars or “TON” for TON grams.
- `last_resale_amount` → `$lastResaleAmount` / `getLastResaleAmount()` / `setLastResaleAmount()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. For gifts bought from other users, the price paid for the gift in either Telegram Stars or nanograms
- `owned_gift_id` → `$ownedGiftId` / `getOwnedGiftId()` / `setOwnedGiftId()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Unique identifier of the received gift for the bot; only present for gifts received on behalf of business accounts
- `transfer_star_count` → `$transferStarCount` / `getTransferStarCount()` / `setTransferStarCount()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Number of Telegram Stars that must be paid to transfer the gift; omitted if the bot cannot transfer the gift
- `next_transfer_date` → `$nextTransferDate` / `getNextTransferDate()` / `setNextTransferDate()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Point in time (Unix timestamp) when the gift can be transferred. If it is in the past, then the gift can be transferred now.

## OwnedGift

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\OwnedGift`

This object describes a gift received and owned by a user or a chat. Currently, it can be one of

- `OwnedGiftRegular`
- `OwnedGiftUnique`

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#ownedgift
- Union: `OwnedGift::create($data)` returns one of: `OwnedGiftRegular`, `OwnedGiftUnique`
