Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `total_count` → `$totalCount` / `getTotalCount()` / `setTotalCount()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. The total number of gifts owned by the user or the chat
- `gifts` → `$gifts` / `getGifts()` / `setGifts()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Types\OwnedGift>`; `list<Types\OwnedGift|array<string, mixed>>|Base\ArrayObject<Types\OwnedGift>` — required. The list of gifts
- `next_offset` → `$nextOffset` / `getNextOffset()` / `setNextOffset()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Offset for the next request. If empty, then there are no more results.

## BotAccessSettings

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\BotAccessSettings`

This object describes the access settings of a bot.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#botaccesssettings

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `is_access_restricted` → `$isAccessRestricted` / `getIsAccessRestricted()` / `setIsAccessRestricted()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. *True*, if only selected users can access the bot. The bot's owner can always access it.
- `added_users` → `$addedUsers` / `getAddedUsers()` / `setAddedUsers()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Types\User>`; `list<Types\User|array<string, mixed>>|Base\ArrayObject<Types\User>` — optional. The list of other users who have access to the bot if the access is restricted

## AcceptedGiftTypes

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\AcceptedGiftTypes`

- `limited_gifts` → `$limitedGifts` / `getLimitedGifts()` / `setLimitedGifts()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. *True*, if limited regular gifts are accepted
- `unique_gifts` → `$uniqueGifts` / `getUniqueGifts()` / `setUniqueGifts()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. *True*, if unique gifts or gifts that can be upgraded to unique for free are accepted

## StarAmount

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\StarAmount`

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):

- `nanostar_amount` → `$nanostarAmount` / `getNanostarAmount()` / `setNanostarAmount()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. The number of 1/1000000000 shares of Telegram Stars; from -999999999 to 999999999; can be negative if and only if *amount* is non-positive

## BotCommand

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\BotCommand`

This object represents a bot command.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#botcommand

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `command` → `$command` / `getCommand()` / `setCommand()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Text of the command; 1-32 characters. Can contain only lowercase English letters, digits and underscores.
- `description` → `$description` / `getDescription()` / `setDescription()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Description of the command; 1-256 characters
- `is_ephemeral` → `$isEphemeral` / `getIsEphemeral()` / `setIsEphemeral()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the command sends an ephemeral message, which can be seen only by the sender of the message and the bot

## BotCommandScope

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\BotCommandScope`

This object represents the scope to which bot commands are applied. Currently, the following 7 scopes are supported:

- `BotCommandScopeDefault`
- `BotCommandScopeAllPrivateChats`
- `BotCommandScopeAllGroupChats`
- `BotCommandScopeAllChatAdministrators`
- `BotCommandScopeChat`
- `BotCommandScopeChatAdministrators`
- `BotCommandScopeChatMember`

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#botcommandscope
- Union: `BotCommandScope::create($data)` returns one of: `BotCommandScopeDefault`, `BotCommandScopeAllPrivateChats`, `BotCommandScopeAllGroupChats`, `BotCommandScopeAllChatAdministrators`, `BotCommandScopeChat`, `BotCommandScopeChatAdministrators`, `BotCommandScopeChatMember`

## BotCommandScopeDefault

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\BotCommandScopeDefault` — variant of `BotCommandScope`

Represents the default `BotCommandScope` of bot commands. Default commands are used if no commands with a [narrower scope](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#determining-list-of-commands) are specified for the user.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#botcommandscopedefault

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `type` → `$type` / `getType()` / `setType()`: `string|null`; `string` — required, always `'default'`. Scope type, must be *default*

## MenuButton

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\MenuButton`

This object describes the bot's menu button in a private chat. It should be one of

- `MenuButtonCommands`
- `MenuButtonWebApp`
- `MenuButtonDefault`

If a menu button other than `MenuButtonDefault` is set for a private chat, then it is applied in the chat. Otherwise the default menu button is applied. By default, the menu button opens the list of bot commands.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#menubutton
- Union: `MenuButton::create($data)` returns one of: `MenuButtonCommands`, `MenuButtonWebApp`, `MenuButtonDefault`

## MenuButtonCommands

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\MenuButtonCommands` — variant of `MenuButton`

Represents a menu button, which opens the bot's list of commands.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#menubuttoncommands

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `type` → `$type` / `getType()` / `setType()`: `string|null`; `string` — required, always `'commands'`. Type of the button, must be *commands*

## MenuButtonWebApp

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\MenuButtonWebApp` — variant of `MenuButton`

Represents a menu button, which launches a [Web App](https://core.telegram.org/bots/webapps).

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#menubuttonwebapp

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `type` → `$type` / `getType()` / `setType()`: `string|null`; `string` — required, always `'web_app'`. Type of the button, must be *web_app*
- `text` → `$text` / `getText()` / `setText()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Text on the button
- `web_app` → `$webApp` / `getWebApp()` / `setWebApp()`: `Types\WebAppInfo|null`; `Types\WebAppInfo|array<string, mixed>` — required. Description of the Web App that will be launched when the user presses the button. The Web App will be able to send an arbitrary message on behalf of the user using the method `answerWebAppQuery`. Alternatively, a `t.me` link to a Web App of the bot can be specified in the object instead of the Web App's URL, in which case the Web App will be opened as if the user pressed the link.

## MenuButtonDefault

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\MenuButtonDefault` — variant of `MenuButton`

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#menubuttondefault

## ChatBoostSource

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\ChatBoostSource`

This object describes the source of a chat boost. It can be one of

- `ChatBoostSourcePremium`
- `ChatBoostSourceGiftCode`
- `ChatBoostSourceGiveaway`

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#chatboostsource
- Union: `ChatBoostSource::create($data)` returns one of: `ChatBoostSourcePremium`, `ChatBoostSourceGiftCode`, `ChatBoostSourceGiveaway`

## ChatBoostSourcePremium

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\ChatBoostSourcePremium` — variant of `ChatBoostSource`

The boost was obtained by subscribing to Telegram Premium or by gifting a Telegram Premium subscription to another user.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#chatboostsourcepremium

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `source` → `$source` / `getSource()` / `setSource()`: `string|null`; `string` — required, always `'premium'`. Source of the boost, always “premium”
- `user` → `$user` / `getUser()` / `setUser()`: `Types\User|null`; `Types\User|array<string, mixed>` — required. User that boosted the chat

## ChatBoostSourceGiftCode

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\ChatBoostSourceGiftCode` — variant of `ChatBoostSource`

The boost was obtained by the creation of Telegram Premium gift codes to boost a chat. Each such code boosts the chat 4 times for the duration of the corresponding Telegram Premium subscription.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#chatboostsourcegiftcode

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `source` → `$source` / `getSource()` / `setSource()`: `string|null`; `string` — required, always `'gift_code'`. Source of the boost, always “gift_code”
- `user` → `$user` / `getUser()` / `setUser()`: `Types\User|null`; `Types\User|array<string, mixed>` — required. User for which the gift code was created

## ChatBoostSourceGiveaway

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\ChatBoostSourceGiveaway` — variant of `ChatBoostSource`

The boost was obtained by the creation of a Telegram Premium or a Telegram Star giveaway. This boosts the chat 4 times for the duration of the corresponding Telegram Premium subscription for Telegram Premium giveaways and *prize_star_count* / 500 times for one year for Telegram Star giveaways.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#chatboostsourcegiveaway

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `source` → `$source` / `getSource()` / `setSource()`: `string|null`; `string` — required, always `'giveaway'`. Source of the boost, always “giveaway”
- `giveaway_message_id` → `$giveawayMessageId` / `getGiveawayMessageId()` / `setGiveawayMessageId()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Identifier of a message in the chat with the giveaway; the message could have been deleted already. May be 0 if the message isn't sent yet.
- `user` → `$user` / `getUser()` / `setUser()`: `Types\User|null`; `Types\User|array<string, mixed>` — optional. User that won the prize in the giveaway if any; for Telegram Premium giveaways only
- `prize_star_count` → `$prizeStarCount` / `getPrizeStarCount()` / `setPrizeStarCount()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. The number of Telegram Stars to be split between giveaway winners; for Telegram Star giveaways only
- `is_unclaimed` → `$isUnclaimed` / `getIsUnclaimed()` / `setIsUnclaimed()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the giveaway was completed, but there was no user to win the prize

## ChatBoost

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\ChatBoost`

This object contains information about a chat boost.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#chatboost

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `boost_id` → `$boostId` / `getBoostId()` / `setBoostId()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Unique identifier of the boost
- `add_date` → `$addDate` / `getAddDate()` / `setAddDate()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Point in time (Unix timestamp) when the chat was boosted
- `expiration_date` → `$expirationDate` / `getExpirationDate()` / `setExpirationDate()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Point in time (Unix timestamp) when the boost will automatically expire, unless the booster's Telegram Premium subscription is prolonged
- `source` → `$source` / `getSource()` / `setSource()`: `Types\ChatBoostSource|null`; `Types\ChatBoostSource|array<string, mixed>` — required. Source of the added boost

## BusinessBotRights

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\BusinessBotRights`

Represents the rights of a business bot.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#businessbotrights

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `can_reply` → `$canReply` / `getCanReply()` / `setCanReply()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the bot can send and edit messages in the private chats that had incoming messages in the last 24 hours
- `can_read_messages` → `$canReadMessages` / `getCanReadMessages()` / `setCanReadMessages()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the bot can mark incoming private messages as read
- `can_delete_sent_messages` → `$canDeleteSentMessages` / `getCanDeleteSentMessages()` / `setCanDeleteSentMessages()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the bot can delete messages sent by the bot
- `can_delete_all_messages` → `$canDeleteAllMessages` / `getCanDeleteAllMessages()` / `setCanDeleteAllMessages()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the bot can delete all private messages in managed chats
- `can_edit_name` → `$canEditName` / `getCanEditName()` / `setCanEditName()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the bot can edit the first and last name of the business account
- `can_edit_bio` → `$canEditBio` / `getCanEditBio()` / `setCanEditBio()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the bot can edit the bio of the business account
- `can_edit_profile_photo` → `$canEditProfilePhoto` / `getCanEditProfilePhoto()` / `setCanEditProfilePhoto()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the bot can edit the profile photo of the business account
- `can_edit_username` → `$canEditUsername` / `getCanEditUsername()` / `setCanEditUsername()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the bot can edit the username of the business account
- `can_change_gift_settings` → `$canChangeGiftSettings` / `getCanChangeGiftSettings()` / `setCanChangeGiftSettings()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the bot can change the privacy settings pertaining to gifts for the business account
- `can_view_gifts_and_stars` → `$canViewGiftsAndStars` / `getCanViewGiftsAndStars()` / `setCanViewGiftsAndStars()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the bot can view gifts and the amount of Telegram Stars owned by the business account
- `can_convert_gifts_to_stars` → `$canConvertGiftsToStars` / `getCanConvertGiftsToStars()` / `setCanConvertGiftsToStars()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the bot can convert regular gifts owned by the business account to Telegram Stars
- `can_transfer_and_upgrade_gifts` → `$canTransferAndUpgradeGifts` / `getCanTransferAndUpgradeGifts()` / `setCanTransferAndUpgradeGifts()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the bot can transfer and upgrade gifts owned by the business account
- `can_transfer_stars` → `$canTransferStars` / `getCanTransferStars()` / `setCanTransferStars()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the bot can transfer Telegram Stars received by the business account to its own account, or use them to upgrade and transfer gifts
- `can_manage_stories` → `$canManageStories` / `getCanManageStories()` / `setCanManageStories()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the bot can post, edit and delete stories on behalf of the business account

## BusinessConnection

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\BusinessConnection`

Describes the connection of the bot with a business account.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#businessconnection

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `id` → `$id` / `getId()` / `setId()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Unique identifier of the business connection
- `user` → `$user` / `getUser()` / `setUser()`: `Types\User|null`; `Types\User|array<string, mixed>` — required. Business account user that created the business connection
- `user_chat_id` → `$userChatId` / `getUserChatId()` / `setUserChatId()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Identifier of a private chat with the user who created the business connection. This number may have more than 32 significant bits and some programming languages may have difficulty/silent defects in interpreting it. But it has at most 52 significant bits, so a 64-bit integer or double-precision float type are safe for storing this identifier.
- `date` → `$date` / `getDate()` / `setDate()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Date the connection was established in Unix time
- `rights` → `$rights` / `getRights()` / `setRights()`: `Types\BusinessBotRights|null`; `Types\BusinessBotRights|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Rights of the business bot
- `is_enabled` → `$isEnabled` / `getIsEnabled()` / `setIsEnabled()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. *True*, if the connection is active

- `message_ids` → `$messageIds` / `getMessageIds()` / `setMessageIds()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Base\ParameterInt>`; `list<int>|Base\ArrayObject<Base\ParameterInt>` — required. The list of identifiers of deleted messages in the chat of the business account

## SentWebAppMessage

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\SentWebAppMessage`

Describes an inline message sent by a [Web App](https://core.telegram.org/bots/webapps) on behalf of a user.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sentwebappmessage

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `inline_message_id` → `$inlineMessageId` / `getInlineMessageId()` / `setInlineMessageId()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Identifier of the sent inline message. Available only if there is an `InlineKeyboardMarkup` attached to the message.

## SentGuestMessage

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\SentGuestMessage`

Describes an inline message sent by a guest bot.

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\PreparedInlineMessage`

- `expiration_date` → `$expirationDate` / `getExpirationDate()` / `setExpirationDate()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Expiration date of the prepared message, in Unix time. Expired prepared messages can no longer be used.

## ResponseParameters

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\ResponseParameters`

Describes why a request was unsuccessful.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#responseparameters

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `migrate_to_chat_id` → `$migrateToChatId` / `getMigrateToChatId()` / `setMigrateToChatId()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. The group has been migrated to a supergroup with the specified identifier. This number may have more than 32 significant bits and some programming languages may have difficulty/silent defects in interpreting it. But it has at most 52 significant bits, so a signed 64-bit integer or double-precision float type are safe for storing this identifier.
- `retry_after` → `$retryAfter` / `getRetryAfter()` / `setRetryAfter()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. In case of exceeding flood control, the number of seconds left to wait before the request can be repeated

## InputMedia

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\InputMedia`

This object represents the content of a media message to be sent. It should be one of

- `InputMediaAnimation`
- `InputMediaAudio`
- `InputMediaDocument`
- `InputMediaLivePhoto`
- `InputMediaPhoto`
- `InputMediaVideo`

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputmedia
- Union: `InputMedia::create($data)` returns one of: `InputMediaAnimation`, `InputMediaAudio`, `InputMediaDocument`, `InputMediaLivePhoto`, `InputMediaPhoto`, `InputMediaVideo`

## InputMediaAnimation

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\InputMediaAnimation` — variant of `InputMedia`

Represents an animation file (GIF or H.264/MPEG-4 AVC video without sound) to be sent.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputmediaanimation

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `type` → `$type` / `getType()` / `setType()`: `string|null`; `string` — required, always `'animation'`. Type of the media, must be *animation*
- `media` → `$media` / `getMedia()` / `setMedia()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. File to send. Pass a file_id to send a file that exists on the Telegram servers (recommended), pass an HTTP URL for Telegram to get a file from the Internet, or pass “attach://<file_attach_name>” to upload a new one using multipart/form-data under <file_attach_name> name. [More information on Sending Files »](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sending-files)
- `thumbnail` → `$thumbnail` / `getThumbnail()` / `setThumbnail()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Thumbnail of the file sent; can be ignored if thumbnail generation for the file is supported server-side. The thumbnail should be in JPEG format and less than 200 kB in size. A thumbnail's width and height should not exceed 320. Ignored if the file is not uploaded using multipart/form-data. Thumbnails can't be reused and can be only uploaded as a new file, so you can pass “attach://<file_attach_name>” if the thumbnail was uploaded using multipart/form-data under <file_attach_name>. [More information on Sending Files »](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sending-files)
- `caption` → `$caption` / `getCaption()` / `setCaption()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Caption of the animation to be sent, 0-1024 characters after entities parsing
- `parse_mode` → `$parseMode` / `getParseMode()` / `setParseMode()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Mode for parsing entities in the animation caption. See [formatting options](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#formatting-options) for more details.
- `caption_entities` → `$captionEntities` / `getCaptionEntities()` / `setCaptionEntities()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Types\MessageEntity>`; `list<Types\MessageEntity|array<string, mixed>>|Base\ArrayObject<Types\MessageEntity>` — optional. List of special entities that appear in the caption, which can be specified instead of *parse_mode*
- `show_caption_above_media` → `$showCaptionAboveMedia` / `getShowCaptionAboveMedia()` / `setShowCaptionAboveMedia()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Pass *True* if the caption must be shown above the message media
- `width` → `$width` / `getWidth()` / `setWidth()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Animation width
- `height` → `$height` / `getHeight()` / `setHeight()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Animation height
- `duration` → `$duration` / `getDuration()` / `setDuration()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Animation duration in seconds
- `has_spoiler` → `$hasSpoiler` / `getHasSpoiler()` / `setHasSpoiler()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Pass *True* if the animation needs to be covered with a spoiler animation

## InputPaidMedia

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\InputPaidMedia`

This object describes the paid media to be sent. Currently, it can be one of

- `InputPaidMediaLivePhoto`
- `InputPaidMediaPhoto`
- `InputPaidMediaVideo`

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputpaidmedia
- Union: `InputPaidMedia::create($data)` returns one of: `InputPaidMediaLivePhoto`, `InputPaidMediaPhoto`, `InputPaidMediaVideo`

## InputPaidMediaLivePhoto

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\InputPaidMediaLivePhoto` — variant of `InputPaidMedia`

The paid media to send is a live photo.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputpaidmedialivephoto

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `type` → `$type` / `getType()` / `setType()`: `string|null`; `string` — required, always `'live_photo'`. Type of the media, must be *live_photo*
- `media` → `$media` / `getMedia()` / `setMedia()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Video of the live photo to send. Pass a file_id to send a file that exists on the Telegram servers (recommended) or pass “attach://<file_attach_name>” to upload a new one using multipart/form-data under <file_attach_name> name. [More information on Sending Files »](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sending-files). Sending live photos by a URL is currently unsupported.
- `photo` → `$photo` / `getPhoto()` / `setPhoto()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. The static photo to send. Pass a file_id to send a file that exists on the Telegram servers (recommended) or pass “attach://<file_attach_name>” to upload a new one using multipart/form-data under <file_attach_name> name. [More information on Sending Files »](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sending-files). Sending live photos by a URL is currently unsupported.

## InputPaidMediaVideo

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\InputPaidMediaVideo` — variant of `InputPaidMedia`

The paid media to send is a video.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputpaidmediavideo

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `type` → `$type` / `getType()` / `setType()`: `string|null`; `string` — required, always `'video'`. Type of the media, must be *video*
- `media` → `$media` / `getMedia()` / `setMedia()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. File to send. Pass a file_id to send a file that exists on the Telegram servers (recommended), pass an HTTP URL for Telegram to get a file from the Internet, or pass “attach://<file_attach_name>” to upload a new one using multipart/form-data under <file_attach_name> name. [More information on Sending Files »](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sending-files)
- `thumbnail` → `$thumbnail` / `getThumbnail()` / `setThumbnail()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Thumbnail of the file sent; can be ignored if thumbnail generation for the file is supported server-side. The thumbnail should be in JPEG format and less than 200 kB in size. A thumbnail's width and height should not exceed 320. Ignored if the file is not uploaded using multipart/form-data. Thumbnails can't be reused and can be only uploaded as a new file, so you can pass “attach://<file_attach_name>” if the thumbnail was uploaded using multipart/form-data under <file_attach_name>. [More information on Sending Files »](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sending-files)
- `cover` → `$cover` / `getCover()` / `setCover()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Cover for the video in the message. Pass a file_id to send a file that exists on the Telegram servers (recommended), pass an HTTP URL for Telegram to get a file from the Internet, or pass “attach://<file_attach_name>” to upload a new one using multipart/form-data under <file_attach_name> name. [More information on Sending Files »](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sending-files)
- `start_timestamp` → `$startTimestamp` / `getStartTimestamp()` / `setStartTimestamp()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Start timestamp for the video in the message
- `width` → `$width` / `getWidth()` / `setWidth()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Video width
- `height` → `$height` / `getHeight()` / `setHeight()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Video height
- `duration` → `$duration` / `getDuration()` / `setDuration()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Video duration in seconds
- `supports_streaming` → `$supportsStreaming` / `getSupportsStreaming()` / `setSupportsStreaming()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Pass *True* if the uploaded video is suitable for streaming

## InputStoryContentPhoto

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\InputStoryContentPhoto` — variant of `InputStoryContent`

Describes a photo to post as a story.

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):

## InputStoryContentVideo

`DevBX\Telegram\Types\InputStoryContentVideo` — variant of `InputStoryContent`

Describes a video to post as a story.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputstorycontentvideo

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `type` → `$type` / `getType()` / `setType()`: `string|null`; `string` — required, always `'video'`. Type of the content, must be *video*

The video must be of the size 720x1280, streamable, encoded with H.265 codec, with key frames added each second in the MPEG4 format, and must not exceed 30 MB. The video can't be reused and can only be uploaded as a new file, so you can pass “attach://<file_attach_name>” if the video was uploaded using multipart/form-data under <file_attach_name>. - `duration` → `$duration` / `getDuration()` / `setDuration()`: `float|null`; `float|int` — optional. Precise duration of the video in seconds; 0-60
- `cover_frame_timestamp` → `$coverFrameTimestamp` / `getCoverFrameTimestamp()` / `setCoverFrameTimestamp()`: `float|null`; `float|int` — optional. Timestamp in seconds of the frame that will be used as the static cover for the story. Defaults to 0.0.
- `is_animation` → `$isAnimation` / `getIsAnimation()` / `setIsAnimation()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Pass *True* if the video has no sound

## Sticker

`DevBX\Telegram\Stickers\Sticker`

This object represents a sticker.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sticker

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `file_id` → `$fileId` / `getFileId()` / `setFileId()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Identifier for this file, which can be used to download or reuse the file
- `file_unique_id` → `$fileUniqueId` / `getFileUniqueId()` / `setFileUniqueId()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Unique identifier for this file, which is supposed to be the same over time and for different bots. Can't be used to download or reuse the file.
- `type` → `$type` / `getType()` / `setType()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Type of the sticker, currently one of “regular”, “mask”, “custom_emoji”. The type of the sticker is independent from its format, which is determined by the fields *is_animated* and *is_video*.
- `width` → `$width` / `getWidth()` / `setWidth()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Sticker width
- `height` → `$height` / `getHeight()` / `setHeight()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Sticker height
- `is_animated` → `$isAnimated` / `getIsAnimated()` / `setIsAnimated()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. *True*, if the sticker is [animated](https://telegram.org/blog/animated-stickers)
- `is_video` → `$isVideo` / `getIsVideo()` / `setIsVideo()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — required. *True*, if the sticker is a [video sticker](https://telegram.org/blog/video-stickers-better-reactions)
- `thumbnail` → `$thumbnail` / `getThumbnail()` / `setThumbnail()`: `Types\PhotoSize|null`; `Types\PhotoSize|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Sticker thumbnail in the .WEBP or .JPG format
- `emoji` → `$emoji` / `getEmoji()` / `setEmoji()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Emoji associated with the sticker
- `set_name` → `$setName` / `getSetName()` / `setSetName()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Name of the sticker set to which the sticker belongs
- `premium_animation` → `$premiumAnimation` / `getPremiumAnimation()` / `setPremiumAnimation()`: `Types\File|null`; `Types\File|array<string, mixed>` — optional. For premium regular stickers, premium animation for the sticker
- `mask_position` → `$maskPosition` / `getMaskPosition()` / `setMaskPosition()`: `Stickers\MaskPosition|null`; `Stickers\MaskPosition|array<string, mixed>` — optional. For mask stickers, the position where the mask should be placed
- `custom_emoji_id` → `$customEmojiId` / `getCustomEmojiId()` / `setCustomEmojiId()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. For custom emoji stickers, unique identifier of the custom emoji
- `needs_repainting` → `$needsRepainting` / `getNeedsRepainting()` / `setNeedsRepainting()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the sticker must be repainted to a text color in messages, the color of the Telegram Premium badge in emoji status, white color on chat photos, or another appropriate color in other places
- `file_size` → `$fileSize` / `getFileSize()` / `setFileSize()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. File size in bytes

`DevBX\Telegram\Stickers\StickerSet`

## MaskPosition

`DevBX\Telegram\Stickers\MaskPosition`

This object describes the position on faces where a mask should be placed by default.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#maskposition

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `point` → `$point` / `getPoint()` / `setPoint()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. The part of the face relative to which the mask should be placed. One of “forehead”, “eyes”, “mouth”, or “chin”.
- `x_shift` → `$xShift` / `getXShift()` / `setXShift()`: `float|null`; `float|int` — required. Shift by X-axis measured in widths of the mask scaled to the face size, from left to right. For example, choosing -1.0 will place mask just to the left of the default mask position.
- `y_shift` → `$yShift` / `getYShift()` / `setYShift()`: `float|null`; `float|int` — required. Shift by Y-axis measured in heights of the mask scaled to the face size, from top to bottom. For example, 1.0 will place the mask just below the default mask position.
- `scale` → `$scale` / `getScale()` / `setScale()`: `float|null`; `float|int` — required. Mask scaling coefficient. For example, 2.0 means double size.

## InputSticker

`DevBX\Telegram\Stickers\InputSticker`

This object describes a sticker to be added to a sticker set.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputsticker

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `sticker` → `$sticker` / `getSticker()` / `setSticker()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. The added sticker. Pass a *file_id* as a String to send a file that already exists on the Telegram servers, pass an HTTP URL as a String for Telegram to get a file from the Internet, or pass “attach://<file_attach_name>” to upload a new file using multipart/form-data under <file_attach_name> name. Animated and video stickers can't be uploaded via HTTP URL. [More information on Sending Files »](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sending-files)
- `format` → `$format` / `getFormat()` / `setFormat()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Format of the added sticker, must be one of “static” for a **.WEBP** or **.PNG** image, “animated” for a **.TGS** animation, “video” for a **.WEBM** video
- `emoji_list` → `$emojiList` / `getEmojiList()` / `setEmojiList()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Base\ParameterString>`; `list<string>|Base\ArrayObject<Base\ParameterString>` — required. List of 1-20 emoji associated with the sticker
- `mask_position` → `$maskPosition` / `getMaskPosition()` / `setMaskPosition()`: `Stickers\MaskPosition|null`; `Stickers\MaskPosition|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Position where the mask should be placed on faces. For “mask” stickers only.
- `keywords` → `$keywords` / `getKeywords()` / `setKeywords()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Base\ParameterString>`; `list<string>|Base\ArrayObject<Base\ParameterString>` — optional. List of 0-20 search keywords for the sticker with total length of up to 64 characters. For “regular” and “custom_emoji” stickers only.

## InputRichMessage

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputrichmessage

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):

- `markdown` → `$markdown` / `getMarkdown()` / `setMarkdown()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Content of the rich message to send described using Markdown formatting. - `media` → `$media` / `getMedia()` / `setMedia()`: `Base\ArrayObject<RichMessages\InputRichMessageMedia>`; `list<RichMessages\InputRichMessageMedia|array<string, mixed>>|Base\ArrayObject<RichMessages\InputRichMessageMedia>` — optional. List of media that are specified in the *markdown* or *html* fields using `tg://photo?id=`, `tg://video?id=`, `tg://document?id=`, and `tg://audio?id=` links
- `is_rtl` → `$isRtl` / `getIsRtl()` / `setIsRtl()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Pass *True* if the rich message must be shown right-to-left
- `skip_entity_detection` → `$skipEntityDetection` / `getSkipEntityDetection()` / `setSkipEntityDetection()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Pass *True* to skip automatic detection of entities (e.g., URLs, email addresses, username mentions, hashtags, cashtags, bot commands, or phone numbers) in the text

`DevBX\Telegram\RichMessages\InputRichMessageMedia`

Describes a media element embedded in an outgoing rich message.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputrichmessagemedia

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):

- `media` → `$media` / `getMedia()` / `setMedia()`: `Types\InputMediaAnimation|Types\InputMediaAudio|Types\InputMediaDocument|Types\InputMediaPhoto|Types\InputMediaVideo|Types\InputMediaVoiceNote|null`; `Types\InputMediaAnimation|array<string, mixed>|Types\InputMediaAudio|Types\InputMediaDocument|Types\InputMediaPhoto|Types\InputMediaVideo|Types\InputMediaVoiceNote` — required. The media to be sent. Everything except the media itself and its properties is ignored.

## RichMessageButton

`DevBX\Telegram\RichMessages\RichMessageButton`

This object represents a button in a `RichMessage`. Exactly one of the fields other than *text* and *style* must be used to specify the type of the button.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#richmessagebutton

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `text` → `$text` / `getText()` / `setText()`: `RichMessages\RichText|string|list<mixed>|null`; `RichMessages\RichText|string|list<mixed>|array<string, mixed>` — required. Text of the button. May contain only plain text, `RichTextCustomEmoji` and `RichTextDateTime` entities.
- `style` → `$style` / `getStyle()` / `setStyle()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Style of the button. Must be one of “danger”, “success”, “primary”, or “link” (the button is shown as a regular link without borders). Apps may use theme-specific colors for the button background and text based on the style. The style “link” is allowed only for callback buttons.
- `url` → `$url` / `getUrl()` / `setUrl()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. HTTP or tg:// URL to be opened when the button is pressed. Links `tg://user?id=<user_id>` can be used to mention a user by their identifier without using a username, if this is allowed by their privacy settings.
- `callback_data` → `$callbackData` / `getCallbackData()` / `setCallbackData()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Data to be sent in a `CallbackQuery` to the bot when the button is pressed, 1-64 bytes
- `web_app` → `$webApp` / `getWebApp()` / `setWebApp()`: `Types\WebAppInfo|null`; `Types\WebAppInfo|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Description of the [Web App](https://core.telegram.org/bots/webapps) that will be launched when the user presses the button. The Web App will be able to send an arbitrary message on behalf of the user using the method `answerWebAppQuery`. Available only in private chats between a user and the bot. Not supported for messages sent on behalf of a business account.
- `login_url` → `$loginUrl` / `getLoginUrl()` / `setLoginUrl()`: `Types\LoginUrl|null`; `Types\LoginUrl|array<string, mixed>` — optional. An HTTPS URL used to automatically authorize the user. Can be used as a replacement for the [Telegram Login Widget](https://core.telegram.org/widgets/login). Not supported for ephemeral messages.
- `switch_inline_query` → `$switchInlineQuery` / `getSwitchInlineQuery()` / `setSwitchInlineQuery()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. If set, pressing the button will prompt the user to select one of their chats, open that chat and insert the bot's username and the specified inline query in the input field. May be empty, in which case just the bot's username will be inserted. Not supported for messages sent in channel direct messages chats and on behalf of a business account.
- `switch_inline_query_current_chat` → `$switchInlineQueryCurrentChat` / `getSwitchInlineQueryCurrentChat()` / `setSwitchInlineQueryCurrentChat()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. If set, pressing the button will insert the bot's username and the specified inline query in the current chat's input field. May be empty, in which case only the bot's username will be inserted. Not supported in channels and for messages sent in channel direct messages chats and on behalf of a business account.
- `switch_inline_query_chosen_chat` → `$switchInlineQueryChosenChat` / `getSwitchInlineQueryChosenChat()` / `setSwitchInlineQueryChosenChat()`: `Types\SwitchInlineQueryChosenChat|null`; `Types\SwitchInlineQueryChosenChat|array<string, mixed>` — optional. If set, pressing the button will prompt the user to select one of their chats of the specified type, open that chat and insert the bot's username and the specified inline query in the input field. Not supported for messages sent in channel direct messages chats and on behalf of a business account.
- `copy_text` → `$copyText` / `getCopyText()` / `setCopyText()`: `Types\CopyTextButton|null`; `Types\CopyTextButton|array<string, mixed>` — optional. A button that copies the specified text to the clipboard
- `disabled` → `$disabled` / `getDisabled()` / `setDisabled()`: `Types\DisabledButton|null`; `Types\DisabledButton|array<string, mixed>` — optional. If set, then the button is disabled and does nothing

## RichText

`DevBX\Telegram\RichMessages\RichText`

This object represents a rich formatted text. Currently, it can be either a String for plain text, an Array of `RichText`, or any of the following types:

- `RichTextBold`
- `RichTextItalic`
- `RichTextUnderline`
- `RichTextStrikethrough`
- `RichTextSpoiler`
- `RichTextDateTime`
- `RichTextTextMention`
- `RichTextSubscript`
- `RichTextSuperscript`
- `RichTextMarked`
- `RichTextCode`
- `RichTextCustomEmoji`
- `RichTextMathematicalExpression`
- `RichTextUrl`
- `RichTextEmailAddress`
- `RichTextPhoneNumber`
- `RichTextBankCardNumber`
- `RichTextMention`
- `RichTextHashtag`
- `RichTextCashtag`
- `RichTextBotCommand`
- `RichTextButton`
- `RichTextAnchor`
- `RichTextAnchorLink`
- `RichTextReference`
- `RichTextReferenceLink`

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#richtext
- Union: `RichText::create($data)` returns one of: `RichTextBold`, `RichTextItalic`, `RichTextUnderline`, `RichTextStrikethrough`, `RichTextSpoiler`, `RichTextDateTime`, `RichTextTextMention`, `RichTextSubscript`, `RichTextSuperscript`, `RichTextMarked`, `RichTextCode`, `RichTextCustomEmoji`, `RichTextMathematicalExpression`, `RichTextUrl`, `RichTextEmailAddress`, `RichTextPhoneNumber`, `RichTextBankCardNumber`, `RichTextMention`, `RichTextHashtag`, `RichTextCashtag`, `RichTextBotCommand`, `RichTextButton`, `RichTextAnchor`, `RichTextAnchorLink`, `RichTextReference`, `RichTextReferenceLink`
- Also accepts: plain string, list of RichText values

## RichBlockTableCell

`DevBX\Telegram\RichMessages\RichBlockTableCell`

Cell in a table.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#richblocktablecell

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `text` → `$text` / `getText()` / `setText()`: `RichMessages\RichText|string|list<mixed>|null`; `RichMessages\RichText|string|list<mixed>|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Text in the cell. If omitted, then the cell is invisible.
- `is_header` → `$isHeader` / `getIsHeader()` / `setIsHeader()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the cell is a header cell
- `colspan` → `$colspan` / `getColspan()` / `setColspan()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. The number of columns the cell spans if it is bigger than 1
- `rowspan` → `$rowspan` / `getRowspan()` / `setRowspan()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. The number of rows the cell spans if it is bigger than 1
- `align` → `$align` / `getAlign()` / `setAlign()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Horizontal cell content alignment. Currently, must be one of “left”, “center”, or “right”.
- `valign` → `$valign` / `getValign()` / `setValign()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Vertical cell content alignment. Currently, must be one of “top”, “middle”, or “bottom”.

## RichBlockListItem

`DevBX\Telegram\RichMessages\RichBlockListItem`

An item of a list.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#richblocklistitem

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `label` → `$label` / `getLabel()` / `setLabel()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Label of the item
- `blocks` → `$blocks` / `getBlocks()` / `setBlocks()`: `Base\ArrayObject<RichMessages\RichBlock>`; `list<RichMessages\RichBlock|array<string, mixed>>|Base\ArrayObject<RichMessages\RichBlock>` — required. The content of the item
- `has_checkbox` → `$hasCheckbox` / `getHasCheckbox()` / `setHasCheckbox()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the item has a checkbox
- `is_checked` → `$isChecked` / `getIsChecked()` / `setIsChecked()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the item has a checked checkbox
- `value` → `$value` / `getValue()` / `setValue()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. For ordered lists, the numeric value of the item label
- `type` → `$type` / `getType()` / `setType()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. For ordered lists, the type of the item label; must be one of “a” for lowercase letters, “A” for uppercase letters, “i” for lowercase Roman numerals, “I” for uppercase Roman numerals, or “1” for decimal numbers

## RichBlock

`DevBX\Telegram\RichMessages\RichBlock`

This object represents a block in a rich formatted message. Currently, it can be any of the following types:

- `RichBlockParagraph`
- `RichBlockSectionHeading`
- `RichBlockPreformatted`
- `RichBlockFooter`
- `RichBlockDivider`
- `RichBlockMathematicalExpression`
- `RichBlockAnchor`
- `RichBlockList`
- `RichBlockBlockQuotation`
- `RichBlockExpandableBlockQuotation`
- `RichBlockPullQuotation`
- `RichBlockCollage`
- `RichBlockSlideshow`
- `RichBlockTable`
- `RichBlockDetails`
- `RichBlockMap`
- `RichBlockButtons`
- `RichBlockAnimation`
- `RichBlockAudio`
- `RichBlockDocument`
- `RichBlockPhoto`
- `RichBlockVideo`
- `RichBlockVoiceNote`
- `RichBlockThinking`

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#richblock
- Union: `RichBlock::create($data)` returns one of: `RichBlockParagraph`, `RichBlockSectionHeading`, `RichBlockPreformatted`, `RichBlockFooter`, `RichBlockDivider`, `RichBlockMathematicalExpression`, `RichBlockAnchor`, `RichBlockList`, `RichBlockBlockQuotation`, `RichBlockExpandableBlockQuotation`, `RichBlockPullQuotation`, `RichBlockCollage`, `RichBlockSlideshow`, `RichBlockTable`, `RichBlockDetails`, `RichBlockMap`, `RichBlockButtons`, `RichBlockAnimation`, `RichBlockAudio`, `RichBlockDocument`, `RichBlockPhoto`, `RichBlockVideo`, `RichBlockVoiceNote`, `RichBlockThinking`

- `size` → `$size` / `getSize()` / `setSize()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Relative size of the text font; 1-6, 1 is the largest, 6 is the smallest

See https://t.me/addemoji/AIActions[https://t.me/addemoji/AIActions](https://t.me/addemoji/AIActions) for examples of custom emoji that are recommended for usage in the block.

- `value` → `$value` / `getValue()` / `setValue()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. For ordered lists, the numeric value of the item label
- `type` → `$type` / `getType()` / `setType()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. For ordered lists, the type of the item label; must be one of “a” for lowercase letters, “A” for uppercase letters, “i” for lowercase Roman numerals, “I” for uppercase Roman numerals, or “1” for decimal numbers

## InputRichBlock

`DevBX\Telegram\RichMessages\InputRichBlock`

This object represents a block in a rich formatted message to be sent. Currently, it can be any of the following types:

- `InputRichBlockParagraph`
- `InputRichBlockSectionHeading`
- `InputRichBlockPreformatted`
- `InputRichBlockFooter`
- `InputRichBlockDivider`
- `InputRichBlockMathematicalExpression`
- `InputRichBlockAnchor`
- `InputRichBlockList`
- `InputRichBlockBlockQuotation`
- `InputRichBlockExpandableBlockQuotation`
- `InputRichBlockPullQuotation`
- `InputRichBlockCollage`
- `InputRichBlockSlideshow`
- `InputRichBlockTable`
- `InputRichBlockDetails`
- `InputRichBlockMap`
- `InputRichBlockButtons`
- `InputRichBlockAnimation`
- `InputRichBlockAudio`
- `InputRichBlockDocument`
- `InputRichBlockPhoto`
- `InputRichBlockVideo`
- `InputRichBlockVoiceNote`
- `InputRichBlockThinking`

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputrichblock
- Union: `InputRichBlock::create($data)` returns one of: `InputRichBlockParagraph`, `InputRichBlockSectionHeading`, `InputRichBlockPreformatted`, `InputRichBlockFooter`, `InputRichBlockDivider`, `InputRichBlockMathematicalExpression`, `InputRichBlockAnchor`, `InputRichBlockList`, `InputRichBlockBlockQuotation`, `InputRichBlockExpandableBlockQuotation`, `InputRichBlockPullQuotation`, `InputRichBlockCollage`, `InputRichBlockSlideshow`, `InputRichBlockTable`, `InputRichBlockDetails`, `InputRichBlockMap`, `InputRichBlockButtons`, `InputRichBlockAnimation`, `InputRichBlockAudio`, `InputRichBlockDocument`, `InputRichBlockPhoto`, `InputRichBlockVideo`, `InputRichBlockVoiceNote`, `InputRichBlockThinking`

## InlineQuery

`DevBX\Telegram\InlineMode\InlineQuery`

This object represents an incoming inline query. When the user sends an empty query, your bot could return some default or trending results.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inlinequery

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `id` → `$id` / `getId()` / `setId()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Unique identifier for this query
- `from` → `$from` / `getFrom()` / `setFrom()`: `Types\User|null`; `Types\User|array<string, mixed>` — required. Sender
- `query` → `$query` / `getQuery()` / `setQuery()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Text of the query (up to 256 characters)
- `offset` → `$offset` / `getOffset()` / `setOffset()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Offset of the results to be returned, can be controlled by the bot
- `chat_type` → `$chatType` / `getChatType()` / `setChatType()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Type of the chat from which the inline query was sent. Can be either “sender” for a private chat with the inline query sender, “private”, “group”, “supergroup”, or “channel”. The chat type should be always known for requests sent from official clients and most third-party clients, unless the request was sent from a secret chat.
- `location` → `$location` / `getLocation()` / `setLocation()`: `Types\Location|null`; `Types\Location|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Sender location, only for bots that request user location

## InlineQueryResultsButton

`DevBX\Telegram\InlineMode\InlineQueryResultsButton`

This object represents a button to be shown above inline query results. You **must** use exactly one of the optional fields.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inlinequeryresultsbutton

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `text` → `$text` / `getText()` / `setText()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Label text on the button
- `web_app` → `$webApp` / `getWebApp()` / `setWebApp()`: `Types\WebAppInfo|null`; `Types\WebAppInfo|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Description of the [Web App](https://core.telegram.org/bots/webapps) that will be launched when the user presses the button. The Web App will be able to switch back to the inline mode using the method [switchInlineQuery](https://core.telegram.org/bots/webapps#initializing-mini-apps) inside the Web App.
- `start_parameter` → `$startParameter` / `getStartParameter()` / `setStartParameter()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. [Deep-linking](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#deep-linking) parameter for the /start message sent to the bot when a user presses the button. 1-64 characters, only `A-Z`, `a-z`, `0-9`, `_` and `-` are allowed. *Example:* An inline bot that sends YouTube videos can ask the user to connect the bot to their YouTube account to adapt search results accordingly. To do this, it displays a 'Connect your YouTube account' button above the results, or even before showing any. The user presses the button, switches to a private chat with the bot and, in doing so, passes a start parameter that instructs the bot to return an OAuth link. Once done, the bot can offer a `InlineKeyboardMarkup` button so that the user can easily return to the chat where they wanted to use the bot's inline capabilities.

## InlineQueryResult

`DevBX\Telegram\InlineMode\InlineQueryResult`

This object represents one result of an inline query. Telegram clients currently support results of the following 20 types:

- `InlineQueryResultCachedAudio`
- `InlineQueryResultCachedDocument`
- `InlineQueryResultCachedGif`
- `InlineQueryResultCachedMpeg4Gif`
- `InlineQueryResultCachedPhoto`
- `InlineQueryResultCachedSticker`
- `InlineQueryResultCachedVideo`
- `InlineQueryResultCachedVoice`
- `InlineQueryResultArticle`
- `InlineQueryResultAudio`
- `InlineQueryResultContact`
- `InlineQueryResultGame`
- `InlineQueryResultDocument`
- `InlineQueryResultGif`
- `InlineQueryResultLocation`
- `InlineQueryResultMpeg4Gif`
- `InlineQueryResultPhoto`
- `InlineQueryResultVenue`
- `InlineQueryResultVideo`
- `InlineQueryResultVoice`

**Note:** All URLs passed in inline query results will be available to end users and therefore must be assumed to be **public**.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inlinequeryresult
- Union: `InlineQueryResult::create($data)` returns one of: `InlineQueryResultCachedAudio`, `InlineQueryResultCachedDocument`, `InlineQueryResultCachedGif`, `InlineQueryResultCachedMpeg4Gif`, `InlineQueryResultCachedPhoto`, `InlineQueryResultCachedSticker`, `InlineQueryResultCachedVideo`, `InlineQueryResultCachedVoice`, `InlineQueryResultArticle`, `InlineQueryResultAudio`, `InlineQueryResultContact`, `InlineQueryResultGame`, `InlineQueryResultDocument`, `InlineQueryResultGif`, `InlineQueryResultLocation`, `InlineQueryResultMpeg4Gif`, `InlineQueryResultPhoto`, `InlineQueryResultVenue`, `InlineQueryResultVideo`, `InlineQueryResultVoice`

## InlineQueryResultArticle

`DevBX\Telegram\InlineMode\InlineQueryResultArticle` — variant of `InlineQueryResult`

Represents a link to an article or web page.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inlinequeryresultarticle

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `type` → `$type` / `getType()` / `setType()`: `string|null`; `string` — required, always `'article'`. Type of the result, must be *article*
- `id` → `$id` / `getId()` / `setId()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Unique identifier for this result, 1-64 Bytes
- `title` → `$title` / `getTitle()` / `setTitle()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Title of the result
- `input_message_content` → `$inputMessageContent` / `getInputMessageContent()` / `setInputMessageContent()`: `InlineMode\InputMessageContent|null`; `InlineMode\InputMessageContent|array<string, mixed>` — required. Content of the message to be sent
- `reply_markup` → `$replyMarkup` / `getReplyMarkup()` / `setReplyMarkup()`: `Types\InlineKeyboardMarkup|null`; `Types\InlineKeyboardMarkup|array<string, mixed>` — optional. [Inline keyboard](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#inline-keyboards) attached to the message
- `url` → `$url` / `getUrl()` / `setUrl()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. URL of the result
- `description` → `$description` / `getDescription()` / `setDescription()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Short description of the result
- `thumbnail_url` → `$thumbnailUrl` / `getThumbnailUrl()` / `setThumbnailUrl()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Url of the thumbnail for the result
- `thumbnail_width` → `$thumbnailWidth` / `getThumbnailWidth()` / `setThumbnailWidth()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Thumbnail width
- `thumbnail_height` → `$thumbnailHeight` / `getThumbnailHeight()` / `setThumbnailHeight()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Thumbnail height

## InlineQueryResultPhoto

`DevBX\Telegram\InlineMode\InlineQueryResultPhoto` — variant of `InlineQueryResult`

Represents a link to a photo. By default, this photo will be sent by the user with optional caption. Alternatively, you can use *input_message_content* to send a message with the specified content instead of the photo.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inlinequeryresultphoto

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `type` → `$type` / `getType()` / `setType()`: `string|null`; `string` — required, always `'photo'`. Type of the result, must be *photo*
- `id` → `$id` / `getId()` / `setId()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Unique identifier for this result, 1-64 bytes
- `photo_url` → `$photoUrl` / `getPhotoUrl()` / `setPhotoUrl()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. A valid URL of the photo. Photo must be in **JPEG** format. Photo size must not exceed 5MB.

## InlineQueryResultVideo

`DevBX\Telegram\InlineMode\InlineQueryResultVideo` — variant of `InlineQueryResult`

Represents a link to a page containing an embedded video player or a video file. By default, this video file will be sent by the user with an optional caption. Alternatively, you can use *input_message_content* to send a message with the specified content instead of the video.

If an InlineQueryResultVideo message contains an embedded video (e.g., YouTube), you **must** replace its content using *input_message_content*.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inlinequeryresultvideo

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):

- `mime_type` → `$mimeType` / `getMimeType()` / `setMimeType()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. MIME type of the content of the video URL, “text/html” or “video/mp4”
- `thumbnail_url` → `$thumbnailUrl` / `getThumbnailUrl()` / `setThumbnailUrl()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. URL of the thumbnail (JPEG only) for the video
- `title` → `$title` / `getTitle()` / `setTitle()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Title for the result
- `caption` → `$caption` / `getCaption()` / `setCaption()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Caption of the video to be sent, 0-1024 characters after entities parsing
- `parse_mode` → `$parseMode` / `getParseMode()` / `setParseMode()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Mode for parsing entities in the video caption. See [formatting options](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#formatting-options) for more details.
- `caption_entities` → `$captionEntities` / `getCaptionEntities()` / `setCaptionEntities()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Types\MessageEntity>`; `list<Types\MessageEntity|array<string, mixed>>|Base\ArrayObject<Types\MessageEntity>` — optional. List of special entities that appear in the caption, which can be specified instead of *parse_mode*
- `show_caption_above_media` → `$showCaptionAboveMedia` / `getShowCaptionAboveMedia()` / `setShowCaptionAboveMedia()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Pass *True* if the caption must be shown above the message media
- `video_width` → `$videoWidth` / `getVideoWidth()` / `setVideoWidth()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Video width
- `video_height` → `$videoHeight` / `getVideoHeight()` / `setVideoHeight()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Video height
- `video_duration` → `$videoDuration` / `getVideoDuration()` / `setVideoDuration()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Video duration in seconds
- `description` → `$description` / `getDescription()` / `setDescription()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Short description of the result
- `reply_markup` → `$replyMarkup` / `getReplyMarkup()` / `setReplyMarkup()`: `Types\InlineKeyboardMarkup|null`; `Types\InlineKeyboardMarkup|array<string, mixed>` — optional. [Inline keyboard](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#inline-keyboards) attached to the message
- `input_message_content` → `$inputMessageContent` / `getInputMessageContent()` / `setInputMessageContent()`: `InlineMode\InputMessageContent|null`; `InlineMode\InputMessageContent|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Content of the message to be sent instead of the video. This field is **required** if InlineQueryResultVideo is used to send an HTML-page as a result (e.g., a YouTube video).

## InputMessageContent

`DevBX\Telegram\InlineMode\InputMessageContent`

This object represents the content of a message to be sent as a result of an inline query. Telegram clients currently support the following types:

- `InputTextMessageContent`
- `InputRichMessageContent`
- `InputLocationMessageContent`
- `InputVenueMessageContent`
- `InputContactMessageContent`
- `InputInvoiceMessageContent`

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputmessagecontent
- Union: `InputMessageContent::create($data)` returns one of: `InputTextMessageContent`, `InputRichMessageContent`, `InputLocationMessageContent`, `InputVenueMessageContent`, `InputContactMessageContent`, `InputInvoiceMessageContent`

## InputTextMessageContent

`DevBX\Telegram\InlineMode\InputTextMessageContent` — variant of `InputMessageContent`

Represents the `InputMessageContent` of a text message to be sent as the result of an inline query.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputtextmessagecontent

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `message_text` → `$messageText` / `getMessageText()` / `setMessageText()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Text of the message to be sent, 1-4096 characters
- `parse_mode` → `$parseMode` / `getParseMode()` / `setParseMode()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Mode for parsing entities in the message text. See [formatting options](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#formatting-options) for more details.
- `entities` → `$entities` / `getEntities()` / `setEntities()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Types\MessageEntity>`; `list<Types\MessageEntity|array<string, mixed>>|Base\ArrayObject<Types\MessageEntity>` — optional. List of special entities that appear in message text, which can be specified instead of *parse_mode*
- `link_preview_options` → `$linkPreviewOptions` / `getLinkPreviewOptions()` / `setLinkPreviewOptions()`: `Types\LinkPreviewOptions|null`; `Types\LinkPreviewOptions|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Link preview generation options for the message

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputrichmessagecontent

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `rich_message` → `$richMessage` / `getRichMessage()` / `setRichMessage()`: `RichMessages\InputRichMessage|null`; `RichMessages\InputRichMessage|array<string, mixed>` — required. The message to be sent. Only previously uploaded files may be used in the message.

## InputLocationMessageContent

`DevBX\Telegram\InlineMode\InputLocationMessageContent` — variant of `InputMessageContent`

Represents the `InputMessageContent` of a location message to be sent as the result of an inline query.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputlocationmessagecontent

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `latitude` → `$latitude` / `getLatitude()` / `setLatitude()`: `float|null`; `float|int` — required. Latitude of the location in degrees
- `longitude` → `$longitude` / `getLongitude()` / `setLongitude()`: `float|null`; `float|int` — required. Longitude of the location in degrees
- `horizontal_accuracy` → `$horizontalAccuracy` / `getHorizontalAccuracy()` / `setHorizontalAccuracy()`: `float|null`; `float|int` — optional. The radius of uncertainty for the location, measured in meters; 0-1500
- `live_period` → `$livePeriod` / `getLivePeriod()` / `setLivePeriod()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Period in seconds during which the location can be updated, must be between 60 and 86400, or 0x7FFFFFFF for live locations that can be edited indefinitely
- `heading` → `$heading` / `getHeading()` / `setHeading()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. For live locations, a direction in which the user is moving, in degrees. Must be between 1 and 360 if specified.
- `proximity_alert_radius` → `$proximityAlertRadius` / `getProximityAlertRadius()` / `setProximityAlertRadius()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. For live locations, a maximum distance for proximity alerts about approaching another chat member, in meters. Must be between 1 and 100000 if specified.

## InputInvoiceMessageContent

`DevBX\Telegram\InlineMode\InputInvoiceMessageContent` — variant of `InputMessageContent`

Represents the `InputMessageContent` of an invoice message to be sent as the result of an inline query.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputinvoicemessagecontent

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `title` → `$title` / `getTitle()` / `setTitle()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Product name, 1-32 characters
- `description` → `$description` / `getDescription()` / `setDescription()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Product description, 1-255 characters
- `payload` → `$payload` / `getPayload()` / `setPayload()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Bot-defined invoice payload, 1-128 bytes. This will not be displayed to the user, use it for your internal processes.
- `provider_token` → `$providerToken` / `getProviderToken()` / `setProviderToken()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Payment provider token, obtained via [@BotFather](https://t.me/botfather). Pass an empty string for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).
- `currency` → `$currency` / `getCurrency()` / `setCurrency()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code, see [more on currencies](https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments#supported-currencies). Pass “XTR” for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).
- `prices` → `$prices` / `getPrices()` / `setPrices()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Payments\LabeledPrice>`; `list<Payments\LabeledPrice|array<string, mixed>>|Base\ArrayObject<Payments\LabeledPrice>` — required. Price breakdown, a JSON-serialized list of components (e.g. product price, tax, discount, delivery cost, delivery tax, bonus, etc.). Must contain exactly one item for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).
- `max_tip_amount` → `$maxTipAmount` / `getMaxTipAmount()` / `setMaxTipAmount()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. The maximum accepted amount for tips in the *smallest units* of the currency (integer, **not** float/double). For example, for a maximum tip of `US$ 1.45` pass `max_tip_amount = 145`. See the *exp* parameter in [currencies.json](https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments/currencies.json), it shows the number of digits past the decimal point for each currency (2 for the majority of currencies). Defaults to 0. Not supported for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).
- `suggested_tip_amounts` → `$suggestedTipAmounts` / `getSuggestedTipAmounts()` / `setSuggestedTipAmounts()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Base\ParameterInt>`; `list<int>|Base\ArrayObject<Base\ParameterInt>` — optional. A JSON-serialized Array of suggested amounts of tip in the *smallest units* of the currency (integer, **not** float/double). At most 4 suggested tip amounts can be specified. The suggested tip amounts must be positive, passed in a strictly increased order and must not exceed *max_tip_amount*.
- `provider_data` → `$providerData` / `getProviderData()` / `setProviderData()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. A JSON-serialized object for data about the invoice, which will be shared with the payment provider. A detailed description of the required fields should be provided by the payment provider.
- `photo_url` → `$photoUrl` / `getPhotoUrl()` / `setPhotoUrl()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. URL of the product photo for the invoice. Can be a photo of the goods or a marketing image for a service.
- `photo_size` → `$photoSize` / `getPhotoSize()` / `setPhotoSize()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Photo size in bytes
- `photo_width` → `$photoWidth` / `getPhotoWidth()` / `setPhotoWidth()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Photo width
- `photo_height` → `$photoHeight` / `getPhotoHeight()` / `setPhotoHeight()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Photo height
- `need_name` → `$needName` / `getNeedName()` / `setNeedName()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Pass *True* if you require the user's full name to complete the order. Ignored for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).
- `need_phone_number` → `$needPhoneNumber` / `getNeedPhoneNumber()` / `setNeedPhoneNumber()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Pass *True* if you require the user's phone number to complete the order. Ignored for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).
- `need_email` → `$needEmail` / `getNeedEmail()` / `setNeedEmail()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Pass *True* if you require the user's email address to complete the order. Ignored for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).
- `need_shipping_address` → `$needShippingAddress` / `getNeedShippingAddress()` / `setNeedShippingAddress()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Pass *True* if you require the user's shipping address to complete the order. Ignored for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).
- `send_phone_number_to_provider` → `$sendPhoneNumberToProvider` / `getSendPhoneNumberToProvider()` / `setSendPhoneNumberToProvider()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Pass *True* if the user's phone number should be sent to the provider. Ignored for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).
- `send_email_to_provider` → `$sendEmailToProvider` / `getSendEmailToProvider()` / `setSendEmailToProvider()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Pass *True* if the user's email address should be sent to the provider. Ignored for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).
- `is_flexible` → `$isFlexible` / `getIsFlexible()` / `setIsFlexible()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. Pass *True* if the final price depends on the shipping method. Ignored for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90).

## ChosenInlineResult

`DevBX\Telegram\InlineMode\ChosenInlineResult`

Represents a `InlineQueryResult` of an inline query that was chosen by the user and sent to their chat partner.

**Note:** It is necessary to enable [inline feedback](https://core.telegram.org/bots/inline#collecting-feedback) via [@BotFather](https://t.me/botfather) in order to receive these objects in updates.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#choseninlineresult

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `result_id` → `$resultId` / `getResultId()` / `setResultId()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. The unique identifier for the result that was chosen
- `from` → `$from` / `getFrom()` / `setFrom()`: `Types\User|null`; `Types\User|array<string, mixed>` — required. The user that chose the result
- `location` → `$location` / `getLocation()` / `setLocation()`: `Types\Location|null`; `Types\Location|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Sender location, only for bots that require user location
- `inline_message_id` → `$inlineMessageId` / `getInlineMessageId()` / `setInlineMessageId()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Identifier of the sent inline message. Available only if there is an `InlineKeyboardMarkup` attached to the message. Will be also received in `CallbackQuery` and can be used to [edit](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#updating-messages) the message.
- `query` → `$query` / `getQuery()` / `setQuery()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. The query that was used to obtain the result

## SuccessfulPayment

`DevBX\Telegram\Payments\SuccessfulPayment`

This object contains basic information about a successful payment. Note that if the buyer initiates a chargeback with the relevant payment provider following this transaction, the funds may be debited from your balance. This is outside of Telegram's control.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#successfulpayment

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `currency` → `$currency` / `getCurrency()` / `setCurrency()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Three-letter ISO 4217 [currency](https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments#supported-currencies) code, or “XTR” for payments in [Telegram Stars](https://t.me/BotNews/90)
- `total_amount` → `$totalAmount` / `getTotalAmount()` / `setTotalAmount()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Total price in the *smallest units* of the currency (integer, **not** float/double). For example, for a price of `US$ 1.45` pass `amount = 145`. See the *exp* parameter in [currencies.json](https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments/currencies.json), it shows the number of digits past the decimal point for each currency (2 for the majority of currencies).
- `invoice_payload` → `$invoicePayload` / `getInvoicePayload()` / `setInvoicePayload()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Bot-specified invoice payload
- `subscription_expiration_date` → `$subscriptionExpirationDate` / `getSubscriptionExpirationDate()` / `setSubscriptionExpirationDate()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Expiration date of the subscription, in Unix time; for recurring payments only
- `is_recurring` → `$isRecurring` / `getIsRecurring()` / `setIsRecurring()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the payment is a recurring payment for a subscription
- `is_first_recurring` → `$isFirstRecurring` / `getIsFirstRecurring()` / `setIsFirstRecurring()`: `bool|null`; `bool` — optional. *True*, if the payment is the first payment for a subscription
- `shipping_option_id` → `$shippingOptionId` / `getShippingOptionId()` / `setShippingOptionId()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Identifier of the shipping option chosen by the user
- `order_info` → `$orderInfo` / `getOrderInfo()` / `setOrderInfo()`: `Payments\OrderInfo|null`; `Payments\OrderInfo|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Order information provided by the user
- `telegram_payment_charge_id` → `$telegramPaymentChargeId` / `getTelegramPaymentChargeId()` / `setTelegramPaymentChargeId()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Telegram payment identifier
- `provider_payment_charge_id` → `$providerPaymentChargeId` / `getProviderPaymentChargeId()` / `setProviderPaymentChargeId()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Provider payment identifier

## RevenueWithdrawalState

`DevBX\Telegram\Payments\RevenueWithdrawalState`

This object describes the state of a revenue withdrawal operation. Currently, it can be one of

- `RevenueWithdrawalStatePending`
- `RevenueWithdrawalStateSucceeded`
- `RevenueWithdrawalStateFailed`

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#revenuewithdrawalstate
- Union: `RevenueWithdrawalState::create($data)` returns one of: `RevenueWithdrawalStatePending`, `RevenueWithdrawalStateSucceeded`, `RevenueWithdrawalStateFailed`

## RevenueWithdrawalStatePending

`DevBX\Telegram\Payments\RevenueWithdrawalStatePending` — variant of `RevenueWithdrawalState`

The withdrawal is in progress.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#revenuewithdrawalstatepending

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `type` → `$type` / `getType()` / `setType()`: `string|null`; `string` — required, always `'pending'`. Type of the state, always “pending”

## RevenueWithdrawalStateSucceeded

`DevBX\Telegram\Payments\RevenueWithdrawalStateSucceeded` — variant of `RevenueWithdrawalState`

The withdrawal succeeded.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#revenuewithdrawalstatesucceeded

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `type` → `$type` / `getType()` / `setType()`: `string|null`; `string` — required, always `'succeeded'`. Type of the state, always “succeeded”
- `date` → `$date` / `getDate()` / `setDate()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Date the withdrawal was completed in Unix time
- `url` → `$url` / `getUrl()` / `setUrl()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. An HTTPS URL that can be used to see transaction details

## RevenueWithdrawalStateFailed

`DevBX\Telegram\Payments\RevenueWithdrawalStateFailed` — variant of `RevenueWithdrawalState`

The withdrawal failed and the transaction was refunded.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#revenuewithdrawalstatefailed

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `type` → `$type` / `getType()` / `setType()`: `string|null`; `string` — required, always `'failed'`. Type of the state, always “failed”

## AffiliateInfo

`DevBX\Telegram\Payments\AffiliateInfo`

Contains information about the affiliate that received a commission via this transaction.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#affiliateinfo

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `affiliate_user` → `$affiliateUser` / `getAffiliateUser()` / `setAffiliateUser()`: `Types\User|null`; `Types\User|array<string, mixed>` — optional. The bot or the user that received an affiliate commission if it was received by a bot or a user
- `affiliate_chat` → `$affiliateChat` / `getAffiliateChat()` / `setAffiliateChat()`: `Types\Chat|null`; `Types\Chat|array<string, mixed>` — optional. The chat that received an affiliate commission if it was received by a chat
- `commission_per_mille` → `$commissionPerMille` / `getCommissionPerMille()` / `setCommissionPerMille()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. The number of Telegram Stars received by the affiliate for each 1000 Telegram Stars received by the bot from referred users
- `amount` → `$amount` / `getAmount()` / `setAmount()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Integer amount of Telegram Stars received by the affiliate from the transaction, rounded to 0; can be negative for refunds
- `nanostar_amount` → `$nanostarAmount` / `getNanostarAmount()` / `setNanostarAmount()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. The number of 1/1000000000 shares of Telegram Stars received by the affiliate; from -999999999 to 999999999; can be negative for refunds

## TransactionPartner

`DevBX\Telegram\Payments\TransactionPartner`

This object describes the source of a transaction, or its recipient for outgoing transactions. Currently, it can be one of

- `TransactionPartnerUser`
- `TransactionPartnerChat`
- `TransactionPartnerAffiliateProgram`
- `TransactionPartnerFragment`
- `TransactionPartnerTelegramAds`
- `TransactionPartnerTelegramApi`
- `TransactionPartnerOther`

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#transactionpartner
- Union: `TransactionPartner::create($data)` returns one of: `TransactionPartnerUser`, `TransactionPartnerChat`, `TransactionPartnerAffiliateProgram`, `TransactionPartnerFragment`, `TransactionPartnerTelegramAds`, `TransactionPartnerTelegramApi`, `TransactionPartnerOther`

## TransactionPartnerUser

`DevBX\Telegram\Payments\TransactionPartnerUser` — variant of `TransactionPartner`

Describes a transaction with a user.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#transactionpartneruser

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `type` → `$type` / `getType()` / `setType()`: `string|null`; `string` — required, always `'user'`. Type of the transaction partner, always “user”
- `transaction_type` → `$transactionType` / `getTransactionType()` / `setTransactionType()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Type of the transaction, currently one of “invoice_payment” for payments via invoices, “paid_media_payment” for payments for paid media, “gift_purchase” for gifts sent by the bot, “premium_purchase” for Telegram Premium subscriptions gifted by the bot, “business_account_transfer” for direct transfers from managed business accounts
- `user` → `$user` / `getUser()` / `setUser()`: `Types\User|null`; `Types\User|array<string, mixed>` — required. Information about the user
- `affiliate` → `$affiliate` / `getAffiliate()` / `setAffiliate()`: `Payments\AffiliateInfo|null`; `Payments\AffiliateInfo|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Information about the affiliate that received a commission via this transaction. Can be available only for “invoice_payment” and “paid_media_payment” transactions.
- `invoice_payload` → `$invoicePayload` / `getInvoicePayload()` / `setInvoicePayload()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Bot-specified invoice payload. Can be available only for “invoice_payment” transactions.
- `subscription_period` → `$subscriptionPeriod` / `getSubscriptionPeriod()` / `setSubscriptionPeriod()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. The duration of the paid subscription. Can be available only for “invoice_payment” transactions.
- `paid_media` → `$paidMedia` / `getPaidMedia()` / `setPaidMedia()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Types\PaidMedia>`; `list<Types\PaidMedia|array<string, mixed>>|Base\ArrayObject<Types\PaidMedia>` — optional. Information about the paid media bought by the user; for “paid_media_payment” transactions only
- `paid_media_payload` → `$paidMediaPayload` / `getPaidMediaPayload()` / `setPaidMediaPayload()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Bot-specified paid media payload. Can be available only for “paid_media_payment” transactions.
- `gift` → `$gift` / `getGift()` / `setGift()`: `Types\Gift|null`; `Types\Gift|array<string, mixed>` — optional. The gift sent to the user by the bot; for “gift_purchase” transactions only
- `premium_subscription_duration` → `$premiumSubscriptionDuration` / `getPremiumSubscriptionDuration()` / `setPremiumSubscriptionDuration()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. Number of months the gifted Telegram Premium subscription will be active for; for “premium_purchase” transactions only
