## StarTransaction

`DevBX\Telegram\Payments\StarTransaction`

Describes a Telegram Star transaction. Note that if the buyer initiates a chargeback with the payment provider from whom they acquired Stars (e.g., Apple, Google) following this transaction, the refunded Stars will be deducted from the bot's balance. This is outside of Telegram's control.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#startransaction

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `id` → `$id` / `getId()` / `setId()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Unique identifier of the transaction. Coincides with the identifier of the original transaction for refund transactions. Coincides with *SuccessfulPayment.telegram_payment_charge_id* for successful incoming payments from users.
- `amount` → `$amount` / `getAmount()` / `setAmount()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Integer amount of Telegram Stars transferred by the transaction
- `nanostar_amount` → `$nanostarAmount` / `getNanostarAmount()` / `setNanostarAmount()`: `int|null`; `int` — optional. The number of 1/1000000000 shares of Telegram Stars transferred by the transaction; from 0 to 999999999
- `date` → `$date` / `getDate()` / `setDate()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Date the transaction was created in Unix time
- `source` → `$source` / `getSource()` / `setSource()`: `Payments\TransactionPartner|null`; `Payments\TransactionPartner|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Source of an incoming transaction (e.g., a user purchasing goods or services, Fragment refunding a failed withdrawal). Only for incoming transactions.
- `receiver` → `$receiver` / `getReceiver()` / `setReceiver()`: `Payments\TransactionPartner|null`; `Payments\TransactionPartner|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Receiver of an outgoing transaction (e.g., a user for a purchase refund, Fragment for a withdrawal). Only for outgoing transactions.

## StarTransactions

`DevBX\Telegram\Payments\StarTransactions`

Contains a list of Telegram Star transactions.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#startransactions

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `transactions` → `$transactions` / `getTransactions()` / `setTransactions()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Payments\StarTransaction>`; `list<Payments\StarTransaction|array<string, mixed>>|Base\ArrayObject<Payments\StarTransaction>` — required. The list of transactions

## PassportData

`DevBX\Telegram\Passport\PassportData`

Describes Telegram Passport data shared with the bot by the user.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#passportdata

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `data` → `$data` / `getData()` / `setData()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Passport\EncryptedPassportElement>`; `list<Passport\EncryptedPassportElement|array<string, mixed>>|Base\ArrayObject<Passport\EncryptedPassportElement>` — required. Array with information about documents and other Telegram Passport elements that was shared with the bot
- `credentials` → `$credentials` / `getCredentials()` / `setCredentials()`: `Passport\EncryptedCredentials|null`; `Passport\EncryptedCredentials|array<string, mixed>` — required. Encrypted credentials required to decrypt the data

## PassportFile

`DevBX\Telegram\Passport\PassportFile`

This object represents a file uploaded to Telegram Passport. Currently all Telegram Passport files are in JPEG format when decrypted and don't exceed 10MB.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#passportfile

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `file_id` → `$fileId` / `getFileId()` / `setFileId()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Identifier for this file, which can be used to download or reuse the file
- `file_unique_id` → `$fileUniqueId` / `getFileUniqueId()` / `setFileUniqueId()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Unique identifier for this file, which is supposed to be the same over time and for different bots. Can't be used to download or reuse the file.
- `file_size` → `$fileSize` / `getFileSize()` / `setFileSize()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. File size in bytes
- `file_date` → `$fileDate` / `getFileDate()` / `setFileDate()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Unix time when the file was uploaded

## EncryptedPassportElement

`DevBX\Telegram\Passport\EncryptedPassportElement`

Describes documents or other Telegram Passport elements shared with the bot by the user.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#encryptedpassportelement

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `type` → `$type` / `getType()` / `setType()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Element type. One of “personal_details”, “passport”, “driver_license”, “identity_card”, “internal_passport”, “address”, “utility_bill”, “bank_statement”, “rental_agreement”, “passport_registration”, “temporary_registration”, “phone_number”, “email”.
- `data` → `$data` / `getData()` / `setData()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Base64-encoded encrypted Telegram Passport element data provided by the user; available only for “personal_details”, “passport”, “driver_license”, “identity_card”, “internal_passport” and “address” types. Can be decrypted and verified using the accompanying `EncryptedCredentials`.
- `phone_number` → `$phoneNumber` / `getPhoneNumber()` / `setPhoneNumber()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. User's verified phone number; available only for “phone_number” type
- `email` → `$email` / `getEmail()` / `setEmail()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. User's verified email address; available only for “email” type
- `files` → `$files` / `getFiles()` / `setFiles()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Passport\PassportFile>`; `list<Passport\PassportFile|array<string, mixed>>|Base\ArrayObject<Passport\PassportFile>` — optional. Array of encrypted files with documents provided by the user; available only for “utility_bill”, “bank_statement”, “rental_agreement”, “passport_registration” and “temporary_registration” types. Files can be decrypted and verified using the accompanying `EncryptedCredentials`.
- `front_side` → `$frontSide` / `getFrontSide()` / `setFrontSide()`: `Passport\PassportFile|null`; `Passport\PassportFile|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Encrypted file with the front side of the document, provided by the user; available only for “passport”, “driver_license”, “identity_card” and “internal_passport”. The file can be decrypted and verified using the accompanying `EncryptedCredentials`.
- `reverse_side` → `$reverseSide` / `getReverseSide()` / `setReverseSide()`: `Passport\PassportFile|null`; `Passport\PassportFile|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Encrypted file with the reverse side of the document, provided by the user; available only for “driver_license” and “identity_card”. The file can be decrypted and verified using the accompanying `EncryptedCredentials`.
- `selfie` → `$selfie` / `getSelfie()` / `setSelfie()`: `Passport\PassportFile|null`; `Passport\PassportFile|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Encrypted file with the selfie of the user holding a document, provided by the user; available if requested for “passport”, “driver_license”, “identity_card” and “internal_passport”. The file can be decrypted and verified using the accompanying `EncryptedCredentials`.
- `translation` → `$translation` / `getTranslation()` / `setTranslation()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Passport\PassportFile>`; `list<Passport\PassportFile|array<string, mixed>>|Base\ArrayObject<Passport\PassportFile>` — optional. Array of encrypted files with translated versions of documents provided by the user; available if requested for “passport”, “driver_license”, “identity_card”, “internal_passport”, “utility_bill”, “bank_statement”, “rental_agreement”, “passport_registration” and “temporary_registration” types. Files can be decrypted and verified using the accompanying `EncryptedCredentials`.
- `hash` → `$hash` / `getHash()` / `setHash()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Base64-encoded element hash for using in `PassportElementErrorUnspecified`

## EncryptedCredentials

`DevBX\Telegram\Passport\EncryptedCredentials`

Describes data required for decrypting and authenticating `EncryptedPassportElement`. See the [Telegram Passport Documentation](https://core.telegram.org/passport#receiving-information) for a complete description of the data decryption and authentication processes.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#encryptedcredentials

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `data` → `$data` / `getData()` / `setData()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Base64-encoded encrypted JSON-serialized data with unique user's payload, data hashes and secrets required for `EncryptedPassportElement` decryption and authentication
- `hash` → `$hash` / `getHash()` / `setHash()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Base64-encoded data hash for data authentication
- `secret` → `$secret` / `getSecret()` / `setSecret()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Base64-encoded secret, encrypted with the bot's public RSA key, required for data decryption

## PassportElementError

`DevBX\Telegram\Passport\PassportElementError`

This object represents an error in the Telegram Passport element which was submitted that should be resolved by the user. It should be one of:

- `PassportElementErrorDataField`
- `PassportElementErrorFrontSide`
- `PassportElementErrorReverseSide`
- `PassportElementErrorSelfie`
- `PassportElementErrorFile`
- `PassportElementErrorFiles`
- `PassportElementErrorTranslationFile`
- `PassportElementErrorTranslationFiles`
- `PassportElementErrorUnspecified`

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#passportelementerror
- Union: `PassportElementError::create($data)` returns one of: `PassportElementErrorDataField`, `PassportElementErrorFrontSide`, `PassportElementErrorReverseSide`, `PassportElementErrorSelfie`, `PassportElementErrorFile`, `PassportElementErrorFiles`, `PassportElementErrorTranslationFile`, `PassportElementErrorTranslationFiles`, `PassportElementErrorUnspecified`

## PassportElementErrorTranslationFiles

`DevBX\Telegram\Passport\PassportElementErrorTranslationFiles` — variant of `PassportElementError`

Represents an issue with the translated version of a document. The error is considered resolved when a file with the document translation change.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#passportelementerrortranslationfiles

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `source` → `$source` / `getSource()` / `setSource()`: `string|null`; `string` — required, always `'translation_files'`. Error source, must be *translation_files*
- `type` → `$type` / `getType()` / `setType()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Type of element of the user's Telegram Passport which has the issue, one of “passport”, “driver_license”, “identity_card”, “internal_passport”, “utility_bill”, “bank_statement”, “rental_agreement”, “passport_registration”, “temporary_registration”
- `file_hashes` → `$fileHashes` / `getFileHashes()` / `setFileHashes()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Base\ParameterString>`; `list<string>|Base\ArrayObject<Base\ParameterString>` — required. List of base64-encoded file hashes
- `message` → `$message` / `getMessage()` / `setMessage()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Error message

## PassportElementErrorUnspecified

`DevBX\Telegram\Passport\PassportElementErrorUnspecified` — variant of `PassportElementError`

Represents an issue in an unspecified place. The error is considered resolved when new data is added.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#passportelementerrorunspecified

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `source` → `$source` / `getSource()` / `setSource()`: `string|null`; `string` — required, always `'unspecified'`. Error source, must be *unspecified*
- `type` → `$type` / `getType()` / `setType()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Type of element of the user's Telegram Passport which has the issue
- `element_hash` → `$elementHash` / `getElementHash()` / `setElementHash()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Base64-encoded element hash
- `message` → `$message` / `getMessage()` / `setMessage()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Error message

## Game

`DevBX\Telegram\Games\Game`

This object represents a game. Use BotFather to create and edit games, their short names will act as unique identifiers.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#game

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `title` → `$title` / `getTitle()` / `setTitle()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Title of the game
- `description` → `$description` / `getDescription()` / `setDescription()`: `string|null`; `string` — required. Description of the game
- `photo` → `$photo` / `getPhoto()` / `setPhoto()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Types\PhotoSize>`; `list<Types\PhotoSize|array<string, mixed>>|Base\ArrayObject<Types\PhotoSize>` — required. Photo that will be displayed in the game message in chats
- `text` → `$text` / `getText()` / `setText()`: `string|null`; `string` — optional. Brief description of the game or high scores included in the game message. Can be automatically edited to include current high scores for the game when the bot calls `setGameScore`, or manually edited using `editMessageText`. 0-4096 characters.
- `text_entities` → `$textEntities` / `getTextEntities()` / `setTextEntities()`: `Base\ArrayObject<Types\MessageEntity>`; `list<Types\MessageEntity|array<string, mixed>>|Base\ArrayObject<Types\MessageEntity>` — optional. Special entities that appear in *text*, such as usernames, URLs, bot commands, etc.
- `animation` → `$animation` / `getAnimation()` / `setAnimation()`: `Types\Animation|null`; `Types\Animation|array<string, mixed>` — optional. Animation that will be displayed in the game message in chats. Upload via [BotFather](https://t.me/botfather).

## CallbackGame

`DevBX\Telegram\Games\CallbackGame`

A placeholder, currently holds no information. Use [BotFather](https://t.me/botfather) to set up your game.

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#callbackgame

## GameHighScore

`DevBX\Telegram\Games\GameHighScore`

This object represents one row of the high scores table for a game.

And that's about all we've got for now.
If you've got any questions, please check out our [**Bot FAQ »**](https://core.telegram.org/bots/faq)

- Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#gamehighscore

Fields (`field` → property / getter / setter: read type; write type):
- `position` → `$position` / `getPosition()` / `setPosition()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Position in high score table for the game
- `user` → `$user` / `getUser()` / `setUser()`: `Types\User|null`; `Types\User|array<string, mixed>` — required. User
- `score` → `$score` / `getScore()` / `setScore()`: `int|null`; `int` — required. Score
